gated.title: Hedge magic
gated.intro: Hedge traditions in general, their characters and their place in the Order.

entries.title: Hedge Magic: common rules
entries.summary: Introduces the common rules shared by hedge traditions and advises troupes designing their own traditions to break only a few of them.

entries.title: The Gift in hedge traditions
entries.summary: Notes that some hedge traditions are exclusively Gifted and others include unGifted members, and what that implies about their size, isolation and survival.

entries.title: Opening the Gift (hedge traditions)
entries.summary: A season-long ritual in which a Gifted master Opens an apprentice's Gift to the tradition; if the apprentice already has Supernatural Abilities or Arts, an Opening Total is compared with an Opening Ease Factor, with a worked example.
quotes: It takes one season to Open The Gift, which occupies both the apprentice and the master for the whole season.
Opening Ease Factor: twice apprentice's Supernatural Ability + Art scores (+ 12 if Gift already Open)
unless the Opening Total exceeds twice the Opening Ease Factor the apprentice loses his existing Supernatural Ability and Art Scores

entries.title: Flawed Opening of The Gift
entries.summary: A master who lacks competence in the tradition's Arts and Abilities passes on a Flaw to the apprentice for each shortfall.
quotes: the character must have a score of at least 2 in each Supernatural Ability and Art of the tradition

entries.title: Opening the Arts after a hedge Opening
entries.requires: Apprentice whose Gift was already Opened by a hedge tradition
entries.summary: Adds a penalty to the Intellego Vim Lab Total needed to Open the Hermetic Arts of an apprentice whose Gift has already been Opened by a hedge tradition.
quotes: add 30 to the Intellego Vim Lab Total required by the magus

entries.title: Social Penalty of the Gift (hedge traditions)
entries.summary: Gifted hedge wizards suffer the Gift's social penalty even with other Gifted characters unless their tradition has found a remedy comparable to Parma Magica.

entries.title: The Limits of Magic and hedge magic
entries.summary: Hedge magic is bound by the Limits of Magic; troupe-designed traditions should break at most one Lesser Limit and no Greater Limit, and should respect the new Limit of Magic Resistance.
quotes: traditions devised by the troupe break no more than one of the Lesser Limits of Magic

entries.title: Hedge Arts and Supernatural Abilities
entries.summary: Hedge traditions produce effects through combinations of hedge Arts, through Supernatural Abilities, or both; hedge Arts do not combine with Hermetic Arts or with other traditions' Arts.

entries.title: Difficult Arts Mechanically (design guideline)
entries.summary: Design advice: if a combination of hedge Arts can affect magi, at least one of them should be a Difficult Art so hedge wizards cannot easily get high Penetration.

entries.title: Difficult Arts
entries.summary: Difficult Arts are bought and advanced like Abilities rather than Arts, but otherwise act as Arts for vis study, Magical Foci and Virtues that affect Arts.
quotes: it costs 5 experience points for a score of 1, 15 experience points for a score of 2, etc

entries.title: Accelerated Abilities
entries.summary: The counterpart to Difficult Arts: Abilities that advance like Arts at one experience point for a score of 1, are not capped at creation, and are otherwise treated as Abilities.
quotes: costing one experience point for a score of 1

entries.title: Favored Abilities
entries.requires: Gifted member of a tradition with favored Supernatural Abilities
entries.summary: Gifted characters of some traditions need not subtract their favored Supernatural Ability scores from the source quality when learning other favored Abilities, but do subtract all of them when learning non-favored ones.

entries.title: The Limit of Magic Resistance
entries.summary: A proposed new Limit of Magic: no hedge tradition has a general resistance to magic, and the Order ruthlessly eliminates any that develop one.
quotes: No hedge tradition has a general resistance to magic.

entries.title: Magic Defenses (hedge wizards)
entries.requires: Hedge tradition that grants Magical Defenses
entries.summary: Hedge wizards have no true Magic Resistance but may gain limited Magical Defense Bonuses in their area of specialty, derived from a hedge Art or Supernatural Ability; defenses do not stack, cannot be switched off and do not apply to Personal Range effects.
quotes: Magical Defense Bonus: Art divided by 5 (round up) or Ability Score
Magical defenses are not cumulative.
Magical defenses do not apply to effects that have a Personal Range.

related.text: Hedge Magic: Greater Magical Defenses and No Magical Defenses

entries.title: Magical Defense: Accelerated Expiry
entries.summary: Spells cast on the hedge wizard within his specialty expire early by an amount that depends on the spell's Duration category.
quotes: Diameter Duration spells expire a number of rounds too early equal to the hedge wizard's Magical Defense Bonus, but last at least one round.

entries.title: Magical Defense: Alacritous Fortune
entries.summary: The hedge wizard adds his Magical Defense Bonus to his Defense Total against spells aimed at him.
quotes: The hedge wizard adds his Magical Defense Bonus to his Defense Total when spells are aimed at him.

entries.title: Magical Defense: Confounding Magics
entries.summary: Makes Concentration rolls harder for casters of Concentration-duration effects aimed at the hedge wizard; in a Group effect only the best bonus among such hedge wizards applies.
quotes: Add the hedge wizards Magical Defense Bonus to the Ease Factor of Concentration rolls

entries.title: Magical Defense: Immovable Object
entries.summary: Each round the hedge wizard rolls to shake off a controlling effect in his specialty, with his Strength and Magical Defense Bonus offsetting the effect's magnitude.
quotes: Strength + Magical Defense Bonus

entries.title: Magical Defense: Magical Fortitude
entries.summary: Damaging effects in the hedge wizard's specialty are soaked with an added Magical Defense Bonus.
quotes: he receives a Magical Defense Bonus to his Soak Total

entries.title: Magical Defense: Strength of Form
entries.requires: Hedge tradition granting Strength of Form
entries.summary: When a form-changing effect in his specialty affects him, the hedge wizard may roll to return to his natural form.
quotes: Stamina + Magical Defense Bonus + simple die roll against an Ease Factor of 9

entries.title: Warping of hedge wizards
entries.summary: Hedge wizards gain Warping Points by the usual methods except from living in a strong magic aura, and have no Wizard's Twilight; unGifted ones react like mundane characters and Gifted ones react in tradition-specific ways.
quotes: he does not accumulate Warping points due to living in a strong magic aura

entries.title: Vis and hedge wizards: detecting vis
entries.summary: Introduces how hedge wizards may use and detect vis, leading into the Magic Sensitivity and non-supernatural detection methods.

entries.title: Creating Hedge Characters
entries.summary: Introduces the general framework for generating hedge wizard characters that each tradition chapter builds on.

entries.title: Hedge wizard as a Gifted Companion
entries.summary: A Gifted companion gets The Gift for free, up to a set number of Virtue points balanced by Flaws, and usually gains access to the tradition's whole suite of powers through a free Social Status after Opening The Gift.
quotes: Such a character may have up to 10 points worth of Virtues and balancing Flaws

entries.title: Hedge wizard as an unGifted Companion
entries.summary: An unGifted hedge wizard buys each power through individual Virtues and has no Gift to Open, so is typically weaker than a Gifted one.
quotes: An un-Gifted companion character may have up to 10 points worth of Virtues and balancing Flaws.

entries.title: Hedge wizard as a Mythic Companion
entries.summary: A more powerful unGifted hedge wizard built as a Mythic Companion with the free Mythic Companion Status, extra Flaws balancing double their value in Virtues, and an extra Minor Virtue.
quotes: The character also receives an extra Minor Virtue at no cost. This means that the Mythic Companion character has a maximum of 21 points of Virtues.

entries.title: Hedge wizard as a Grog
entries.summary: A very minor unGifted hedge wizard can be a grog with a few Minor Virtues representing his powers.
quotes: created as a grog character who has up to three Minor Virtues to represent his powers

entries.title: Concerns in building hedge characters
entries.summary: Reminds troupes to follow the normal Virtue and Flaw mix for each character type, that only Gifted companions may take Hermetic Virtues and Flaws, and how hedge characters compare in power to magi when allocating them to players.
quotes: only Gifted companion characters may be assigned Hermetic Virtues and Flaws

entries.title: Hermetic Virtues and Flaws for hedge wizards
entries.summary: A Gifted hedge wizard may take Hermetic Virtues and Flaws that make sense for his tradition; unGifted members may get Supernatural versions, and may only take a Supernatural Flaw that limits a Virtue he has.
quotes: An unGifted character may only take a Supernatural Flaw of this sort if he has a Virtue that will be limited by it.

entries.title: Free Social Status: (Hedge Wizard)
entries.summary: Each tradition has its own free Social Status Virtue: for Gifted members it reflects the Opening of The Gift and access to favored Abilities or Arts, while unGifted members need the individual Virtues but still gain the social standing.

entries.title: Arcane Abilities of hedge wizards
entries.summary: The hedge wizard Social Status gives access to the Arcane Abilities Finesse, Magic Lore and Penetration, and often a tradition-specific analogue of Magic Theory.
quotes: at least the Arcane Abilities Finesse, Magic Lore, and Penetration

entries.title: (Hedge Magic) Theory
entries.requires: Hedge tradition with a theoretical basis
entries.summary: An Arcane Ability covering the technical practice of a hedge tradition's magic; traditions without practitioners holding it are poor at innovation, new effects and teaching.

entries.title: (Organization) Lore for hedge traditions
entries.summary: A General Ability for the legends, history, structure and goals of each hedge tradition; membership is not required, and some traditions use it in initiations.

entries.title: Inherited and Learned Powers
entries.summary: Hedge powers are either inherited as Supernatural Virtues that the tradition then trains, or learned through teaching, initiations or Opening the Gift; players should decide how a character acquired his powers.

entries.title: Hedge powers during character generation
entries.summary: A Gifted companion with an Opened Gift may spend starting experience on tradition Arts and Abilities, while an unGifted one may only do so for those powers for which he has the corresponding Virtues.

entries.title: Hedge powers during play
entries.summary: In play, hedge wizards improve existing Supernatural Abilities and Arts normally but cannot learn new ones without the necessary Virtues, typically gained by initiation.

entries.title: Hedge tradition Initiations
entries.requires: Hedge tradition that teaches powers by Initiation
entries.summary: A Mystagogue directs the Initiate through a Script of mystically significant tasks; an Initiation Total plus Script Bonus is compared to an Ease Factor and, on success, the Initiate gains a power, usually a Virtue.
quotes: If the Mystagogue does not personally know the power then the Ease Factor is increased by 3 (if the power is a Minor Virtue), or by 9 (if the power is a Major Virtue).
The Script Bonus is added to the Initiation Total.

entries.title: Converts to the Order (hedge wizards joining Hermes)
entries.requires: Hedge wizard character who swears the Oath of Hermes (House Ex Miscellanea)
entries.summary: How to build a Gifted hedge wizard who has converted to the Order: use the tradition's creation rules up to the Oath, then continue as a Hermetic magus, with limits on learning the Hermetic Arts and social consequences of the conversion.
quotes: Once the character has sworn the Oath of Hermes he gains the free Social Status Virtue Hermetic Magus

related.text: Houses of Hermes: Societates, House Ex Miscellanea

entries.title: UnGifted Hedge Wizards and the Order
entries.requires: unGifted hedge wizard seeking membership in the Order
entries.summary: Explains why membership is normally restricted to Gifted characters, the rare exceptions, and what an unGifted member could never do; includes the sample spell The Numbness of The Gift for sensing the Gift.
quotes: Membership in the Order of Hermes is restricted to characters with The Gift.

entries.title: Identifying The Gift
entries.summary: How Hermetic Intellego Vim effects detect the Gift and hedge Arts or Supernatural Abilities, giving the effective residual magnitude of such a target.
quotes: an effective residual magnitude of his highest Art / 5
effective residual magnitude equal to his highest Supernatural Ability Score

entries.title: Hedge wizards and Certamen
entries.requires: Hedge wizard facing a certamen challenge
entries.summary: Hedge wizards cannot take part in certamen unless their Hermetic Arts are Opened; a hedge wizard who accepts a challenge simply loses, which makes converts targets for bullying.
quotes: he cannot cause his phantasm to manifest

entries.title: Allies to the Order (hedge allies of covenants)
entries.requires: Covenant or magus allied with a hedge tradition
entries.summary: How to represent hedge-tradition allies of a covenant or a single magus with Covenant Boons and Virtues such as Social Contacts and Personal Vis Source.
quotes: Minor Virtue Social Contacts (ArM5, page 49)

entries.title: Hedge Wizards and the Aegis of the Hearth
entries.requires: Hedge wizard meeting an Aegis of the Hearth
entries.summary: How a hedge wizard's magic interacts with an Aegis of the Hearth: casting towards it must Penetrate, casting inside it suffers a penalty, and tokens or participation grant immunity.
quotes: half the level of the Aegis is subtracted from his Casting Total

related.text: ArM5 p.161 Aegis of the Hearth

entries.title: Folk Dancer (Communal Dance Magic)
entries.summary: A vestigial communal magical tradition in which a troupe of folk dancers performs a long dance, each passing a Dexterity + Carouse roll, to create a minor magical effect; troupes know only a few fixed dances negotiated at character creation.
quotes: A troupe of a dozen or more folk dancers, who all make Dexterity + Carouse rolls of 9+ can perform a dance

entries.title: Leadworker (Katadesmoi and Penetration Bonuses)
entries.requires: Virtue: Leadworker (Minor, Hermetic); House Tremere tradition
entries.summary: Explains the leadworker's curse tablets and figurines and gives Penetration bonus table additions for a katadesmos tablet, a kolossos, and a kolossos containing a sympathetic connection, plus a free fixed Arcane Connection created from body material.
quotes: Katadesmos tablet, inscribed with the name of a victim (+2)
A Kolossos constructed with a sympathetic connection from the body of the victim imbedded in it (+3)

gated.title: Ex Miscellanea traditions
gated.intro: The traditions within House Ex Miscellanea.

entries.title: Ex Miscellanea Traditions
entries.summary: Introduces three simple Ex Miscellanea magical traditions that can be chosen for a maga, noting others are in Houses of Hermes: Societates.
quotes: House Ex Miscellanea is not at all unified, consisting of many different magical traditions.

entries.title: Beast Masters
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea: Beast Masters tradition
entries.summary: A tradition of summoning and controlling wild creatures; members get Animal Ken and a Minor Magical Focus with a group of animals, the Incompatible Arts Flaw, and a Virtue and Flaw balance of their own.
quotes: They must take at least one more Flaw to balance their Virtues, and then have only 8 points of Flaws available to them to buy another 8 points of Virtues.

entries.title: Summon Animals
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea: Beast Masters tradition
entries.summary: A Supernatural Ability to summon mundane animals by an audible call; the Ability score sets the number and size of animals arriving, and a Communication + Summon Animals roll sets arrival time.
quotes: He must then make a Communication + Summon Animals roll against an Ease Factor of 9.

entries.title: The Nemthengacha
entries.summary: Background of the Nemthengacha, an Ex Miscellanea tradition of Celtic and Scandinavian sorcerers who create animosity and dissent in listeners.
quotes: The Nemthengacha (singular: Nemthenga) are a sect of Ex Miscellanea magi who have the ability to create animosity and dissent in their listeners.

entries.title: Nemthengacha Powers
entries.summary: A Nemthenga receives Embitterment as a free Major Non-Hermetic Virtue, Deficient Technique Rego as a compulsory Major Flaw, and Subtle Magic as a free Minor Hermetic Virtue.
quotes: Each has the Major Hermetic Flaw: Deficient Technique Rego.

entries.title: Embitterment
entries.summary: A Major Supernatural Ability that turns a listener against a chosen target by conversation, with an Ease Factor by relationship and increases for hatred, loathing and longer duration; it can be cancelled by Vim, Mentem effects.
quotes: EMBITTERMENT ROLL: Communication + Embitterment + Stress Die
Increasing this animosity to hatred adds +3 to the Ease Factor.
consider the effective level of the embitterment to be equal to the Nemthenga's score in Embitterment times five

entries.title: Tempestaria (Weather Witch)
entries.summary: A Saxon weather-witch tradition using simple sympathetic tools, with Whistle Up The Wind as its Major Non-Hermetic Virtue, Affinity with Auram, and a Necessary Condition Flaw.
quotes: Major Hermetic Flaw: Necessary Condition (tools for their magic to work)

entries.title: Whistle Up The Wind
entries.summary: A Supernatural Ability to create a wind of a chosen strength by whistling, with an Ease Factor table by strength, changeable with Communication + Music rolls, diminishing each sunset.
quotes: makes a Stamina + Whistle Up The Wind roll, against the Ease Factor listed in the table below

entries.title: House Ex Miscellanea: Compulsory Tradition Virtues and Flaws
entries.summary: Every magus Ex Miscellanea gets a compulsory Major non-Hermetic Virtue, Major Hermetic Flaw and Minor Hermetic Virtue for his tradition, in addition to the normal allocation; this section explains what each represents and which Virtues and Flaws are typical.
quotes: All members of this House have their particular tradition represented by a Major non-Hermetic Virtue, a Major Hermetic Flaw, and a Minor Hermetic Virtue (ArM5, page 30).
Note that Hermetic Virtues and Flaws, including the ones gained by being a member of House Ex Miscellanea, affect only the exercise of Hermetic magic, not non-Hermetic powers.

entries.title: Control Fertility (Supernatural Ability)
entries.summary: An example Supernatural Ability that enhances or withdraws fertility in plants, animals and people; the Ability score sets the possible effects and a Presence roll sets how long they last.
quotes: She must then make a Presence + Fertility roll against an Ease Factor of 9 to affect the target with the chosen power for a month

entries.title: Magi Ex Miscellanea Without a Major Supernatural Ability
entries.summary: Allows the compulsory Major non-Hermetic Virtue of a magus Ex Miscellanea to be something other than a Supernatural Ability, and sets limits on designing such Virtues.
quotes: New Supernatural Virtues that are not controlled by an Ability score should be designed following the rules for effects instilled into items, complete with uses per day, and should not exceed seventh magnitude.

entries.title: Magi Ex Miscellanea (Favored Ability)
entries.summary: Says that a House-Virtue Supernatural Ability counts as the magus's Favored Ability, so no Source Quality penalty from his Art scores applies when learning it after Hermetic training.
quotes: If a Supernatural Ability is acquired as part of the apprenticeship of a magus Ex Miscellanea (that is, as his House Virtue), then this Ability should be considered to be his Favored Ability

entries.title: Mythic Companions (Non-Hermetic Magicians)
entries.summary: Describes Mythic Companions as non-Gifted characters who can fill the role of non-Hermetic magicians, with a Special Virtue that replaces The Gift and a Virtue point allowance based on Flaws taken.
quotes: Instead, a Mythic Companion has a Special Virtue akin to The Gift, which grants a Minor Virtue at no cost, and then two Virtue points for every point of Flaw he takes.

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages p.104

entries.title: Magi Orbi
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea (exile from another House)
entries.summary: How to create a magus orbus, an exile from another House who joined House Ex Miscellanea, built with the former House's rules but without its privileges and Mystery Cults, and with an Orbus Reputation.
quotes: A magus orbus has a Hermetic Reputation as an Orbus at a score of 2, and probably avoids his former colleagues.

related.text: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults pp.52, 73
Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal pp.62-64

entries.title: Gifted Companions
entries.summary: Step-by-step method for creating a Gifted hedge wizard who keeps a native tradition instead of Hermetic magic: take The Gift and Hermetic Magus status, build as a Companion with Arcane Abilities, and gain a Hedge Wizard Reputation.
quotes: Take The Gift and Hermetic Magus Social Status Virtues.
Gain the Reputation Hedge Wizard 2 (Hermetic)

entries.title: Damhadh-Duidsan (Ex Miscellanea Tradition)
entries.summary: Overview of the Ogam rune tradition that curses enemies and steals their life, with its compulsory Virtue and Flaw package.
quotes: Major Non-Hermetic Virtue: Shapechanging, Giant Blood, or Incantation

entries.title: Hermetic Haruspexes (Ex Miscellanea Tradition)
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea; Hermetic Haruspexes tradition
entries.summary: Overview of the Roman tradition of divination by inspecting the entrails of sacrificed animals, with its compulsory Virtue and Flaw package and its susceptibility to Twilight.
quotes: Major Non-Hermetic Virtue: Divination and Augury

entries.title: Karaites (Ex Miscellanea Tradition)
entries.summary: Overview of the Karaite Jewish tradition of holy magic, which may join the Order only if it practises holy magic, with its compulsory Virtue and Flaw package.
quotes: Major Non-Hermetic Virtue: Holy Magic

entries.title: Malocchi (Ex Miscellanea Tradition)
entries.summary: Overview of the Italian tradition of Entrancement through the gaze, with its compulsory Virtue and Flaw package and a required extra Virtue.
quotes: As well as his free Virtues and Flaws, a maloccho must also take Piercing Gaze as a compulsory Virtue.

entries.title: Scinnfolk (Gifted Companions Tradition)
entries.summary: Overview of the cunning-folk tradition of Gifted Companions who keep natural and faerie charms instead of Hermetic magic, with its Virtue and common Virtue and Flaw choices.
quotes: Major Non-Hermetic Virtue: Fertility (free with The Gift)

entries.title: Witches of Thessaly (Ex Miscellanea Tradition)
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea; Witches of Thessaly tradition
entries.summary: Overview of the Thessalian tradition of sorcery, necromancy and curses, with its compulsory Virtue and Flaw package and a note on its suspicion of diabolism.
quotes: Major Non-Hermetic Virtue: Summoning

entries.title: Warding (Columbae)
entries.summary: The Columbae's Accelerated Ability for drawing chalk circles that ward away a subset of one Form. The Warding Total acts as a Casting Total for natural targets and as Penetration against beings with Might, but is useless against Magic Resistance without Might.
quotes: Warding Total: stress die + Stamina + Warding + aura
a ward against objects made of wood requires a Warding Total of at least 30

related.text: ArM5 p.114 Ring Duration / Circle Target

entries.title: Banishing (Donatores)
entries.summary: A Supernatural Accelerated Ability that expels creatures of one realm from a designated area for a Sun duration, with an Ease Factor depending on area size and a re-entry roll for the banished creature that reduces its Might. Includes a worked example.
quotes: Banishing Total: stress die + Presence + Banishing + aura
the default Ease Factor is Near Range, which is defined as the area within 10 paces of the character
Stamina + (Realm) Lore roll against an Ease Factor of 12

related.text: ArM5 p.148 Weight of a Thousand Hells
RoP: The Infernal p.34 True Names

entries.title: The Path of Orpheus
entries.summary: Describes a rumored great ritual that follows Orpheus into the Underworld to restore a dead loved one to life, modelled on the rituals of Fenicil. Gives its parameters, requirements and the limits and risks of its success.
quotes: with an Ease Factor of 78, Range Adelphixis, Duration Momentary, and Target Individual

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages p.76 (Fenicil)

entries.title: Mythic Herbalism Ease Factor Table
entries.summary: Table of Ease Factors for the healing effects, poisons and physical-bonus potions that a Mythic Herbalism user can brew.

entries.title: Mythic Herbalism
entries.summary: A Supernatural Ability for brewing healing poultices, poisons and potions of physical bonuses: preparation time scales with the Ease Factor, extra doses raise the Ease Factor, and an Intelligence + Mythic Herbalism roll decides success. Describes expiry, duration and stacking limits.
quotes: a number of days equal to one-third the Ease Factor of the intended effect
the Ease Factor is increased by one for each additional dose
roll the character's Intelligence + Mythic Herbalism against the target Ease Factor

entries.title: Opening the Arts of a Hedge Wizard
entries.summary: Summary of the rules for opening the Arts of a character with Supernatural Abilities: compare an Intellego Vim Lab Total to a level based on the Supernatural Ability scores, and the margin decides whether the Abilities are lost or converted into Hermetic Virtues.
quotes: Level Required for Opening the Arts: 5 x (the sum of all Supernatural Ability scores)
Minimum Level per Ability: 10 if the Ability derives from a Minor Virtue, or 30 if it derives from a Major Virtue

entries.title: New Spell Guideline: Rego Vim
entries.summary: A Rego Vim guideline for sustaining or suppressing spells of a specific type cast by another, limited by the level of the Vim spell.
quotes: Sustain or suppress a spell or spells of a specific type cast by another with level less than or equal to the level + 2 magnitudes of the Vim spell

entries.title: Induction of Hedge Wizards into the Order
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea: Lineage of Pralix (inducting maga)
entries.summary: Procedure for bringing a Gifted hedge wizard into the Order: a short apprenticeship in Hermetic basics, an attempt to open the Arts that may destroy non-Hermetic powers, a season teaching the Parma Magica, then the Oath. Explains the Flaws and Gifted Companion status that can result.
quotes: typically lasting less than five years
The Pralician maga need not have all Arts above 5 for this process

entries.title: Joint Training of Apprentices
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea: Lineage of Pralix
entries.summary: Describes the arrangement in which a Pralician teaches Hermetic magic to a hedge wizard's apprentice in exchange for laboratory assistance, producing an apprentice trained in both traditions.
quotes: for every season the Pralican spends teaching Hermetic magic to her colleague's apprentice, she gets two seasons of the apprentice's assistance in the laboratory

entries.title: Comprehend Magic (Ability)
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability for analysing the magic in an object, person, aura or vis. A Comprehension Total is compared to an Ease Factor by source of magic, with more rounds of study revealing more, and the insight boosts the user's spells and lab work against the studied target.
quotes: Comprehension Total: Perception + Comprehend Magic + stress die
The observer may add twice his Comprehend Magic score to the Casting Total of any spontaneous Muto, Perdo, or Rego Vim spell used against the object or creature studied

entries.title: Pralicians and Scrying
entries.summary: Explains how using Comprehend Magic on another magus counts as scrying under the Code of Hermes, and when a Tribunal is likely to convict.
quotes: Using Comprehend Magic against another magus is scrying, and forbidden by the Code of Hermes

entries.title: Craft Magic (Rusticani)
entries.summary: Lets a character craft an object in place of casting an effect, with shape and material bonuses capped by his Craft score, and also to make charged items and lesser enchantments of vis-containing objects without spending a season. Four applications, each with its own time and level rules and worked examples.
quotes: though this bonus cannot exceed his Craft score
Use the character's Casting Total or the result of the Supernatural Ability roll as if it were a Lab Total to determine the effect's level and the number of charges
the level of the invested effect cannot exceed five times the number of pawns of vis in the object

related.text: RoP: The Divine pp.137-138 Craft Amulets

entries.title: Design and Inscription Bonuses
entries.summary: Enchantment bonuses from portraits, writing, seals or symbols and images that Craft Magic users can add to crafted effects and some lab work, in addition to shape and material bonuses.
quotes: Note that the total bonus gained from shape, material, design, and inscription is still limited to the magus's Magic Theory score (or an applicable Craft score)

entries.title: The Jinn
entries.summary: Describes jinn as spirits of place with a spiritual and a material form, the three kinds of jinn by realm, their typical Might, and their regeneration and Virtues.
quotes: typically Mights range from 5–40

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine ch.5 Mythic Islam

entries.title: Sihr (Summoning and Bargaining with Jinn)
entries.summary: A Supernatural Accelerated Ability for summoning a jinni and bargaining it into service. Covers discerning a jinni's Might, the vis cost and Summoning Total, extra summoning time, the Bargain Total against an Ease Factor, botches, and how many jinn may be kept in service.
quotes: Summoning Total: Presence + Sihr + Aura + stress die
Bargain Total: Communication + Bargain + Summoning Strength + stress die
Ease Factor: 18 + Bargain Modifiers

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine ch.5 Mythic Islam

entries.title: Bargain Modifiers (Sahirs)
entries.summary: Table of modifiers to the Ease Factor of a sahir's bargain with a jinni, depending on the scope of the terms, length of service, any duty accepted and vis spent above or below the standard cost.

entries.title: Typical Duties for Sahirs
entries.summary: Examples of simple and onerous duties a sahir may accept to modify a bargain with a jinni.

entries.title: Siren Song (Seirenes)
entries.summary: A Major Virtue letting the character command those who hear her music, resolved as a Communication + Music roll against the target's Stamina roll with a bonus table by command severity. Limits help from other musicians and explains how it combines with Enchanting Music.
quotes: A successful roll of Communication + Music versus the target's Stamina roll allows the character to issue a command to any individual or group who hears the music
No more than two musicians' scores can assist the singer in performing a song

entries.title: Elementalist Characters (Arts, vis use and study)
entries.summary: Elementalist magic uses four Techniques and four Forms that work only in combination and come in Medicinal, Philosophical and Theurgical types; it also covers how elementalists add vis to totals and study their Arts from vis or books.
quotes: receiving a +2 bonus for each pawn of vis that corresponds to the Elementalist Form used in the formula
spend a number of pawns of vis associated with that Form equal to (their score in the Technique / 2), rounded up

related.text: Hedge Magic: Acquiring Hedge Wizard Powers

entries.title: Elemental Affinities & Character Creation
entries.requires: Tradition: Elementalists (Elemental Magic, Medicine, Philosophiae or Theurgy)
entries.summary: Optional character creation method that approximates these Virtues' free experience by treating them as an Affinity with the related Forms.
quotes: an optional method is to treat the Virtue as an Affinity with the related Forms

entries.title: Other Summoning Arts
entries.requires: Elementalist who also has infernal Summoning
entries.summary: Distinguishes elementalist (Elemental) Summoning from infernal (Spirit) Summoning, and which of Controlling and Commanding works on elementals, spirits or both.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal pp.87, 114-115

entries.title: Elemental Warping
entries.summary: Elementalists gain elemental Personality Traits instead of Virtues and Flaws from Warping; the Traits add to Soak against the matching element, subtract from Recovery against matching humoral illness, and become Personality Flaws or madness as they rise.
quotes: divide the Form by 5 (rounded up), and add this result to the value of the corresponding Trait
You must subtract the value of the Trait from the character's Recovery rolls whenever he is suffering from an illness of the corresponding humor.
Treat Traits of +6 or more as Major Personality Flaws

entries.title: Elemental Traits
entries.summary: Describes the four elemental Personality Traits (Choleric, Melancholic, Phlegmatic, Sanguine), the Form and opposed Trait for each, and notes that opposed Traits never cancel out.
quotes: The effects of these Traits on the character's personality never cancel each other out

entries.title: Elementalist Forms
entries.summary: Introduces the four Elementalist Forms and what they can affect depending on the paired Technique type.

entries.title: Elementalist Air
entries.summary: A Difficult Art; defines what Medicinal, Philosophical and Theurgical elementalists can affect with air and gives a Soak bonus from the Sanguine Trait against air damage.
quotes: The character adds his Sanguine Trait to his Soak whenever he is damaged by the element of air

entries.title: Elementalist Earth
entries.summary: A Difficult Art; defines what elementalists can affect with earth and gives a Soak bonus from the Melancholy Trait against earth damage.
quotes: The character adds his Melancholy Trait to his Soak whenever he is damaged by the element of earth

entries.title: Elementalist Fire
entries.summary: A Difficult Art; defines what elementalists can affect with fire and gives a Soak bonus from the Choleric Trait against fire damage.
quotes: The character adds his Choleric Trait to his Soak whenever he is damaged by the element of fire

entries.title: Elementalist Water
entries.summary: A Difficult Art; defines what elementalists can affect with water and gives a Soak bonus from the Phlegmatic Trait against water damage.
quotes: The character adds his Phlegmatic trait to his Soak when he is damaged by the element of water

entries.title: Elementalist Techniques
entries.summary: Introduces the four Elementalist Techniques, each tied to a Characteristic, combined with a Form and applied to a Medicinal, Philosophical or Theurgical target.

entries.title: Elementalist Summoning
entries.summary: The Summoning roll draws elements or targets to the elementalist at the cost of a long-term Fatigue level; the Total is looked up on a Size/Might chart, multiple Forms use the lowest score, summoning containers hold targets and ease later effects, and botches lose control.
quotes: SUMMONING TOTAL: stress die + Stamina + Summoning + (Form) + aura
This procedure always costs the elementalist a long-term Fatigue level

entries.title: Summoning (Medicinal)
entries.summary: An elemental physician touches a target to cure or cause disease by shifting its humors, with the Summoning Total giving the strength of the disease in terms of wound and illness severity.
quotes: one magnitude more affects a disease equivalent to a Medium wound or a serious illness

entries.title: Summoning (Philosophical)
entries.summary: An elemental philosopher conjures raw natural phenomena or base matter, or native animals of a fitting temperament, within the Size and Might limits set by the Summoning Total.
quotes: of an amount no more than the Size indicated by the Summoning Total on the chart earlier

entries.title: Summoning (Theurgical)
entries.summary: An elemental theurgist brings an elemental into being from raw base material, with the Summoning Total setting its maximum Might; the elemental is permanent but cannot recover Might except by consuming vis.
quotes: Elementals are permanently summoned, but do not recover their Might Points over time unless they consume vis

entries.title: Summoning Elementals
entries.summary: Summoned elementals are temporary, revert to base material when their Might Pool is empty, regain Might by eating vis (preferring the opposed Form), and are wild and dangerous unless contained.
quotes: each pawn an elemental consumes returns 5 points of Might to it

entries.title: Elementalist Controlling
entries.summary: Controlling lets an elementalist dictate the behavior of summoned or encountered targets; it costs an ordinary Fatigue level, takes a round, must penetrate Magic Resistance, and is much easier against a bound target.
quotes: CONTROLLING TOTAL: stress die + Presence + Controlling + (Form) + aura

entries.title: Controlling (Medicinal)
entries.summary: An elemental physician inspires or suppresses emotions as a temporary Personality Trait scaled to the Controlling Total, and can command supernatural creatures lodged in a human body.
quotes: roughly equivalent to a Personality Trait with a positive or negative value of (Controlling Total / 10), rounded up

entries.title: Controlling (Philosophical)
entries.summary: An elemental philosopher can boost his Soak against a material of the matching element and give commands to animals of the matching temperament.
quotes: He may add his (Controlling Total / 5) to his Soak against the target material for as long as he maintains concentration

entries.title: Controlling (Theurgical)
entries.summary: An elemental theurgist who equals or exceeds a being's Might can force it to carry out a single command, or banish an elemental permanently.
quotes: assuming he can equal or exceed the being's Might on his Controlling roll

entries.title: Elementalist Divining
entries.summary: Divining costs no Fatigue and either senses an appropriate target nearby (Size only) or, by touch, communes with it (Size and Might, and penetration); it can also locate vis of an element and uses the lower Form when several are combined.
quotes: Divining Total: stress die + Perception + Divining + (Form) + aura

entries.title: Divining (Medicinal)
entries.summary: An elemental physician diagnoses humoral imbalance and, by tending a patient through recovery, adds a fraction of the Divining Total as magical aid to the patient's recovery roll.
quotes: treat his (Divining Total / 5) as magical aid for the purposes of the target's recovery roll

entries.title: Divining (Philosophical)
entries.summary: An elemental philosopher senses natural materials of an element and animals of the matching temperament, including understanding an animal's thoughts by touch.

entries.title: Divining (Theurgical)
entries.summary: An elemental theurgist senses beings with Might of the element in the region and can converse with them or perceive their past by touch.

entries.title: Elementalist Refining
entries.summary: A season-long laboratory-like activity that purifies or breaks down a target, often yielding raw vis; it also lets an elementalist brew a longevity potion costing vis scaled to his age.
quotes: REFINING TOTAL: Intelligence + (associated Ability) + Refining + (Form) + aura
The potion gives him a bonus to his Aging rolls equal to his (Refining Total /5)
costs a number of pawns of vis equal to his (age /5), rounded up

entries.title: Refining (Medicinal)
entries.summary: An elemental physician can make longevity potions for others and a year-long vigor potion that boosts a Characteristic chosen by Element, capped by his lowest Form; a table lists the Characteristics per element.
quotes: This boosts one of the target's Characteristics (as shown below) by the elementalist's (Refining Total / 5)

entries.title: Refining (Philosophical)
entries.summary: An elemental philosopher extracts vis from an aura, drains or boosts the Might of supernatural animals for vis, and moves vis between objects, losing half if the Form must be changed.
quotes: producing his (Refining Total / 10) in vis associated with the appropriate one of the four elements
his Refining Total for the season must equal or exceed (the total number of pawns of vis moved x 5)

entries.title: Refining (Theurgical)
entries.summary: An elemental theurgist restores Might to, or drains it from, an elemental or supernatural being depending on whether the Form matches, opposes or is unrelated to its own, producing vis from surplus or lost Might.
quotes: this is the number of Might Points restored to it

entries.title: Elementalist Societies (and Opening the Gift)
entries.summary: Societies teach particular Techniques and Forms; a Gifted member opens a Gifted student's Gift using a specific Opening Total, and the society's Arts indicate what unGifted initiates can be taught.
quotes: OPENING TOTAL: Intelligence + highest Technique + lowest Form + aura

entries.title: Apostles of Apollonius
entries.summary: An elementalist society that favors (Theurgical) Summoning, (Theurgical) Controlling and all four Elementalist Forms, with history and notes on its distribution in 1220.

entries.title: Ikhwan as-Safa' (Brethren of Purity)
entries.summary: An elementalist society whose Arts are Philosophical Summoning, Philosophical Refining and all four Elementalist Forms.

entries.title: Teaching of the Brethren of Purity (grades)
entries.summary: The Brethren advance through four grades with minimum Ability scores; Gifted members learn the society's Arts directly while unGifted members must be initiated.

entries.title: Bload Oath of Becoming a Member of Ikhwan as-Safa'
entries.summary: Initiation Script that grants the Major Virtue Philosophical Refining with the Major Flaw Weak Elementalist Resistance, after a quest, a tractatus and a season of study.
quotes: Initiation Ease Factor: 21
Script Bonus: +18 (+3 Quest, +9 Major Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sacrifice, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Ritual of Uncovering the Elemental Nature of Man
entries.summary: Initiation Script that grants a score of 1 in an Elementalist Form (chosen by the Initiate's temperament) plus the Minor Flaw Mentor.
quotes: Initiation Ease Factor: 15
Script Bonus: +12 (+3 Quest, +3 Minor Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus, +1 Sacrifice)

entries.title: Ritual of Making the Soul Actually Knowledgeable
entries.summary: Initiation Script that grants the Major Virtue Elemental Philosophiae and the Major Flaw Study Requirement after the supplicant writes a summa.
quotes: Initiation Ease Factor: 21
Script Bonus: +18 (+3 Quest, +9 Major Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sacrifice, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Ikhwan as-Safa' Characters
entries.summary: Character generation notes for Brethren: yearly experience points for Arcane and Academic Abilities, typical Abilities, Virtues and Flaws.
quotes: they receive 30 experience points to spend on Arcane and Academic Abilities

related.text: Learned Magicians: Mythic Alchemy, Mythic Herbalism

entries.title: Tulab Ibn Sina
entries.summary: An elementalist society of Islamic physicians whose Arts are Medicinal Summoning, Medicinal Divining and all four Elementalist Forms.

entries.title: Teachings of Ibn Sina (access to Arts)
entries.summary: Who the Tulab accept as students; Gifted members learn Medicinal Summoning, Medicinal Divining and the Forms, while unGifted members gain Arts only through Initiation.
quotes: Gifted members of this tradition learn Medicinal Summoning, Medicinal Divining, and all the Elementalist Forms.

entries.title: Rite of Testing the Physician's Dedication
entries.summary: Initiation Script granting a score of 1 in Medicinal Divining and the Major Flaw Restriction after a year of aiding disaster victims.
quotes: Initiation Ease Factor: 21
Script Bonus: +18 (+3 Quest, +9 Major Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +2 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Ritual of Discovering the Physician's Humor
entries.summary: Initiation Script in which the supplicant recovers from a Medium Wound as a pauper, then gains a score of 1 in an Elementalist Form matching his humor and the Minor Flaw Vow.
quotes: Initiation Ease Factor: 15
Script Bonus: +11 (+3 Quest, +3 Minor Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Ritual of Improving the Physician's Character
entries.summary: Initiation Script granting the Major Virtue Elemental Medicine and the Major Flaw Study Requirement after a year of free healing for the poor.
quotes: Initiation Ease Factor: 21
Script Bonus: +18 (+3 Quest, +9 Major Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus, +1 Sacrifice)

entries.title: Rite of Opening the Mind
entries.summary: Initiation Script involving a season of fasting and prayer at Ibn Sina's tomb, with a Stamina roll, granting a score of 1 in Premonitions with the Flaw Visions.
quotes: Initiation Ease Factor: 15
Script Bonus: +12 (+3 Quest, +3 Minor Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +2 Sympathetic Bonus)
the player makes a Stamina roll against an Ease Factor of 9

entries.title: Tulab Ibn Sina Characters
entries.summary: Character generation notes for Tulab members: a short intense training period with set experience points, favored Abilities, typical Virtues and Flaws, and the Educated Virtue's allocation for Islamic lands.
quotes: In a five-year period, the student gains 150 experience points to spend on Academic and Arcane Abilities.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine pp.101, 114

entries.title: Creating a Folk Witch Character
entries.summary: Folk witches may be Gifted or unGifted (companion or grog), need at least one Flaw limiting their magic and the free Folk Witch Status, spend a ten-year apprenticeship with a special experience allotment, and can do limited laboratory work during creation.
quotes: you may spend 200 experience points for the character on any Abilities
which gives her seven favored Supernatural Abilities
Each season spent on laboratory activities reduce the number of experience points received for that year by 10

entries.title: Folk Witch minimum Ability Scores
entries.summary: Minimum Ability scores expected of a Gifted folk witch after apprenticeship, and the language scores needed for a literate or writing witch.
quotes: she must have a score of at least 4 in a Language (which does not need to be Latin), and a score of at least 1 in Artes Liberales

entries.title: Folk Witch (Social Status)
entries.summary: The free Social Status that grants folk witch laboratory activities, casting methods and magical defenses, coven membership and sabbat attendance, and requires two seasons a year of self-support.
quotes: she must spend two seasons each year supporting herself

entries.title: Folk Witch Magic
entries.summary: Folk witches use seven favored Supernatural Abilities, advanced on the standard Ability table, accessed by potions, incantations or fetish objects, with limited Magical Defenses but no Magic Resistance.
quotes: folk witches use the standard Ability experience advancement table when improving these Abilities

entries.title: Folk Witch Powers (casting formulas)
entries.summary: A folk witch's Casting Score is a Characteristic plus Ability plus aura, plus a stress die for the Total, compared to the effect's Ease Factor; Gifted witches can add vis, and Penetration follows from the Total.
quotes: FOLK WITCH CASTING SCORE: Characteristic + Ability + Aura Modifier
MAGNITUDE OF EFFECT: Ability
EQUIVALENT SPELL LEVEL: (5 x Ability)
PENETRATION TOTAL: Casting Total + Penetration Bonus — Ease Factor
MAXIMUM VIS EXPENDITURE: Ability + Effect Vis Cost

entries.title: Folk Witch Casting Methods
entries.summary: Each Ability must be used by Potion, Incantation (a rhyme the target hears) or Fetish (a prepared item), with rules for losing the incantation from memory and for spare fetishes.
quotes: make an Intelligence + Concentration roll against an Ease Factor of 6 for her every day after the memory-altering effect ceases

entries.title: Folk Witch Botches
entries.summary: A botch makes the effect happen uncontrolled and gives the witch Warping Points.
quotes: She also gains 1 Warping Point for every 0 on the botch dice

entries.title: Folk Witch Mark
entries.summary: Each witch's effects carry a personal mark that others can recognize with a Perception and Organization Lore roll; identifying merely that a witch cast it is easier.
quotes: make a Perception + Organization Lore: Folk Witch roll against an Ease Factor of 9
a successful Perception + Organization Lore: Folk Witch roll against an Ease Factor of 6 identifies an effect as one cast by a Folk Witch

entries.title: Folk Witch Ability: Animal Ken
entries.summary: Folk witch Animal Ken uses Communication and the Animal Form, delivered by incantation or potion.
quotes: Characteristic: Communication

entries.title: Folk Witch Ability: Cursing (and the curses)
entries.summary: A witch curses a target via a woven fetish or potion, using Dexterity and a Form that depends on the curse; each curse type (disease, miscarriage, aging, emotion, tongue, paralysis, beast, reduction) has its own Ease Factor and effect, and the curse must penetrate the target's Magic Resistance throughout the preparation season.
quotes: Preparing the curse is a laboratory activity that takes the folk witch an entire season
use the highest Magic Resistance the target has during the season

entries.title: Folk Witch Ability: Dowsing
entries.summary: Folk witch Dowsing uses Perception, a Form that depends on the target, and a fetish or potion; it lets witches find vis.
quotes: This ability is important for folk witches as it allows them to find vis.

entries.title: Folk Witch Ability: Flight
entries.summary: A witch can fly using Stamina and Auram, at the cost of a long-term Fatigue level when using a fetish; it describes speed, duration, maneuver rolls and a combat bonus against non-flying opponents.
quotes: The Ease Factor to take to the air is 9.
her Flight Ability score is added to both her Attack and Defense Totals

entries.title: Folk Witch Ability: Healing
entries.summary: True healing of wounds and Fatigue that breaks the Limit of Energy; it costs Corpus vis according to a table of Ease Factors by wound or fatigue level, and must penetrate the target's Magic Resistance.
quotes: the folk witch must spend a number of pawns of Corpus vis depending on the wound type (indicated below)

entries.title: Folk Witch Ability: Second Sight
entries.summary: Folk witch Second Sight uses Perception and the Vim Form, delivered by incantation or potion.
quotes: Form: Vim

entries.title: Folk Witch Ability: Shapeshifter
entries.summary: Folk witch Shapeshifter uses Stamina and the Animal Form, delivered by fetish (made from the animal's skin) or potion.
quotes: The fetish is made from the skin of the animal form.

entries.title: Folk Witch Magical Defenses
entries.summary: Lists which Magical Defense each folk witch power grants (for example Healing gives Magical Fortitude against Corpus effects); an unGifted witch only gets defenses for powers she has.
quotes: Defense: Strength of Form. Defense against Animal or Corpus effects.

entries.title: Witch's Kitchen
entries.summary: A folk witch's kitchen works like a laboratory, with a Lab Total built from a Supernatural Ability, Intelligence, Folk Witch Magic Theory and aura; unGifted witches may do tasks only if they hold the matching Virtues.
quotes: Lab Total: (Supernatural Ability) + Intelligence + Folk Witch Magic Theory + Aura Modifier

entries.title: Folk Witch Magic Theory
entries.summary: An Arcane Ability analogous to Magic Theory, covering the technical details of folk witch magic and used in kitchen laboratory activities; any character can be taught it.
quotes: Any character can be taught this Ability.

entries.title: Building the Kitchen
entries.summary: Setting up a witch's kitchen or converting a Hermetic laboratory takes set seasons and minimum Theory scores; Covenants laboratory rules can be used with a size-scale adjustment.
quotes: SETTING UP A KITCHEN: 2 Seasons and a minimum Folk Witch Magic Theory score of 3
add 3 to the Laboratory Size Scale

entries.title: Help in the Kitchen
entries.summary: Folk witches work alone except for their familiar and for mutual aid at a sabbat.

entries.title: Experimenting (folk witches)
entries.summary: Folk witches experiment as Hermetic magi do, gaining a Lab Total bonus and rolling on the Extraordinary Results table, often to overcome Divine aura penalties.
quotes: EXPERIMENTAL BONUS TO LAB TOTAL: Simple die + Risk Modifier

entries.title: Folk Witch Lab Texts
entries.summary: Only literate witches can write or use Lab Texts, which follow the Hermetic copying and writing rules but are not useful to magi and vice versa.

entries.title: Folk Witch Vis (extraction, transfer, use)
entries.summary: Witches find vis by Dowsing, extract Vim vis from the aura each season based on their Lab Total, move vis between forms in a day, and may use only a limited amount in laboratory projects.
quotes: extract a number of pawns of Vim vis from the local aura equal to a tenth of her Lab Total (round up)
can only use up to twice her Folk Witch Magic Theory Ability score in pawns of vis on laboratory projects

entries.title: Fixing Arcane Connections
entries.summary: In a season a witch can lengthen an Arcane Connection's lifetime by one step, using her Lab Total and a pawn of Vim vis.
quotes: costs 1 pawn of Vim vis

entries.title: Folk Witch Study
entries.summary: Studying in the kitchen gives no bonus, and learning Supernatural Abilities remains difficult or impossible for unGifted witches without an existing score.

entries.title: Curse Fetish Weaving
entries.summary: Weaving a curse fetish occupies a season in a kitchen, needs an active Arcane Connection to the target, and some curses take effect at once while others last until the fabric is destroyed or the connection expires.
quotes: creating a single fabric (which targets an Individual) both occupies the character for an entire season, and requires a kitchen

entries.title: Dowsing Rod Binding
entries.summary: Enchanting a dowsing rod fetish takes a season and a pawn of Intellego vis, and it lasts indefinitely unless destroyed.
quotes: enchanting a dowsing rod takes 1 season and consumes 1 pawn of Intellego vis

entries.title: Flight Broom Preparation
entries.summary: Enchanting a flying aid fetish takes a season and a pawn of Auram vis, and it lasts indefinitely unless destroyed.
quotes: enchanting a flying aid takes 1 season and consumes 1 pawn of Auram vis

entries.title: Skin Knitting
entries.summary: Enchanting an animal-skin fetish takes a season and a pawn of Animal vis; a witch needs a separate fetish for each animal type she can take.
quotes: enchanting the fetish takes a season and consumes 1 pawn of Animal vis

entries.title: Potion Brewing
entries.summary: A season of brewing yields a batch of doses sharing a Brew Potency equal to the witch's Lab Total; a drinker's effective Casting Total is that Potency plus a stress die, with vis costs per dose and optional Lab Text bonus doses, with a worked example.
quotes: Brew Potency: Supernatural Ability Lab Total
POTION CASTING TOTAL: Brew Potency + stress die
Doses per Brew: Folk Witch Magic Theory (+ Lab Text Level)
Vis Cost: 1 per Dose + Effect Cost

entries.title: Potion Effects
entries.summary: What each Ability's potion does for the drinker: temporary Ability scores and durations derived from the Brew Potency, curse potions, healing potions and shapeshifting.
quotes: with an Ability score equal to the Brew Potency / 5 (round up)

entries.title: Enriching Things of Virtue
entries.summary: A folk witch may enrich Things of Virtue using the rules in Realms of Power: Magic.

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic, Things of Virtue

entries.title: Folk Witch Longevity Ritual
entries.summary: A witch can make a Longevity Ritual only for herself, using the Hermetic rules with her Healing Lab Total, so it is weaker than a magus's.
quotes: Use her Healing Ability Lab Total for this activity

entries.title: Investigating a Potion
entries.requires: Tradition: Folk Witches or magus familiar with folk witch magic
entries.summary: A witch identifies a potion's Potency and effect with an Intelligence and Theory roll; to a magus a potion is an effect whose detection depends on extra magnitudes of Intellego Vim.
quotes: POTION INVESTIGATION: Intelligence + Folk Witch Magic Theory + Stress Die vs Ease Factor of 9

entries.title: Folk Witch Familiars
entries.summary: A witch binds one animal as a familiar in a season of laboratory work by beating a Binding Total built from the familiar's Size and Might.
quotes: FOLK WITCH FAMILIAR BINDING TOTAL: 10 + Familiar's Size + Familiar's Magic Might

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic, Book of Mundane Beasts
Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults p.38

entries.title: Benefits of a Folk Witch Familiar
entries.summary: A familiar gains human Intelligence and languages, can assist in the kitchen for a Lab Total bonus, ages with its mistress, serves as an Arcane Connection both ways, and lets the witch dowse for it and see through its senses.
quotes: Familiar Bonus to Lab Total: Familiar's Intelligence + Familiar's Folk Witch Magic Theory

entries.title: Folk Witch Warping
entries.summary: Folk witches gain Warping Points as usual plus from botches, but not from Magic auras; each time the Warping Score rises she suffers the Witch Moon instead of Twilight.
quotes: She also gains Warping points when she botches using her Supernatural Abilities.

entries.title: The Witch Moon
entries.summary: The folk witch's equivalent of Wizard's Twilight: a month or more of lost Supernatural Abilities and a fever Medium Wound, with a monthly roll to end it and extra Warping Points on failure or botch.
quotes: TO END WITCH MOON: Stamina – Warping Score + stress die vs Ease Factor 6

entries.title: Effects of the Witch Moon
entries.summary: After recovering, the witch's experience is good or bad depending on whether the months taken exceeded her Warping Score, and the storyguide picks an effect from the matching list.
quotes: If the folk witch took more months to recover from the Witch Moon than her Warping score, then the experience is bad.

entries.title: Witch Moon: Good Experiences
entries.summary: Good Witch Moon outcomes: experience points in an existing Ability or Theory, a new Minor Virtue, or a new Supernatural Ability at score 1.
quotes: equal to 5 x number of months spent in the Witch Moon

entries.title: Witch Moon: Bad Experiences
entries.summary: Bad Witch Moon outcomes: lost experience in a Supernatural Ability or Theory per Warping Point gained, or a new Minor Flaw.
quotes: She loses 2 experience points in a Supernatural Ability or in Folk Witch Magic Theory for every Warping Point gained during the Witch Moon.

entries.title: Covens
entries.summary: A coven is the folk witch equivalent of a covenant: a small, dispersed group of witches, each living a day's travel apart, with its strengths and vulnerabilities.

entries.title: Folk Witch Opening the Gift
entries.summary: Opening a folk witch's Gift follows the general rules with a folk-witch Opening Total and grants seven favored Supernatural Abilities, which troupes can swap for others.
quotes: FOLK WITCH OPENING TOTAL: Int + Folk Witch Magic Theory + Sabbat Bonus

entries.title: Organization Lore: Folk Witches
entries.summary: The Ability covers folk witch effects, coven locations and reputations; its specialty is a home coven, with extra botch dice for covens farther away.
quotes: roll an additional botch die for every week's travel this coven is from the character's "home" coven

entries.title: Initiations for unGifted Folk Witches
entries.summary: unGifted witches are initiated by a Mystagogue who must know the power, with an Initiation Total using Presence and Theory; seven sample Scripts (Rhyme of the Beast, Venomous Darts, Sense of Place, Unbound by Land, Hands of Life, The Devil's Eye, Second Life) give the Supernatural Virtues and their ordeal Flaws.
quotes: FOLK WITCH INITIATION TOTAL: Mystagogue's Presence + Mystagogue's Folk Witch Magic Theory + Script Bonus + Sabbat Bonus
Script Bonus: +10 (+9 Major Ordeal, +1 Time)

entries.title: Precocious Girls
entries.summary: What a coven can do when it accidentally initiates a Gifted girl as if unGifted: find someone to Open her Gift properly or teach her Abilities without favored status.

entries.title: Sabbat
entries.summary: The coven meeting where witches trade vis and discuss threats; because witches lack Parma Magica the Gift's social effects often cause bickering, and a sabbat does not interrupt long-term tasks.

entries.title: Sabbat Politics
entries.summary: Four optional ways a sabbat can run (Easy, Bickering, Dictatorial, Feuding), depending on the Gifted makeup of the coven and the kind of stories wanted.

entries.title: Sabbat Magic
entries.summary: Witches cooperate at a sabbat to raise a brew's Potency, an Opening Total or an Initiation Total by a bonus per assistant limited by the site's Magic aura; each witch may take part in only one activity per sabbat.
quotes: POTENCY BONUS FOR SABBAT BREW: +1 each folk witch assisting main caster
MAXIMUM NUMBER OF ASSISTANTS: Magic Aura at sabbat site
TOTAL BONUS FOR SABBAT INITIATION: +1 each folk witch assisting Mystagogue

entries.title: Sabbat Times
entries.summary: A table of the traditional dates on which covens hold sabbats, grouped under the winter and summer solstices.

entries.title: Creating a Coven
entries.requires: Saga set in a folk witch coven
entries.summary: A coven can be built with the Customized Covenant Creation rules, either as the saga's focus or as an antagonist, following a few adjustments.

entries.title: Guidelines for a Coven
entries.requires: Saga set in a folk witch coven
entries.summary: Covenant creation adjustments for dispersed covens: separate auras per site, Hooks and Boons balanced over the whole coven, vis sources assigned to individuals, initiation scripts bought with Build Points equal to their bonus, and Build Point ranges by power level.
quotes: By default, the coven has a single site with a level-3 aura
Each initiation script costs a number of Build Points equal to the script bonus.

entries.title: Gruagach Character Generation
entries.summary: How Gifted and unGifted gruagachan are built: when apprenticeship happens, how the Opening of the Gift grants the gruagach Arts, and how many experience points and spell levels each kind of apprenticeship provides.
quotes: 160 experience points for any Abilities, including Arcane ones or the gruagach Arts, and 80 levels of spells
For each year of training, the player may spend 16 experience points in Abilities or gruagach Arts and take 8 levels of spells.

entries.title: Gruagach Training
entries.summary: Explains how gruagachan are taught and how they improve: through a master, vis, exposure or adventure, with Abilities (but not Arts) also raisable by practice.
quotes: gruagachan may not improve their Arts through practice

entries.title: Typical Gruagach Abilities
entries.summary: Minimum Abilities and Arts a Gifted gruagach must have after apprenticeship, plus the Technique, Form, Pictish and Lore thresholds needed before taking the Fetch and External Soul Virtues and initiating unGifted students.
quotes: must have a score of 2 in Pictish and Gruagach Lore, as well as scores of 1 in all of the gruagach Arts

entries.title: Gruagach Abilities (Gruagach Lore and Pictish Language)
entries.summary: Describes Gruagach Lore and Pictish Language, the latter acting as the gruagach equivalent of Magic Theory and capping how high the gruagach's Arts may rise.
quotes: With a Pictish score of 1, a gruagach's Arts may not exceed a score of 5.

entries.title: Hermetic Virtues and Flaws for Gruagachan
entries.summary: Lists which Hermetic Virtues and Flaws gruagach characters may take, with notes on Quiet Magic and on Flaws forbidden to unGifted gruagachan.

entries.title: Gruagach Arts
entries.summary: Introduces the gruagach Techniques and Forms; a caster needs both a Technique and a Form, and an unGifted gruagach needs the matching Virtue for each Art used.

entries.title: Gruagach Techniques (Give and Take)
entries.summary: Describes the Give and Take Techniques, which grant things to or remove things from a target, and how they relate to Hermetic Techniques.

entries.title: Gruagach Forms (Blessing, Curse, Shape, Vision)
entries.summary: Describes the four gruagach Forms and what each can do with Give and Take, including which Virtues Blessing cannot affect and the conditions attached to curses.

entries.title: Gruagach Spellcasting
entries.summary: Gives the gruagach casting score and casting-total formulas for Formulaic and Spontaneous spells, the Fatigue consequences of casting, and how Formulaic spells can be varied in Range, Duration, Target or size.
quotes: Technique + Form + Stamina + Aura Modifier
(Casting Score + Stress Die) / 2
The final spell must be within 2 magnitudes of the original spell

entries.title: Gruagach Spell Mastery
entries.summary: Gruagachan may master Formulaic spells as Hermetic magi do and use Mastery Abilities the troupe allows, except Quiet Casting.

entries.title: Gruagach Flexible Casting Mastery
entries.summary: A Mastery Ability that widens, with Mastery Score, how many magnitudes a gruagach can vary a known Formulaic spell.
quotes: For every full five points in the gruagach's Mastery Score, add one to the number of magnitudes by which he can vary the Range, Duration, Target, or size of a known Formulaic spell.

entries.title: Gruagach Ranges, Durations, and Targets
entries.summary: Lists the limited Range, Duration and Target parameters gruagach spells may use, their base parameters, the vocalization requirement, and the Conversation Range.
quotes: The base parameters for Shape and Vision spells are Personal, Momentary, and Individual. The base parameters for Blessing and Curse spells are Conversation, Momentary, and Individual.
Range: Personal, Conversation (0/+1), and Voice (+1/+2)

entries.title: Gruagach Laboratory Activities
entries.summary: Lists the few laboratory activities open to gruagachan and the gruagach Lab Total, which uses Pictish Language in place of Magic Theory.
quotes: Gruagach Technique + Gruagach Form + Intelligence + Pictish Language + Aura Modifier

entries.title: Gruagach Learning and Inventing Spells
entries.summary: Gruagachan learn and invent spells by the Hermetic rules.

entries.title: Enchanting Tattoos
entries.summary: Rules for gruagach tattoos, which work as Lesser Enchantments: size multipliers for material, Blessing tattoos, Warping, shape bonuses, plus a worked example.
quotes: A tattoo has a base material score of 2, multiplied by a size modifier.

entries.title: Gruagach Shape Bonuses
entries.summary: Table of animal shapes for gruagach tattoos and the shape bonus each animal gives to particular kinds of effect.
quotes: Boar: +3 ferocity, + 4 attacking
Dove: +6 granting visions or premonitions

entries.title: Gruagach Vis Use
entries.summary: How gruagachan use and study raw vis, which Hermetic Forms of vis suit each gruagach Art, extracting Vim vis from auras and moving vis between physical forms.
quotes: A gruagach may extract a number of pawns of Vim vis from a magical aura equal to one tenth of her Take Vision Lab Total.
The gruagach is limited in the number of pawns he may use in a single season to twice his score in Pictish Language.

entries.title: Gruagach Laboratory Texts
entries.summary: Gruagach Laboratory Texts follow the Hermetic rules but Pictish replaces Latin for the levels writable per season, and texts are written in Ogham.
quotes: it replaces Latin to determine the number of levels that may be written per season

entries.title: Gifted Gruagach Initiations
entries.summary: Explains how Gifted gruagachan Initiate students into additional supernatural Abilities via Scripts, with the Initiation Total formula and notes on mystagogues, written scripts and self-initiation.
quotes: Presence + Gruagach Lore + Script Bonus

entries.title: Ritual of Calling the Fetch
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Fetch Virtue: a fasting vigil on a mountaintop, the Stamina plus Concentration rolls required, how the fetch animal is chosen, and the Restriction gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +13 (+3 Quest, +9 Major Ordeal, +1 Sympathetic)
The player must succeed in a Stamina + Concentration roll against an Ease Factor of 9 on three consecutive attempts.

related.text: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults p.19 Choosing the Heartbeast

entries.title: Spirit Magic (gruagach sidebar)
entries.summary: States that gruagach magic cannot affect the dead or their spirits, and points to the Ars Goetica rules for characters who want to command spirits.
quotes: The magic of the gruagachan cannot affect the dead or their spirits.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal p.114 Ars Goetica

entries.title: Extractions of the Soul from its Husk
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the External Soul Virtue: prerequisites such as a Vow to train apprentices and a vessel stone, a season-long ritual, and the Flaw gained.
quotes: Initiation Ease Factor: 21/30

entries.title: UnGifted Gruagach Initiations
entries.summary: Explains how unGifted gruagachan gain each Art through an independent Initiation Script in any order, with no self-Initiation, and the usual progression of Arts.
quotes: an unGifted gruagach may not self-Initiate any Arts

entries.title: Initiation into the Give Technique
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Give Technique, a quest for justice followed by training, with the Flaw gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +17 (+3 Quest, +9 Major Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Initiation into the Take Technique
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Take Technique, a sacrifice at a place of worship followed by training, with the Flaw gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +17 (+3 Special Place, +9 Major Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Sacrifice, +1 Initiate's Time)

entries.title: Initiation into the Blessing Form
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Blessing Form, requiring a permanent solution for a truly disadvantaged person, with the Flaw gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +11 (+3 Quest, +3 Minor Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Initiation into the Curse Form
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Curse Form, punishing a wicked individual with a poetically just penalty, with the Flaw gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +11 (+3 Quest, +3 Minor Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Initiation into the Shape Form
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Shape Form, defeating a shapechanger and being transformed into its shape for a lunar month, with the Flaw gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +11 (+3 Quest, +3 Minor Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Initiation into the Vision Form
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Vision Form, a fast and meditation at a Pictish holy site with Concentration rolls, with the Flaw gained.
quotes: The player must succeed in a Stamina + Concentration roll against an Ease Factor of 9 on three consecutive attempts.

entries.title: Gruagach Magical Defenses
entries.summary: Lists the Form-specific magic defenses each gruagach Art grants against particular Forms of magic.
quotes: Magical Fortitude: Defense against Corpus effects.
Strength of Form: Defense against Corpus or Animal effects.

entries.title: Geas and Limit Durations
entries.summary: Introduces the Geas and Limit condition Durations, comparable to the Merinita condition Durations but with difficulty varying by how broad the prohibition is or how easily it can be ended.
quotes: The gruagach Durations never require a Ritual

related.text: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults p.100

entries.title: Geas and Limit Duration Magnitudes
entries.summary: Table of the magnitude added to a spell by Geas or Limit Durations depending on whether the prohibition is sweeping, general or specific.
quotes: Geas (Condition) | +4 magnitudes

entries.title: Geas (Condition) Duration
entries.summary: Rules for geasa: magical prohibitions with grave consequences if broken, which Techniques and Forms may use them, how the caster states the condition, and how the geas and Limit Durations combine.
quotes: Geasa come in the following three varieties: sweeping prohibitions (+4 magnitudes), general prohibitions (+2 magnitudes), and specific prohibitions (+1 magnitude).
only the larger of the two Durations is added to the magnitude of the spell

entries.title: Limit (Condition) Duration
entries.summary: Rules for the Limit Duration used by all Blessing and Curse spells, where ease of lifting the spell sets its cost, and how geasa carry two conditions.
quotes: All Blessing and Curse spells must use the Limit (Condition) Duration.

entries.title: Sweeping Prohibitions
entries.summary: Defines sweeping prohibitions, with examples, and their Duration equivalent and magnitude cost for geasa versus blessings and curses.
quotes: Sweeping prohibitions for geasa are the equivalent of Year Duration and add +4 magnitudes to the level of the spell.

entries.title: General Prohibitions
entries.summary: Defines general prohibitions, comparable to the Flaw Restriction, with examples and their Duration equivalent and magnitude cost.
quotes: General prohibitions are the equivalent of Sun Duration and add +2 magnitudes to the level of the spell cast.

entries.title: Specific Prohibitions
entries.summary: Defines specific prohibitions, narrower than the Flaw Restriction, with examples and their Duration equivalent and magnitude cost for geasa versus blessings and curses.
quotes: Specific prohibitions for geasa are the equivalent of Diameter Duration and add +1 magnitude to the level of the spell cast.

entries.title: Poetic Justice (geas and curse resistance)
entries.summary: A geas or curse that does not suit the victim's past acts is easier to resist; a table of modifiers to the victim's Stamina check measures how appropriate the geas and curse are.
quotes: the victim receives a bonus to his Stamina check to avoid the effects of the geas or curse
The geas and/or curse are perfectly appropriate to address some past event

entries.title: Geas and Limit Durations in Play
entries.summary: How conditions are articulated in play, how gruagach flexibility lets a spell be altered when cast, and Warping: a Geas does not count as active until broken, but a Limit is active.
quotes: A spell with Geas Duration does not count as an active supernatural effect until the character breaks the prohibition
a typical gruagach may alter freely the Range, Target, or Duration of a spell by 10 levels

entries.title: Gruagach Alternative (all spells use Limit or Geas)
entries.summary: Optional rule making every gruagach spell and laboratory effect use the Limit or Geas Durations.
quotes: the troupe may decide that all spells and Laboratory effects by gruagachan must use the Limit or Geas Durations

entries.title: Blessing Spell Guidelines Overview
entries.summary: Introduces Blessing spells that temporarily grant Virtues, Ability bonuses and Characteristic improvements, and Take Blessing spells that remove Virtues, with the requirement that prohibitions fit the story.

entries.title: Give Blessing Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Give Blessing spells, which grant Virtues, Ability bonuses or Characteristic increases, with limits on which Virtues may be given and descriptions of sweeping, general and specific prohibitions.
quotes: Level 5: Provide a bonus of +1 to a single Ability roll.
Level 20: Grant a Major General or Supernatural (Magic) Virtue.

entries.title: Take Blessing Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Take Blessing spells, which nullify Virtues, Abilities or Characteristics, including how the storyguide picks the target and the victim's Stamina resistance roll with poetic justice modifiers.
quotes: Level 10: Reduce the score in a single Ability to 0.
the target has the opportunity to resist it with a Stamina check against an Ease Factor of 9

entries.title: Curse Spell Guidelines Overview
entries.summary: Introduces Curse spells, which inflict Flaws or reduce Characteristics and Abilities, and Take Curse spells, which remove curses and lingering magic.

entries.title: Give Curse Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Give Curse spells that inflict Flaws, diseases, injuries or penalties, which Flaws cannot be inflicted, prohibition types, the victim's Stamina resistance roll and the required Geas or Limit Duration.
quotes: All Give Curse spells must have either the Geas or Limit Duration.
Level 15: Inflict a serious disease.

entries.title: Take Curse Guidelines
entries.summary: Guidelines for Take Curse spells that learn the terms of or remove curses, the risk to a caster who fails or botches, and how Hermetic magic can dispel gruagach curses.
quotes: If a gruagach fails to remove a curse, the caster suffers the effects of the curse also.

entries.title: Shape Spell Guidelines Overview
entries.summary: Introduces Give Shape and Take Shape spells for altering the physical shape of another or oneself, noting that carried items are incorporated into the new form.

entries.title: Give Shape Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Give Shape spells that add features of other creatures or transform a willing recipient, including the target's inability to back out once the change is accepted.
quotes: Give Shape spells are only effective on a willing recipient.

entries.title: Take Shape Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Take Shape spells that force a foreign form on a target or let the caster mimic one, including the Stamina resistance roll modified by Personality Traits.
quotes: the player would need to succeed at an Ease Factor of 6 to resist

entries.title: Vision Spell Guidelines Overview
entries.summary: Introduces Vision spells that control perception, create simple illusions, grant invisibility, send out the fetch, and give glimpses of the future.

entries.title: Give Vision Guidelines
