entries.summary: Guideline table for Give Vision spells that create sight and sound illusions or grant Visions and Premonitions on a chosen topic, with magnitude increases for complex or moving images.
quotes: Level 1: Create an image that affects sight or sound.

entries.title: Take Vision Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Take Vision spells that use senses at a distance via the fetch, detect vis, discern or dispel illusions, and destroy an object's effect on hearing or sight.
quotes: Level 1: Detect the presence of vis.

entries.title: Gruagach Botches
entries.summary: Describes botch results for each gruagach Form, which follow the Hermetic botch guidelines, and notes that Vision botches inflict extra Warping Points.
quotes: every Vision botch inflicts double the normal Warping Points

entries.title: Gruagach Transformation (the Curse of Gruagach)
entries.summary: The gruagach equivalent of Twilight and Warping: when a gruagach gains Warping Points from a botch or other powerful effect he rolls to avoid transformation, slowly becoming troll-like.
quotes: Stamina + Concentration + Vision Magic Defense Bonus + stress die vs. Warping Score + Number of Warping Points Gained + local aura + stress die

entries.title: Effects of Transformation
entries.summary: After a transformation the Understanding Transformation roll decides whether the experience is good or bad, and at a high enough Warping Score the gruagach becomes a troll controlled by the storyguide.
quotes: Intelligence + stress die vs. Warping Score + stress die
When a character reaches a Warping Score of 10, the transformation to a troll is complete.

entries.title: Gruagach Good Transformation Experiences
entries.summary: Options for a good transformation: a gruagach magic Virtue, a troll Virtue, or bonus experience in an Art.
quotes: The gruagach acquires Experience Points in a pre-existing Art equivalent to the character's Warping Score + simple die.

entries.title: Gruagach Bad Transformation Experiences
entries.summary: Options for a bad transformation: a gruagach magic Flaw, a troll Flaw such as Repellent, or lost experience in an Art.
quotes: The gruagach loses Experience Points in a pre-existing Art equivalent to the character's Warping Score + simple die.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal p.89 Repellent

entries.title: Gruagachan in Play (covenant involvement)
entries.summary: Explains how gruagachan appear as allies or adversaries to a covenant, how non-Order gruagachan are generated, and that they can supply covenant Boons and Hooks.

entries.title: Major Covenant Boon: Friendly Gruagach Collective
entries.summary: A Major covenant Boon giving the covenant control over a nearby gruagach collective that supplies information, trade and aid.
quotes: This is a variant of the Hedge Tradition Covenant Boon (see Covenants page 21).

related.text: Covenants p.21 Hedge Tradition Covenant Boon

entries.title: Major Covenant Hook: Hostile Gruagach Collective
entries.summary: A Major covenant Hook where a nearby gruagach collective is hostile, spreading rumors and harvesting the covenant's vis sources.

entries.title: Minor Covenant Boon: Gruagach Ally
entries.summary: A Minor covenant Boon in which a single gruagach lives nearby and assists the magi.

entries.title: Minor Covenant Hook: Gruagach Resident
entries.summary: A Minor covenant Hook in which gruagachan live in the covenant, risking visits from a Quaesitor, curious magi and suspicious fellow gruagachan.

entries.title: Hermetic Gruagachan
entries.summary: How to build a gruagach who is nominally a member of the Order of Hermes: the required Flaw and Virtue, and the minimum Code of Hermes and Parma Magica scores.
quotes: A nominal Hermetic gruagach character should take the Flaw Hedge Wizard and the Virtue Arcane Lore.

entries.title: Trollsynir Tradition
entries.requires: Tradition: Trollsynir (Virtue: Giant Blood, Flaw: No Tattoo Magic)
entries.summary: Overview of the Norse trollsynir, an alternate tradition using the gruagach Arts, with their required Virtues and Flaws.
quotes: Required Virtues and Flaws: Giant Blood, No Tattoo Magic

entries.title: Trollsynir Magic
entries.summary: Trollskap works like gruagach magic with the Jotnar language replacing Pictish and no tattoo magic; overuse turns the trollson into a troll via Warping, and Initiation Scripts favor heroic deeds.
quotes: Any requirement for a score in the Pictish language is replaced with the Jotnar language

entries.title: Trollsynir Characters
entries.summary: Character creation notes for trollsynir: no formal apprenticeship or training requirements, universally taught Abilities, and typical or inappropriate Virtues and Flaws.

entries.title: Kolduni Tradition
entries.summary: Overview of the pagan wizards of the Novgorod Tribunal who use the gruagach Arts, with the required Flaw and favored Abilities.
quotes: Required Flaws: No Tattoo Magic

entries.title: Koldun Magic
entries.summary: Koldun magic uses the gruagach mechanics with Koldovali Theory in place of Pictish, a wholly oral tradition, an Arcane Connection Range needing water, a Durable External Soul variant, and a faerie-based Warping progression.
quotes: except the Ability Koldovali Theory replaces Pictish Language in the relevant formulae
The kolduni have access to the Arcane Connection Range, which adds +4 Magnitudes to a spell's level.

entries.title: Koldun Characters
entries.summary: Character creation notes for kolduni: use the gruagach generation rules, typical Abilities, available Social Statuses and appropriate Virtues and Flaws.

gated.title: Learned Magicians
gated.intro: The magic of the learned magicians.

entries.title: Learned Magician Character Generation
entries.summary: How Gifted and unGifted learned magicians are built: starting age, the Opening of the Gift, yearly experience points and charms, and the lack of a formal apprenticeship.
quotes: Each year that the learned magician trains under a master he gains 30 experience points.
The player may also spend experience points on charms, at a rate of 5 levels of charms per experience point.

entries.title: Learned Magician Training
entries.summary: Learned magicians learn from a master then study from texts written under the normal text rules.

entries.title: Typical Learned Magician Abilities
entries.summary: Abilities typical of learned magicians, minimum Latin and Artes Liberales scores needed for charms and amulets, and Virtues and Flaws that suit the tradition.
quotes: All magicians must possess minimum scores of 1 in Latin to learn charms and 1 in Artes Liberales to create amulets and chartae or cast charms from text.

entries.title: Lore of the Mathematici
entries.summary: Describes the Organization Lore of the Mathematici of Bologna and what a character with it knows.

entries.title: Mythic Alchemy and Mythic Herbalism (Learned Magician Virtues)
entries.requires: Virtue: Mythic Alchemy or Mythic Herbalism
entries.summary: The opening of the learned-magician Virtues, including the extended rules behind Mythic Alchemy (formulae, reagents, alterations, vis limits, craft preparation) and Mythic Herbalism (concoction Ease Factor table for healing, poisons and potions).
quotes: Briefly, a formula is invented in a season by acquiring 5 experience points.
At the end of the process, the player must roll the character's Intelligence + Mythic Herbalism against the target Ease Factor.

entries.title: New Reagent Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline levels for new alchemical reagents transmuting complex or simple matter or preparing raw materials for craftsmen.
quotes: Level 2: Prepare raw materials for a craftsman to produce superior goods.

entries.title: Hermetic Virtues and Flaws for Learned Magicians
entries.summary: Lists the Hermetic Virtues and Flaws available to learned magicians, noting that some suit only those with The Gift.

entries.title: Magic of the Learned Magicians (charms, amulets and chartae)
entries.summary: Overview of verbal charms, chartae and amulets, and how charm magic bypasses the Arcane Connection requirement but must still overcome Magic Resistance.

entries.title: Learned Magician Arts
entries.summary: Learned magicians have three Techniques and three Forms; every charm or amulet needs one of each, and unGifted characters need the matching Virtue for each Art.

entries.title: Learned Magician Techniques (Tueor, Succurro, Vulnero)
entries.summary: Describes the Tueor, Succurro and Vulnero Techniques, what each can and cannot do, and how they relate to Hermetic Rego, Creo and Perdo.

entries.title: Learned Magician Forms (Fortunam, Magicam, Salutem)
entries.summary: Describes the Fortunam, Magicam and Salutem Forms and their limits compared with Hermetic Arts.

entries.title: Charms Overview
entries.summary: Charms are cast and learned like Formulaic spells; there are no spontaneous charms, but a magician can cast unlearned charms from a text.

entries.title: Charm Design and Casting Totals
entries.summary: Gives the learned magician casting score and the charm totals for known and text-read charms, with success, Fatigue and failure thresholds and which die applies.
quotes: Hedge Technique + Hedge Form + Communication + Aura Modifier
(Casting Score + Die) / 2
(Casting Score + Stress Die) / 5

entries.title: Ranges, Durations, & Targets for Charms
entries.summary: Table of the Range, Duration and Target parameters available to charms, with their magnitude modifiers.
quotes: Range: Personal, Eye/Touch (+1), and Voice (+2)

entries.title: Reading Charms from Text
entries.summary: How a learned magician finds and casts charms from a formulary: the search roll, reading time per magnitude, Language penalties, and how the storyguide decides what a formulary contains.
quotes: The player must make an Intelligence + Language roll against an Ease Factor of 9

entries.title: Charm Ranges, Durations, and Targets
entries.summary: Charms use the Hermetic parameters from a restricted list, are fixed once known and cannot be altered during casting, and a related charm still gives the Lab Total bonus.
quotes: The base parameters for a charm are Personal, Momentary, and Individual.

entries.title: Learned Magician Vis Use
entries.summary: Learned magicians use raw vis in charm casting under the Hermetic rules and a table of which kinds of vis suit each Art, but they cannot study from vis.
quotes: Learned magicians may not study from vis.

entries.title: Learned Magician Laboratory Activities
entries.summary: Introduces amulets (season-long, multi-charge) and chartae (quick, single-use) as the devices learned magicians create.

entries.title: Amulet and Charta Design
entries.summary: Gives the learned magician Lab Total, how many charges an amulet holds, the Charta Total, creation time, and rules for incomplete chartae prepared for an unknown recipient.
quotes: Hedge Technique + Hedge Form + Intelligence + Artes Liberales + Aura Modifier
(Lab Total – Amulet Level of Effect) / 5 (rounded up)
Lab Total/2

entries.title: Ranges, Durations, and Targets for Amulets and Chartae
entries.summary: Table of Range, Duration and Target parameters and magnitudes available to amulets and chartae.
quotes: Duration: Momentary, Sun (+1), Moon (+2), and Season (+3)

entries.title: Astronomical Requirements
entries.summary: Amulets and chartae need a horoscope of the recipient: daily and nativity horoscopes give Lab Total bonuses, with the Intelligence plus Artes Liberales rolls, time needed and a failure result.
quotes: A simple daily horoscope is sufficient for writing a charta, and adds +5 to the character's Lab Total, but if a nativity horoscope is created instead, the astronomer adds +10 to his Lab Total.

entries.title: Amulet and Chartae Ranges, Durations, and Targets
entries.summary: Rules on the Range, Duration and Target of amulets and chartae: touch only, how Group, Bloodline, Structure and Boundary targets work, and the Season Duration.
quotes: The base parameters for amulets and chartae are Touch, Momentary, and Individual.

entries.title: Amulet and Charta Effects
entries.summary: How charges are expended when an amulet is worn or a charta is made, and what effects are not allowed for these devices.

entries.title: Learned Magician Laboratory Requirements
entries.summary: A learned magician's laboratory needs only the basic equipment for casting a horoscope and writing.

entries.title: Learned Magician Laboratory Texts
entries.summary: Lab Texts follow the Hermetic rules but charms are shorter, so many more charm levels can be written or copied per season than device levels.
quotes: Language x 100 charm levels per season Language x 20 device levels per season

entries.title: Inventing and Learning New Charms
entries.summary: Charms are learned from a teacher and invented by the Hermetic rules, but the totals are multiplied because charms are simpler.
quotes: the maximum total levels of charms learned in a season is the teacher's Lab Total in the applicable Art combination multiplied by five

entries.title: Mitigation of Realm Interaction Effects (Entreat the Powers)

entries.summary: How learned magicians call on realm powers to reduce negative realm interaction in hostile auras: the Entreat the Powers Total, its cap, entreating multiple realms and the botch penalty, with examples.
quotes: Stress Die + Presence + (Realm) Lore

entries.title: UnGifted Mathematicus Initiations
entries.summary: Explains that an unGifted mathematicus takes both the Flaw and Virtue for each Initiation, that the examples given are only examples, and that Ordeal Flaws relate to the ability to practice magic.
quotes: A player who wishes to play a companion mathematicus must take both the Flaw and Virtue for each Initiation listed.

entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Tueor Technique: a season of service with a Philosophiae test, then a season of teaching, with the Flaws gained.

entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Magicam Form: a season of service with a Magic Lore test, then a season of teaching, with the Flaws gained.

entries.title: Initiation into the Salutem Form
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Salutem Form: a season of service with a Medicine test, then a season of teaching, with the Flaws gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +14 (+3 Quest, +6 Minor Ordeals (2), +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Initiation into the Entreat the Divine Powers Ability

entries.summary: Initiation Script granting the Entreat the Divine Powers Minor Virtue after a season of service with a Divine Lore test, with the Flaw gained.

entries.summary: Lists the Form-specific magic defenses each learned magician Art grants against particular Hermetic Forms.

entries.title: Fortunam Charms and Magic Resistance

entries.title: Tueor Fortunam Guidelines

quotes: Level 1: Allow a player to re-roll a failed roll for a single Ability where the Ease Factor is no more than 3 and use the better of the two rolls.

entries.title: Succurro Fortunam Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Succurro Fortunam charms that grant luck bonuses, Ability bonuses or Virtues, and which must penetrate the Magic Resistance of the target and anyone the character acts against.
quotes: Level 1: Provide a bonus of +1 to all Luck related rolls.

entries.title: Vulnero Fortunam Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Vulnero Fortunam curses that add botch dice, penalize Ability rolls or force rerolls, including the Perception plus Magic Lore roll for a victim to notice the curse.
quotes: To discover the curse, the player must roll a Perception + Magic Lore against an Ease Factor of 12, minus the magnitude of the Vulnero Fortunam charm

entries.title: Magicam Charms Overview
entries.summary: Introduces Magicam charms for each Technique, notes that they cannot control demons directly, and explains that general guidelines must be learned at a specific level.

entries.title: Tueor Magicam Guidelines
entries.summary: Guidelines for Tueor Magicam charms that protect against a specific type of hostile magical damage or Supernatural Ability, adding to Soak, Defense or Ease Factors.
quotes: General: Add +2 to the Target's Soak Total for damage caused by magical damage of specific type for every level of the base charm effect.

entries.title: Succurro Magicam Guidelines
entries.summary: Guidelines for Succurro Magicam charms that grant Supernatural Ability bonuses or Magic Realm Virtues, or boost existing charms and amulets.
quotes: Level 2: Provide a bonus of +1 to rolls for a single Supernatural Ability.

entries.title: Vulnero Magicam Guidelines
entries.summary: Guidelines for Vulnero Magicam charms that shorten continuing magic or ward against creatures of a realm below a given Might, with the Target referring to a single spell.
quotes: If the victim of the spell has Magical Resistance, the charm must penetrate to be effective.

entries.title: Salutem Charms Overview
entries.summary: Introduces Salutem charms, which cover the health of humans, animals, crops and structures but cannot improve Characteristics, change shape or control movement.

entries.title: Tueor Salutem Guidelines
entries.summary: Guidelines for Tueor Salutem protective charms against broad or narrow categories of damage, disease, poison and wards against animals or people, with limits on wards and magical damage.
quotes: Tueor Salutem wards can only be placed on locations with either a Structure or Boundary Target.

related.text: ArM5 Greater Immunity and Lesser Immunity

entries.title: Succurro Salutem Guidelines
entries.summary: Guidelines for Succurro Salutem charms, which follow Creo Corpus but cannot heal permanently, covering Recovery bonuses, plant growth, Living Conditions and aging crises, best used as amulets and chartae.
quotes: Level 2: Give a character a +6 bonus to Recovery rolls for a single non-magical disease, poison, or injury.

entries.title: Vulnero Salutem Guidelines
entries.summary: Guidelines for Vulnero Salutem charms, which follow Perdo Corpus, inflicting wounds, lost Fatigue, crippled limbs, destroyed senses and diseases.
quotes: Level 5: Inflict a Light Wound.

entries.title: Learned Magician Botches
entries.summary: Describes botch results for Fortunam, Salutem and Magicam charms, following the Hermetic botch guidelines.

entries.title: Learned Magician Warping
entries.summary: Magicians gain Warping Points from the usual sources and from zeros on botch dice when casting charms, and may suffer an intervention if a single botch gives two or more points.
quotes: Like Hermetic magi, magicians also gain 1 Warping Point for every 0 that comes up on the botch dice when casting a charm.

entries.title: Intervention (learned magician Twilight analogue)
entries.summary: When Warping from a botch triggers an intervention, a realm entity confronts the magician; an avoidance roll and an appeasement roll decide whether he receives a boon or a punishment such as a Flaw tied to that realm.
quotes: Intelligence + Concentration + (Magicam Score / 5) + stress die vs. Warping Score + Number of Warping Points Gained + (Realm) aura + stress die
Communication + stress die vs. Warping Score + stress die

entries.title: Abduction
entries.summary: Once the Warping Score is high enough, the offended realm entity abducts the magician for a number of seasons, and at a higher score the effect becomes permanent.
quotes: Once the learned magician's Warping Score reaches 7, the entity takes more-direct action.
When the character's Warping Score becomes 10, the effect becomes permanent.

entries.title: Epistolary Community (Gifted mathematici and correspondence)
entries.summary: Gifted mathematici use long correspondence to overcome the social effects of The Gift, and a successful Communication plus Charm roll can let a face-to-face meeting count as an established relationship instead of a first impression.
quotes: successful in a Communication + Charm roll against an Ease Factor set by the storyguide

related.text: ArM5 p.76 First Impression and Established Relationship

entries.title: Learned Magicians in Play (covenant involvement)
entries.summary: Explains how mathematici appear as allies or adversaries of a covenant, how non-Order mathematici are generated, and that they provide covenant Boons and Hooks.

entries.title: Minor Covenant Boon: Mathematicus Ally
entries.summary: A Minor covenant Boon in which a university-trained mathematicus lives nearby and helps the magi.

entries.title: Minor Covenant Hook: Mathematicus Resident
entries.summary: A Minor covenant Hook in which mathematici live in the covenant, drawing Quaesitor visits if any are Gifted and visits from magi seeking Insight.

entries.title: Hermetic Learned Magicians
entries.requires: Tradition: Learned Magicians (member of the Order)
entries.summary: How to build a nominally Hermetic learned magician: the required Flaw and Virtue and where the Arcane Lore experience goes.
quotes: A nominally Hermetic learned magician character should take the Flaw Hedge Wizard and the Virtue Arcane Lore.

entries.title: Mythic Alchemists Tradition
entries.summary: Overview of the mythic alchemist alternate tradition and its required Virtues, Flaws, Arts and Abilities.
quotes: Required Virtues and Flaws: Mythic Alchemy, Laboratory Magician, and No Text Casting

entries.title: Mythic Alchemist Magic
entries.summary: How mythic alchemists work: powders, potions and pastilles in place of charms, Philosophiae in the Lab Total, experimentation risk, vis cost for doses, lab assistance rules, and a Warping progression leading to paranoia and insanity.
quotes: A Mythic alchemist substitutes his Philosophiae score for Artes Liberales in calculating his Lab Total.
the alchemist must use 1 pawn of vis for every 5 levels of the base effect of the potion
When the character's Warping Score reaches 3, he acquires a Minor Personality Flaw making the character more secretive and suspicious.

entries.title: Mythic Alchemist Characters
entries.summary: Character creation notes for mythic alchemists, who follow the learned magician guidelines with idiosyncratic training and typical Abilities.

entries.title: Cunning-Folk Tradition
entries.summary: Overview of the cunning-folk alternate tradition and its required Virtues, Arts and Abilities.
quotes: Required Virtues: Mythic Herbalism and Entreat the Faerie Powers

entries.title: Cunning-Folk Magic
entries.summary: Cunning-folk use the learned magician mechanics with local-language charms, Craft: Charm replacing Artes Liberales in the Lab Total, no horoscope requirement and their own lab assistance rule.
quotes: The cunning-folk substitute the Craft: Charm Ability for Artes Liberales in their Laboratory Total when creating their devices.

entries.title: Cunning-Folk Characters
entries.summary: Character creation notes for cunning-folk: apprenticeship length, yearly experience and spell levels, and typical Abilities, Social Status, Virtues and Flaws.
quotes: For each year of training, the player may spend 16 experience points in Abilities or Arts and 8 levels of spells.

entries.title: Integrating the Learned Magicians' Magic
entries.requires: Hermetic Breakthrough: Integration of learned magician magic
entries.summary: Introduces the possible Breakthrough for a magus who integrates learned magician magic with Hermetic magic.

entries.title: Integration: Single-Use Charged Items
entries.requires: Hermetic Breakthrough: Integration of Single-Use Charged Items
entries.summary: Integration of chartae creation into Hermetic theory so a magus can quickly create single-use charged items: suggested Breakthrough points, sources of Insight, the one-device-per-season limit during Integration and the consequences.
quotes: Suggested Breakthrough Points: 40
The magus may only create one device per season until he achieves a Breakthrough.

entries.title: Nightwalker Characters
entries.summary: Nightwalkers are built as conventional companions rather than Mythic Companions, and most have a mundane profession.
quotes: Nightwalkers are designed as conventional companions, not Mythic Companions like the most powerful members of the other traditions described in this book.

entries.title: Nightwalker New Virtues (regional traditions)
entries.summary: The Nightwalker Major Virtue must be localized by choosing a regional tradition (or a similar local group), and membership of a regional tradition is a Free Virtue.
quotes: Membership of each regional tradition is a Free Virtue.

entries.title: Nightwalker (Virtue powers and limitations)
entries.summary: The Nightwalker Virtue lets a character stray as a phantasticum, listing the powers it grants (Second Sight, tangible or intangible form, animal shapes, speaking to sleepers) and its duties and limitations such as a vulnerable body and shared injuries.
quotes: The character may make his spiritual form tangible or intangible using a Stamina + Concentration roll.

entries.title: Born With a Caul
entries.summary: Sidebar explaining the caul that most nightwalkers are born with, the possible Major Story Flaw for losing it, and the Virtues that having a caul can grant or often grants.
quotes: Knowledge of the nightwalkers is an (Organization) Lore

entries.title: Straying (Ekstasis) Overview
entries.summary: Introduces ekstasis or straying, the power that lets a nightwalker send his spirit out of his sleeping body. It arises untrained and has no Ability that improves with practice.
quotes: It is a power that arises without training, and has no corresponding Ability

entries.title: Preparation for Straying
entries.summary: How a nightwalker induces insensibility so the spirit can stray: sleep, illness, asceticism, Hermetic sleep spells or drugs. Drugs take a time that depends on Concentration, and a poisoned victim may resist with a Stamina roll.
quotes: a character using drugs takes (10 – Concentration) minutes to reach insensibility, with a minimum time of one minute
Stamina roll against an Ease Factor of 6

entries.title: The Insensate Body and Straying Fatigue
entries.summary: Describes the helpless, death-like body left behind during straying, the danger of it being disturbed, and the Long Term Fatigue cost of straying for an hour or a whole night.
quotes: they have lost a Long Term Fatigue level
they have lost 2 Long Term Fatigue levels

entries.title: The Phantasticum
entries.summary: Rules for the straying spirit form: it can be corporeal or immaterial, visible or invisible, human or animal, and switching state takes rounds and a roll if attempted in combat.
quotes: Switching between corporeality and immateriality takes three rounds, and cannot be performed during combat without a Stamina + Concentration roll against an Ease Factor of 15.

entries.title: Second Sight and Magical Air in Spirit Form
entries.summary: A nightwalker in spirit form may use Second Sight, and the phantasticum unsettles humans and is sensed by domestic animals.
quotes: While in spirit form, the nightwalker may use the Second Sight Ability.

entries.title: Travel Through Straying
entries.summary: Spirit travel is almost instant and uses a Stamina + Athletics roll whose result sets how familiar a destination must be. Extra carried objects raise the difficulty and some journeys succeed automatically.
quotes: needs to make a Stamina + Athletics roll
increases the difficulty of the roll by +3 per object

entries.title: Combat Statistics for Animal Phantastica
entries.summary: A system for building the animal-shaped phantasticum: combine the species statistics with the character's Characteristics, apply Size and body Virtues and Flaws, and use the animal's General Abilities.
quotes: if both the species and character have a negative score, use the lowest score. If both the species and the character have a positive score, use the highest.

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic, Book of Mundane Beasts

entries.title: Communications Through Straying
entries.summary: A corporeal phantasticum can talk with people at its destination at the cost of extra fatigue, while speaking to sleepers is remembered as dreams unless an Intelligence + Concentration roll preserves details.
quotes: Intelligence + Concentration roll against an Ease Factor of 12

entries.title: Leading Others Astray
entries.summary: A nightwalker can guide willing people out of their bodies with a Stamina + Leadership roll, and failed guidance leaves the lost spirits to find their way back.
quotes: Stamina + Leadership roll against an Ease Factor 3 points higher than that for personal travel
requires a Stamina + Leadership roll against an Ease Factor of 3

entries.title: Combat and the Straying Spirit
entries.summary: Corporeal phantastica fight material foes and immaterial ones fight only spirits; damage to the phantasticum is mirrored on the sleeping body, scaled up or down for animal forms.
quotes: Any damage a phantasticum in human form suffers appears, instantly and identically, on the body of the nightwalker.

entries.title: Drowsiness
entries.summary: A hostile phantasticum makes bystanders drowsy; a waking character without Magic Resistance must roll to stay awake and a sleeper is nearly impossible to wake.
quotes: Concentration + Stamina roll against an Ease Factor of 3

entries.title: Fertility Battles
entries.summary: Every nightwalker answers summons to seasonal spirit battles whose outcome decides whether the local harvest, hunting and fishing are normal, poor or bountiful.
quotes: most do battle four times a year

entries.title: Giving Battle
entries.summary: How a night battle is run: either the player rolls for a disciplined militia or the character seeks individual foes in a mêlée, using Perception + Awareness to find enemies.
quotes: Perception + Awareness roll of 9 or more

entries.title: Covenants Supplement Modifiers (Fertility Battle Outcomes)
entries.summary: A table that maps the outcome of a fertility battle onto the Income Modification Table of the Covenants supplement in place of the stress die roll.
quotes: This selection replaces the stress die roll.

entries.title: Night Battle Enemies
entries.summary: Guidance for statting the foes in night battles: enemy nightwalkers like player characters or quick grogs, the dead from ghost statistics, and Infernal servants and demonic captains from the Infernal and Divine books.
quotes: Demonic captains are generally Aerial Powers with a Might score of 20 or less.

entries.title: Musters Out of Season and Recognising Fellow Nightwalkers
entries.summary: Special musters can be called to deal with a local evil, and nightwalkers recognise each other or Infernal witches in waking life with a Perception + Awareness roll reduced by Reputation and frequency of meeting.
quotes: Perception + Awareness roll of (15 - the highest applicable Reputation of the observed)

entries.title: Returning Home and Spiritual Nourishment
entries.summary: After battle nightwalkers drift home invisibly and take spiritual nourishment, whose form varies by tradition, to shorten their Long Term Fatigue.
quotes: Returning nightwalkers often take spiritual nourishment so that they suffer Long Term Fatigue for a briefer time.

entries.title: Processions of the Dead
entries.summary: Nightwalkers escort the dead and can fight, intimidate or question ghosts; intimidation and questioning use opposed-style Ease Factors keyed to the ghost's traits and the length of answer wanted.
quotes: Presence + Leadership roll against an Ease factor of 6 + the ghost's Brave score

entries.title: Celebratory Processions
entries.summary: Feasts and celebrations are spiritual regeneration that reduce Long Term Fatigue after waking, and the same rituals can help with Long Term Fatigue from other causes.
quotes: Feasting is an act of spiritual regeneration that reduces the level of the nightwalker's Long Term Fatigue after waking

entries.title: Nightwalker Taboo on Waking Contests
entries.summary: Nightwalkers and Infernal witches may duel in waking life, but breaking the taboo against speaking about the night battles brings dream beatings whose injuries show on the waking body.
quotes: If either breaks their taboo they are terribly beaten, in their dreams

entries.title: Benandanti Tradition
entries.summary: The north Italian good walkers: how recruits are summoned, the Ember Day Thursday battles against the malandanti, the Lady of the Game who appoints captains and revives eaten animals.
quotes: The benandanti fight in human form and are armed with bunches of fennel

entries.title: Hounds of God Tradition
entries.summary: The werewolf nightwalkers who raid Hell in wolf form three times a year; includes the two ways of becoming a Hound, notably the toasting ritual that passes the power on to another person.
quotes: the wolf does not drink to the toast, or give thanks for it

entries.title: Kresniki and Kudlaki Tradition
entries.summary: Slavic nightwalkers pairing a community protector, the kresnik, with a sorcerer rival, the kudlak, who steals fertility and may return as a vampire. Covers birth with a caul, the forced Versatile Phantasticum and the effects of a kudlak winning.
quotes: These characters are required to take the Versatile Phantasticum Virtue

entries.title: Mazzeru Tradition
entries.summary: Corsican nightwalkers who fight Infernal witches with asphodel and are also compelled to hunt in dreams, killing animals that foretell the death of villagers; accepting this costs no Flaw but resisting it gives a Story Flaw.
quotes: Mazzeri use stalks of asphodel as weapons.

entries.title: Taltos Tradition
entries.summary: Hungarian nightwalkers who fight in the sky as horses, bulls or flames. Covers the childhood coma and initiation, the battle schedule, recovery by eating, and the fact that most taltós lose their powers at some age.
quotes: Taltós fight in the forms of horses, bulls, or flames

entries.title: Statistics and Abilities for Flame Shape
entries.summary: Rules for a taltos in the form of a ball or wheel of flame, built from the characteristics of an elemental: fixed Characteristics, Abilities that can be used, fire Damage, fire vulnerability immunities and a Hungry Personality trait.
quotes: suffer +5 burn damage for each attack (Penetration 0)
and does +5 fire Damage

entries.title: Vitkir as Characters
entries.requires: Tradition: Vitkir (The Gift, apprenticed rune master)
entries.summary: Character creation for vitkir: designed like magi with The Gift, a long apprenticeship in the 24 runes, set starting experience and rune script levels, minimum Abilities, virtue and flaw limits, and the Vitki Social Status.
quotes: They receive a total of 240 experience points for these years of specialized study
120 levels of rune scripts
A score of 10 in a single rune is the practical maximum for a character who has just finished his apprenticeship.

entries.title: Vitkar Magic Foci
entries.requires: Tradition: Vitkir; Virtue: Major or Minor Rune Focus
entries.summary: Explains how a vitkar magic focus works: the rune score is doubled for spells of the focus' purpose carved into its proper material. Lists the seven Sigrdrifumal types of rune magic with their materials and typical runes.
quotes: he may double his score in the rune used in the spell formula

entries.title: Craft: Runes
entries.summary: New Ability covering carving or inscribing runes into materials; it affects how long runes last and how well they can be hidden in a script.
quotes: This can be used to determine how long the runes last

entries.title: Rune Magic Ability
entries.summary: New Arcane Ability representing knowledge of vitkar magic and how to formulate rune scripts; interchangeable with the Ancient Magic Ability of the same name.
quotes: It deals with the technical details of each rune, how they may be used, and how to formulate a rune script.

entries.title: Nátt-thel
entries.summary: The vitkar equivalent of Twilight: after a sudden burst of Warping Points a vitki rolls to avoid temporarily losing The Gift and his magic, and a duration roll sets how long he is without it. A vitki may sacrifice extra Warping Points to keep some rune effects active.
quotes: Stamina + Concentration + stress die vs. (Warping Score x 3)
simple die + Warping Score

entries.title: Odin's Sacrifice
entries.summary: An initiation ritual copying Odin's ordeal on the tree: surviving nine days and succeeding at a stress roll can grant The Gift, open the runes or give another Major Virtue. A vis-based potion can ease the ordeal at a risk.
quotes: he must make an Intelligence + Concentration stress roll, to which he adds the aura bonus or penalty for Magic
If he achieves a total of 24 or more

entries.title: Learning Vitkar Magic
entries.summary: How a master opens the runes for a laering, including the Opening Total and possible deficiencies, and how vitkir study runes from books, teachers, adventures, exposure and raw vis brewed into a potion.
quotes: Opening Total is his Intelligence + Rune Magic + lowest rune + aura

entries.title: Vitkar Magic: How Rune Spells Work
entries.summary: Overview of rune magic: runes inscribed in a material cause true natural changes that last as long as the inscription, do not trigger Magic Resistance, cause Warping, and make the carved object an Arcane Connection to the vitki.
quotes: the target of the rune spell is not considered a magical thing, and does not trigger Magic Resistance
The target also experiences Warping from rune spells of Level 30 or greater, unless the vitki casts the effect on himself.

related.text: ArM5 p.162 Opening the Intangible Tunnel

entries.title: Vitkar Rune Scripts
entries.summary: Vitkir cannot cast spontaneously and must invent rune scripts in advance, each using one of three methods that include the vitki's name and a description of effect and/or target.
quotes: Vitkir typically know many scripts, since they cannot perform their magic spontaneously.

entries.title: Rune Script Method I
entries.summary: A first-person script affecting the vitki or the object the runes are drawn on; it needs only a single rune because the target is implied.
quotes: This formula only requires a single rune, since the target is implied

entries.title: Rune Script Method II
entries.summary: A third-person script affecting some other target with an Arcane Connection or within about ten paces of the runes; uses two runes and the lower of the two scores.
quotes: The vitki always uses the lowest of his scores in these runes

entries.title: Rune Script Method III and Vitkar Lab Total
entries.summary: Method III creates a substitute Arcane Connection to a target. The section also gives the Vitkar Lab Total used to invent rune scripts in a season, and how scripts can be learned from a teacher.
quotes: (lowest) Rune + Intelligence + Rune Magic + Aura Modifier
the vitki gains a number of spell levels equal to his Lab Total

entries.title: Casting Rune Spells
entries.summary: The vitkar casting procedure: inscribe the script, roll the Casting Total against the script level for success or fatigue loss, and adjust for hurried, hidden, emphasised or vis-boosted inscriptions.
quotes: stress die + Stamina + (Iowest) Rune + Aura Modifier
gives him a -5 penalty
increases the Casting Total of the effect by 2 per pawn

entries.title: The Runes: Effects and Bonuses
entries.summary: Introduces the 24 runes as Accelerated Abilities, how rune effects grant non-stacking bonuses or penalties to rolls, and how to convert Hermetic guidelines into rune effects by adding magnitudes.
quotes: a good rule of thumb is to add four magnitudes to the effect

entries.title: Rune Casting Variations
entries.summary: Table of Casting Total modifiers for hiding or omitting the name or description, extra effort, emphasis and vis.
quotes: | Hidden name | -2 |

entries.title: The Older Futhark (Rune Table)
entries.summary: Lists the 24 runes of the Elder Futhark by aett (Freya, Heimdall, Tyr), with each letter, name, meaning and the effects it governs.
quotes: The three aetts of the Elder Futhark are named after three gods

entries.title: Ansuz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Ansuz governs speech, communication and sound, mostly Imaginem or Mentem as a target. Guidelines give Communication bonuses, recognising audible illusions, speech, perceiving Might and surface thoughts.
quotes: The target receives a bonus or penalty equal to the magnitude of the effect to all Ability rolls associated with Communication.

entries.title: Berkanan Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Berkanan is the rune of healing, fertility and youth. Guidelines scale recovery bonuses, fertility control, and healing or preventing the natural healing of Light through Incapacitating wounds.
quotes: recovery rolls equal to (the magnitude of the effect x 3)

entries.title: Dagaz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Dagaz governs time, day-long activities and growth. Guidelines cover bonuses to day-long Ability rolls and Aging rolls, size changes with the sun, rapid maturity and aging.
quotes: Aging rolls equal to the magnitude of the effect

entries.title: Ehwaz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Ehwaz governs horses, mounted combat, speed and trust. Guidelines give bonuses on mounted rolls, Quickness rolls and trust rolls, plus taming, summoning a mount and changing Quickness.
quotes: bonus or penalty equal to the magnitude of the effect on all rolls performed while mounted

entries.title: Fehu Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Fehu governs common wealth such as cattle, silver and grain. Guidelines give bonuses to wealth-gaining Ability rolls, detect precious metal or domestic animals, and summon wealth.
quotes: Ability rolls that support the target gaining wealth

entries.title: Gebo Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Gebo governs gifts, debt and obligation, and acts as a Mentem influence. Guidelines give social-influence bonuses and escalating levels of deference, simple and complex commands, and domination.
quotes: bonus or penalty equal to the magnitude of this effect on all Ability rolls to influence others

entries.title: Hagalaz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Hagalaz governs destructive weather and hail, mostly Auram or Aquam. Guidelines give Damage bonuses, a general hail attack and summoning or intensifying storms.
quotes: inflicting damage equal to a stress die + (the Level of the effect – 15)

entries.title: Isa Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Isa governs ice, cold and cold emotions. Guidelines give bonuses to cold-related rolls, a chilling Damage effect, freezing or melting water, apathy, holding a target motionless and icing a surface.
quotes: Chill a target, doing Damage equal to (the level of the effect – 20)

entries.title: Jera Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Jera governs harvest and year-long endeavours, mostly Herbam. Guidelines give a bonus to year-long activities paid out at year end, immunity to supernatural disease, lasting health and summoning food and drink.
quotes: year-long activities, so long as the rune lasts for the entire year
Target is immune to supernatural diseases of up to this effect

entries.title: Kauno Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Kauno governs fire, heat, fever and burning pain. Guidelines give disease-related roll bonuses, a scale of burning Damage per round by level and flammability, and illnesses from sores up to terminal that block natural healing.
quotes: recovery rolls due to sickness and disease equal to
This does +5 Damage to the target or anything touching it each round.

entries.title: Laguz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Laguz governs water, especially the ocean, mostly Aquam. Guidelines give bonuses to rolls in or on water, seeing through water, summoning water, breathing water, speeding sea journeys and waves.
quotes: Ability rolls performed while submerged in or floating upon water

entries.title: Mannaz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Mannaz governs mankind and cooperation, usually Corpus, and is often used to target a person for another rune. Guidelines give Dexterity and group-work bonuses, cooperation, and Dexterity changes.
quotes: Ability rolls that involve Dexterity (but not Attack rolls)

entries.title: Naudiz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Naudiz governs hardship and need. Guidelines give bonuses when in great need, a bonus or penalty on retried Abilities, delaying another supernatural effect, binding an active rune spell, and despair that blocks Confidence.
quotes: Bind an active rune spell of Level less than or equal to this one

entries.title: Ingwaz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Ingwaz governs family, home and security, tied to Herbam, Terram or Corpus. Guidelines give bonuses to family and household rolls, sensing family, easy childbirth and summoning a person.
quotes: Ability rolls that affect his family, household, or home

entries.title: Othila Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Othila governs inherited property such as lands and heirlooms, tied to Terram. Guidelines give bonuses to rolls using a specific heirloom tool, improving an object to exceptional quality, and summoning small objects.
quotes: The object functions as if it were exceptional quality, and reduces the number of potential botch dice by two when used.

entries.title: Perth Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Perth governs chance, secrets and the supernatural, tied to Vim. Guidelines give bonuses on chance rolls, adjusting botch dice, dispelling weaker effects, and sensing auras, vis and magic users.
quotes: the number of potential botch dice is reduced or increased by the magnitude of this effect
less than or equal to half this effect

entries.title: Raido Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Raido governs travel, carts, ships and planning. Guidelines give bonuses to travel Ability rolls, Stamina-based rolls and Initiative, repairs, sense of direction, doubling travel speed, Stamina changes and summoning large objects.
quotes: all Ability rolls made while traveling, such as Area Lore, Folk Ken, Ride, or Charm

entries.title: Sowilo Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Sowilo governs light and the sun, tied to Ignem and the Divine. Guidelines give Perception bonuses, seeing through illusions, darkvision, sensing auras, darkness, invisibility, cold resistance and sunlight.
quotes: natural Ability rolls associated with Perception

entries.title: Tiwaz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Tiwaz governs truth, justice and battle for companions, tied to Mentem. Guidelines give bonuses to positive Personality rolls and Attack or Defense, a Confidence boost, and sensing people, motives, and lies.
quotes: as long as his Confidence Score is no greater than (the magnitude of this effect – 3)

entries.title: Thurisaz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Thurisaz governs ogres, thorns, evil and shapeshifting, tied to Vim and Herbam. Guidelines give bonuses to negative Personality rolls, reducing supernatural Might, brambles, destroying plants and transformations between living and nonliving things.
quotes: Might Score is reduced by (the level of this effect – 10)

entries.title: Uruz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Uruz governs strength, endurance and wild animals, tied to Animal and Auram. Guidelines give Strength bonuses, Encumbrance changes, immunity to lesser mind effects, Strength changes and summoning wild animals by Size at escalating levels.
quotes: The target's Encumbrance is increased or decreased by the magnitude of this effect

entries.title: Wunjo Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Wunjo governs joy, comfort and glory, a Mentem rune for emotions. Guidelines give Presence-based bonuses, reducing Fatigue or Wound Penalties, powerful emotions, ignoring all such penalties and Presence changes.
quotes: Wound Penalties by (the magnitude of this effect x 3)

entries.title: Ihwaz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Ihwaz governs yew trees, bows, the dead and graves. Guidelines give Intelligence bonuses, sensing and summoning supernatural beings by Might, sensing plants and corpses, animating and summoning corpses, speaking with the dead and summoning a tree.
quotes: Summon a supernatural being with Might Score less than or equal to (the level of this effect – 10).

entries.title: Algiz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Algiz is the protection rune, used with a secondary rune. Guidelines adjust Soak and ward away supernatural targets or things of the secondary rune.
quotes: Soak is increased or decreased by the effect

entries.title: Modified Runes (Younger Futhark and Futhorc)
entries.requires: Tradition: Vitkir (Younger Futhark or Anglo-Saxon Futhorc)
entries.summary: Variant rune alphabets that use the same magic system: the Younger Futhark has fewer runes, so fewer are opened at the start; the Futhorc has more characters, which dilutes experience and power.
quotes: The magic of the Younger Futhark uses only 16 of the 24 runes (as shown in the insert)

entries.title: Hermetic Integration of Rune Magic
entries.summary: Optional rule: investigating vitkir and runes can become a Major Breakthrough giving a Rune Duration and Inscription Target, and Odin's Sacrifice may give an automatic Discovery. Notes the Order's enmity toward the vitkir.
quotes: the magus receives a new Rune Duration and a new Inscription Target

entries.title: The Anglo-Saxon Futhorc
entries.summary: Reference table of the extended Anglo-Saxon rune alphabet, giving each rune's name, pronunciation, meaning and the Elder Futhark rune it corresponds to, with five runes that have no Elder equivalent.
quotes: Scholars agree that it included the first 28 runes

entries.title: The Younger Futhark
entries.summary: Reference table for the 16-rune Younger Futhark, listing the Elder Futhark runes that are missing and how each remaining rune maps to its Elder equivalent.
quotes: the runemasters eventually settled on a set of 16 runes instead of the original 24

gated.title: Faerie wizards
gated.intro: Faerie rites, methods, powers and bargains.

entries.title: Faerie Wizardry Overview
entries.summary: Introduces faerie wizards, or faerie hedge wizards, who use faerie rites and faerie bargaining, and the traditions that teach their Abilities and Arts.

entries.title: Charms
entries.summary: Explains how a Virtue can be tied to a secret faerie charm through the Charm Flaws, how the charm is lost if shared, and which Virtues may be charmed.
quotes: The Virtue must affect what the character can do, not who he is.
if other characters become party to the charm, the power vanishes like mist in the sunlight

entries.title: Folk Charms
entries.summary: Hedge-magic charm that ends a faerie effect, rolled with Intelligence and Faerie Lore, at the cost of a Fatigue level and a Warping point.
quotes: stress die + Intelligence + Faerie Lore + aura
Activating a folk charm costs a Fatigue level and gives the character a point of Warping.

entries.title: Hermetic Charms
entries.requires: Sympathy Trait gained from exposure to the Faerie realm
entries.summary: Lets a magus apply Sympathy Traits to Hermetic Abilities, Lab Totals, talisman attunement and charmed devices, and treat the work as a Magic or Faerie effect for Realm Interaction.
quotes: Sympathy Traits can be used as specializations to boost Abilities used to perform Hermetic magic, including Penetration and Magic Theory.
he may add the value of any of his Sympathy Traits that are appropriate to the shape or material to his Lab Total

entries.title: Examples of Charmed Virtues
entries.summary: Sidebar giving example Virtues with the charm that activates each.

entries.title: Faerie Virtues and Flaws
entries.summary: Explains that a Supernatural Virtue can be designated as having a Faerie origin, which gives it the Faerie bonuses on the Realm Interaction Table and spares the character Warping from living in a Faerie aura; notes Benediction and Malediction as typical faerie gifts and curses.
quotes: characters with a Faerie Virtue or Flaw do not gain Warping from living in a Faerie aura.

related.text: ArM5 pp.54-55 Greater and Lesser Malediction

entries.title: Faerie Ceremony
entries.summary: A Faerie Supernatural Ability that lets a group join a focus character in a faerie effect, adding a group modifier and each participant's Characteristic plus Ability or Method to the focus character's total.
quotes: Group Modifier: total Ceremony scores – number of participants

entries.title: Curse-Throwing
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to cure diseases, lift curses and dispel harmful effects by transferring them to another person, with a Casting Total against an Ease Factor by affliction type, ritual time, Penetration and modifiers for how the recipient is represented; includes a worked example.
quotes: Curse-Throwing Casting Total: Presence + Curse-Throwing + Aura + stress die
Penetration Total: Casting Total – Ease Factor + Penetration Bonus

entries.title: Learning Faerie Abilities
entries.requires: Strong alignment to the Faerie realm (Sympathy Traits and Faerie Rank)
entries.summary: Describes how characters aligned to Faerie learn Faerie Supernatural Abilities and Arts like Gifted characters learn Magic Abilities, with experience limited by Faerie Rank and easier study of a tradition's four Favored Abilities.
quotes: the sum of the character's strongest positive and negative Sympathy Traits must equal at least 5 at the start of the season for him to learn a new Ability in this way

related.text: ArM5 p.166 Gifted characters learning Magic Abilities

entries.title: Faerie Doctors as Mythic Companions
entries.summary: Character-building rules for playing a faerie doctor, either as a Mythic Companion with the Faerie Doctor Special Virtue and doubled Virtue points per Flaw, or as a Gifted or ordinary character, with compulsory Virtues and Flaws and Favored Abilities.
quotes: receives 2 points to spend on Virtues for every point he spends on Flaws

related.text: ArM5 p.28 Virtue and Flaw balance

entries.title: Homunculi Wizards
entries.requires: Flaw: Homunculus Wizard (character with The Gift)
entries.summary: Explains hedge wizards who gain a faerie version of The Gift through a bond with a homunculus: what they can do, their dependence on feeding and hiding the homunculus, and how to build one as a character.
quotes: To play a Homunculus Wizard as a character, take The Gift and the Homunculus Wizard Flaw during character creation.

related.text: House Merinita outer mystery of Faerie Magic

entries.title: Rites of Faerie
entries.requires: Faerie Method, Faerie Power and Sympathy Trait
entries.summary: Introduces faerie rites, spontaneous spell-like effects that faerie wizards focus through a Faerie Method and Power.

entries.title: Performing Faerie Rites
entries.requires: Faerie Method, Faerie Power and Sympathy Trait
entries.summary: Procedure for casting a faerie rite: the stress die plus Characteristic, Method, Power and aura gives the level, capped by the applicable Sympathy Traits, with rules for negative Traits, botches, experience, ritual-level rites and the lack of permanent effects.
quotes: Rite Casting Total: stress die + Characteristic + Method + Power + aura modifier
Maximum Rite Level: (Sympathy Traits x 5)

related.text: ArM5 pp.111-114 Hermetic Ranges, Durations and Targets

entries.title: Hermetic Rites
entries.summary: Allows a magus with a Faerie Method and Power to design Hermetic rituals using faerie rite guidelines and the special Faerie Ranges, Durations and Targets, using Method and Power in place of Artes Liberales and Philosophiae.
quotes: the caster may add his scores in the Method and Power instead of Artes Liberales and Philosophiae to his Casting Total

entries.title: Faerie Ranges, Durations, and Targets
entries.requires: Faerie wizard: Faerie Method, Faerie Power and Sympathy Trait
entries.summary: Sidebar of extra Ranges (Crossroads, Presence, Prop, Symbol), Durations (Held, Focus, While, Geas, Hour + 1, Midday/Midnight, Not, Season, Aura, Faerie, Hidden, If, Symbol) and Targets (Medium, Passion, Symbol) available to faerie rites, with their equivalent spell levels and conditions.
quotes: Anyone with a total of 6 or higher is affected.

related.text: ArM5 pp.111-114 Hermetic Ranges, Durations, Targets
ArM5 pp.92-93 House Merinita Faerie Magic

entries.title: Faerie Methods
entries.requires: Faerie wizard: Faerie Method, Faerie Power and Sympathy Trait
entries.summary: Explains that Methods are Supernatural Abilities used with a Faerie Power to perform a rite, and gives guidance for designing new Methods with a Characteristic, a cost and an advantage.

entries.title: Evocation (Faerie Method)
entries.summary: Faerie Method using Communication that calls on faerie patrons at the cost of a Warping Point or Confidence Point, and lets the user add vis to any rite for a bonus with a limit and botch risk.
quotes: with each pawn spent increasing his Rite Casting Total by 2.

entries.title: Enchantment (Faerie Method)
entries.summary: Faerie Method using Presence in which the user performs an Ability roll against an Ease Factor tied to the intended magnitude, building up a bonus over several rounds before casting the rite; can also roll a simple die to avoid botching.
quotes: making a roll against an Ease Factor of (the magnitude of the intended effect x 3)

entries.title: Empathy (Faerie Method)
entries.summary: Faerie Method using Stamina that requires spending a Fatigue level on a lengthy trance ritual, and lets the user spend more Fatigue to extend the rite, reset bonus limits and multiply the effect cap from Sympathy Traits.
quotes: Empathy allows him to effectively double the value of the Sympathy Traits that determine his effect level

entries.title: Faerie Powers
entries.requires: Faerie wizard: Faerie Method, Faerie Power and Sympathy Trait
entries.summary: Explains that Faerie Powers are Supernatural Abilities used only with a Faerie Method, and that each Power has a vulnerability chosen when it is gained.
quotes: Every Faerie Power is vulnerable to certain uncommon circumstances, such as when touching iron, running water, or salt, when in the Dominion, or when repeating the character's name three times.

entries.title: Beguile (Faerie Power)
entries.summary: Faerie Power for commanding targets or altering their memories, perceptions and emotions; any Sympathy Trait appropriate to the memory, emotion or perception can apply.

entries.title: Beguile Guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guideline table by level for Beguile effects: altering memories, perceptions and emotions, planting suggestions, commands and total control.
quotes: Completely control the target, including its movement and communication.

entries.title: Conjure (Faerie Power)
entries.summary: Faerie Power creating solid glamours or transforming a target into something else; the caster needs Sympathy Traits for both the original and new forms, and glamours can defy ordinary space and end unpredictably.

entries.title: Conjure Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Conjure effects: extra magnitudes for intricate or controllable glamours and for changing animate to inanimate, conjuring faeries, and changing targets into glamours by Size.
quotes: Conjure a faerie with Faerie Might equal to the base level of this effect.

entries.title: Dream (Faerie Power)
entries.summary: Faerie Power for perceiving things from outside one's body and glimpsing the future; includes advice for storyguides on handling prophetic visions as vague good or bad omens tied to a symbol.

entries.title: Dream Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Dream effects: remote senses, mental communication, understanding speech, reading thoughts and memories, and answering questions about the likely future over increasing time spans.
quotes: Treat the target as if it possessed the Premonitions Ability for the duration, with a score of (the base level of this effect / 5).

entries.title: Grant (Faerie Power)
entries.summary: Faerie Power for blessing or cursing a target with Warping Points, temporary Virtues and Flaws, or temporary Sympathy Traits that cannot be increased and do not affect Faerie Rank.

related.text: Chapter 5: Touches of Faerie, Charms and Sympathetic Influence

entries.title: Grant Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Grant effects: restoring Faerie Might, giving the target a power, temporary Sympathy Traits, Warping Points, temporary Virtues and Flaws, and temporary Faerie auras or regiones.
quotes: The target faerie regains a number of Faerie Might Points equal to (the base level of this effect + 5) for the duration.

entries.title: Portage (Faerie Power)
entries.summary: Faerie Power for instant travel by faerie trods, moving the target and what is attached to it from one place to another.

entries.title: Portage Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Portage effects: moving targets through regio boundaries into or out of the Faerie Realm by level, instant transport to Sympathy Trait objects, and changes to movement speed and Fatigue.
quotes: Transport the target through a regio boundary to a regio with a level less than or equal to ((the base level of this effect + 15) / 5).

entries.title: Ware (Faerie Power)
entries.summary: Faerie Power for protecting a target with wards against chosen things; wards often need a second Sympathy Trait describing what is warded against, both used for the maximum level, and must penetrate Magic Resistance.
quotes: Use both of these Traits to determine the maximum level of the effect.

entries.title: Ware Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Ware effects: suppressing supernatural effects, wards against things by Might limit depending on the caster's positive, negative or any Sympathy Traits, and bonuses to Soak and Defense.
quotes: Ward the target against anything associated with one of the caster's positive Sympathy Traits, with Faerie Might no greater than (the base level of this effect + 20).

entries.title: Weal (Faerie Power)
entries.summary: Faerie Power that alters natural healing and aging for the duration, speeding recovery or slowing aging; cannot return a character to childhood.
quotes: This effect cannot cause a character to revert to childhood, nor can it affect a character who has not yet reached physical maturity.

entries.title: Weal Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Weal effects: bonuses and penalties to Recovery and Aging rolls, healing wounds for the duration, shortening wound recovery intervals, and reducing apparent age.
quotes: Give the target a bonus to Recovery rolls and a penalty to Aging rolls, or a bonus to Aging rolls and a penalty to Recovery rolls, equal to ((3 + magnitude) x 3)

entries.title: Woe (Faerie Power)
entries.summary: Faerie Power for inflicting wounds, Fatigue loss, aging and slowed healing that vanish when the effect ends.

entries.title: Woe Guidelines
entries.summary: Guideline table for Woe effects: penalties to Recovery or Aging rolls, Fatigue loss, wounds at each severity for the duration, lengthened wound recovery intervals and forced Aging rolls.
quotes: Give the target a penalty to Recovery or Aging rolls equal to ((3 + magnitude) x 3).

entries.title: Faerie Bargaining (Ars Fabulosa)
entries.requires: Faerie Bargaining: one of the Virtues Summoning, Bonding, Captivating or Dismissing
entries.summary: Introduces the Ars Fabulosa, the hedge art of bargaining with faeries through four powers (Summoning, Bonding, Captivating, Dismissing) that start at score 0, increase like Arts, and are learned as Supernatural Abilities or from Virtues.
quotes: There are four powers associated with bargaining: Summoning, Bonding, Captivating, and Dismissing.

related.text: Chapter 5: Touches of Faerie, Learning Faerie Abilities

entries.title: Summoning (Faerie Bargaining)
entries.summary: Procedure for summoning a faerie: Sympathy Traits cap the Might that can be summoned, a Fatigue level is spent, a Summoning Total is rolled against the faerie's Might and Magic Resistance, and success holds the faerie to listen and bargain; covers botches, specific faeries, failure, and the experience and penalty for keeping or breaking a bargain.
quotes: Summoning Total: stress die + Presence + Summoning + Faerie Rank + aura Maximum Might
The sum of these Traits, multiplied by 5, determines the maximum Might Score that the character can summon.

entries.title: Summoning Faeries
entries.summary: Sidebar comparing the other Summoning arts that can call faeries or spirits: (Spirit) Summoning, (Elemental) Summoning and Sihr.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal pp.114-115

entries.title: Bonding (Faerie Bargaining)
entries.summary: Power forming a mystic bond with a faerie, using a Bonding Total against the faerie's Might and Magic Resistance, which lets the bearer use the faerie's Characteristics, powers, a shared enchanted effect, or protections from Warping and hardship; bonds to objects need a charm and only one bond can be held at a time.
quotes: Bonding Total: stress die + Communication + Bonding + Faerie Rank + aura
Maximum Might Score: (Sympathy Traits x 5)

entries.title: Faerie Bargains
entries.requires: Faerie Bargaining: one of the Virtues Summoning, Bonding, Captivating or Dismissing
entries.summary: Guidance on conducting a bargaining session with a faerie: working out what it wants with Intelligence + Faerie Lore, roleplaying etiquette, a contested roll to resolve a stalled session, and typical offers and requests.
quotes: you can quickly resolve the bargaining session with a contested Communication + Bargain roll, modified by the character's Faerie Rank.

entries.title: Captivating (Faerie Bargaining)
entries.summary: Power for exchanging places with a faerie, with a Captivating Total against the faerie's Might and Magic Resistance; covers what is exchanged, struggles for dominance, and the Warping Points gained.
quotes: Captivating Total: stress die + Perception + Captivating + Faerie Rank + aura

entries.title: Dismissing (Faerie Bargaining)
entries.summary: Power for cancelling effects made by beings with Might, ending effects on them, or releasing them from supernatural agreements, using a Dismissing Total limited by Sympathy Traits; can deflect powers and dismiss several effects with a cumulative penalty.
quotes: Dismissing Total: stress die + Intelligence + Dismissing + Faerie Rank + aura

entries.title: Pagan Traditions
entries.summary: Introduces faerie hedge wizard traditions, with Favored Abilities that are easier to learn, Initiation Scripts, and the minimum Virtue points and Sympathy Traits needed to build a starting faerie wizard.
quotes: the player must devote at least four points of the character's starting Virtues to a Faerie Method and a Faerie Power

related.text: Chapter 5: Touches of Faerie, Learning Supernatural Abilities

entries.title: Borrowers
entries.summary: Faerie bargaining tradition of travelling traders who sell goods to faeries; Favored Arts are Summoning, Bonding, Captivating and Dismissing.
quotes: Summoning, Bonding, Captivating, Dismissing

entries.title: Ollamhain
entries.summary: Irish poet-sage tradition of faerie wizardry; Favored Abilities are Enchantment, Beguile, Dream and Portage.
quotes: Enchantment, Beguile, Dream, Portage

entries.title: Volkhvy
entries.summary: Russian pagan faerie wizards who work communal rites; Favored Abilities are Evocation, Ceremony, Conjure and Grant.
quotes: Evocation, Ceremony, Conjure, Grant

entries.title: Wise Folk
entries.summary: Village wise men and women who ward off the supernatural and mend or injure; Favored Abilities are Empathy, Ware, Weal and Woe.
quotes: Empathy, Ware, Weal, Woe

gated.title: Holy traditions
gated.intro: Holy magic and the holy traditions.

entries.title: Holy Tradition: Ascetics
entries.summary: A sample generic holy tradition of ascetics, with its favored Abilities and ethos.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Adjuration, Cursing, Purity, Second Sight

entries.title: Holy Tradition: The Cantores
entries.summary: Christian holy tradition of musician-worshippers with Blessing, Enchanting Music, Holy Music and Intervention as favored Abilities.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Blessing, Enchanting Music, Holy Music, Intervention

entries.title: Holy Societas: The Priory of Saint Nerius
entries.requires: Holy Societas: Priory of Saint Nerius
entries.summary: A secret monastic Hermetic holy societas with Holy Magic, Intervention, Premonitions and Purity as favored Abilities; all members take the Monastic Vows (Hermetic) Flaw.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Holy Magic, Intervention, Premonitions, Purity
All Nerusians take the Monastic Vows (Hermetic) Flaw.

entries.title: Holy Tradition: Sufis
entries.summary: Describes the Sufi holy tradition, its favored Abilities and its group dhikr and sama' meditation rituals, whose benefits are boosted by a shaykh's Ceremony Ability.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Ceremony, Meditation, Transcendence, Understanding
their shaykhs will often possess the Ceremony Ability, which enables them to synchronize their efforts in order to reach higher degrees of understanding.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine, Blessed by God, New Abilities (Ceremony)

entries.title: Holy Societas: Zoroastrians
entries.summary: Describes the Zoroastrian holy societas of Magoi, including favored Abilities, taboos of purity, and its link to Holy Magic and Hermetic House Flambeau.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Invocation, Holy Magic, Sense Holiness and Unholiness, Wonders
These spells require Holy Magic to cast and are only taught to members of the tradition.

entries.title: (Immortal)'s Blessing (Zoroastrian Ritual)
entries.requires: Tradition: Holy Societas Zoroastrians; Holy Magic
entries.summary: A non-Hermetic holy ritual giving a bonus to the next spell cast, with seven versions tied to an Immortal, a Personality trait and a Form; the bonus is capped by the caster's trait.
quotes: Your score in this Personality trait (or a closely related trait), multiplied by ten, determines the maximum bonus granted by this ritual.

entries.title: Saoshyant's Elixir (Zoroastrian Ritual)
entries.requires: Tradition: Holy Societas Zoroastrians; Holy Magic
entries.summary: A non-Hermetic holy ritual of eternal life: after an ordeal and sacrifice the caster stops aging rolls and cannot die while strictly following Zoroastrianism, at the cost of accumulating Warping points.
quotes: Drink this, and for as long as you strictly follow Zoroastrianism, you do not have to make aging rolls and cannot die.

related.text: ArM5 p.181 Injuries, Heat and Corrosion

entries.title: Holy Tradition: Ba'al Shem
entries.summary: The tradition of itinerant Jewish folk magicians who make amulets and give blessings, with its favored Abilities and note that Initiations grant extra Methods and Powers.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Adjuration, Blessing, Craft Amulets, and Invocation

entries.title: Holy Societates: Karaites
entries.summary: Describes Karaite Gifted magi who may join the Order if their magic is Holy Magic; lists required Flaws and favored Abilities, and the restriction on taking apprentices.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Craft Amulets, Holy Magic, Merkavah, Transcendence
Hermetic Karaites can only take Gifted apprentices from within their own religion.

entries.title: The Ba'al Ov (Jewish Summoning Tradition)
entries.summary: A Jewish necromantic tradition that uses the Summoning, Commanding and Binding Goetic Arts, forcing spirits to manifest through objects such as corpses and skulls rather than simple circles.
quotes: use the Summoning, Commanding, and Binding Goetic Arts as presented in Realms of Power: The Infernal, pages 114–119.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal, pp.114-119

entries.title: Christian Mysticism
entries.requires: Character aligned with the Divine realm
entries.summary: Introduces the mystic as a personal, non-institutional path to God, distinguishes contemplative and monistic mysticism and their dangers, and states that mystics must be Divine-aligned and that their Warping takes the form of Divine Ascent.
quotes: Both forms of mysticism require the character to be aligned with the Divine realm.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine Holy Traditions

entries.title: Experiencing Divine Ascent
entries.summary: A Divine-aligned character who gains enough Warping Points in a single event rolls to resist Divine Ascent, and on a failure undergoes Divine Form (contemplatives) or Divine Gloom (monistics) and takes extra Warping Points equal to the margin of failure.
quotes: Presence + Concentration (or Meditation) + Stress die vs. Warping Score + Warping Points gained + True Faith Score local aura + stress die (no botch)

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine p.63 Divine Ascent

entries.title: Personality Traits, Sins, and Tempers
entries.requires: Divine-aligned characters and mystics (Sinful Traits and Tempers)
entries.summary: Groups Personality Traits into paired Sins and Tempers, lets a trait be annotated with its Sin or Temper, and explains that a trait's value counts negatively for the opposed one.
quotes: When dealing with opposing tempers or sins, treat the trait's value as negative.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine p.40 Sins and Tempers

entries.title: Contemplative Mysticism
entries.requires: Positive Pious Personality Trait; association with the Divine realm; no Sinful Personality Traits
entries.summary: Describes the contemplative path of imitating Christ and sets its entry requirements: a positive Pious trait, no Sinful traits and an association with the Divine realm.
quotes: the mystic must possess a positive Pious Personality Trait score

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine p.40 Sinful Personality Traits

entries.title: Divine Warping and the Contemplative Mystic
entries.requires: Contemplative mystic who has suffered Divine Form
entries.summary: Summarizes the permanent changes of Divine Form for a contemplative mystic: added Magic Resistance, a Soak bonus, a Penetration bonus, extra botch dice for impious acts, automatic wounds for sin and a continuous Commanding Aura.
quotes: The character gains a Penetration Bonus equal to her Warping Score, with an additional bonus equal to her (True Faith Score multiplied by 5).
The character gains a bonus to physical Soak totals equal to the Magic Resistance Total divided by 5

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine p.64 Divine Form

entries.title: Spiritual Paths and Revelations
entries.summary: A contemplative mystic gains new Virtues, Methods, Powers or Supernatural Abilities by following a Spiritual Path: a Path Total is set by the Revelation sought, reduced by the character's Pious score to a Path Target, and met by completing Quest Components of listed values.
quotes: Path Target = Path Total – score in Personality Trait Pious
Total Quest Component Values = Path Total

entries.title: Monistic Mysticism
entries.requires: Flaw: Visions or Major Virtue: True Faith; positive Pious trait; association with the Divine realm
entries.summary: Describes the monistic path, its entry requirements, and its Twilight-Prone-like effect that a single Warping Point forces a test for Divine Ascent, so the mystic learns from Warping experiences rather than Spiritual Paths.
quotes: requires the mystic to possess either the Flaw Visions or the Major Virtue True Faith

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine p.63 Divine Gloom

entries.title: Advantages of Pursuing Monistic Mysticism
entries.summary: Monistic mystics gain extra experience from practising Holy Abilities (equal to Concentration) and, after Divine Ascent, may roll to integrate a Revelation and choose a benefit such as keeping mundane experience, a new Virtue, substituting Dominion Lore for another Realm Lore, or accepting the Infernal as subordinate to the Divine.
quotes: Intelligence + Concentration + stress die vs. Warping Score + stress die (no botch)
gains experience points equal to her Concentration Ability score rather than 4 experience points

entries.title: Divine Warping and the Monistic Mystic
entries.requires: Monistic mystic who has suffered Divine Gloom
entries.summary: Summarizes Divine Gloom for a monistic mystic: Warping Points convert into experience in Dominion Lore and Holy Abilities at the cost of mundane Ability experience, with a bonus against Celestial Disorientation and attraction of supernatural beings.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine p.63 Divine Gloom
Realms of Power: The Divine p.14 Celestial Disorientation

entries.title: Improving True Faith
entries.summary: True Faith can only be gained or raised through a story and a troupe decision, and higher scores grant extra abilities such as dispelling illusions, doubled Magic Resistance against Mentem, and an Empyreal Aura.
quotes: At True Faith 3, the character gains double Magic Resistance against Mentem spells and similar supernatural powers, and adds +6 instead of +3 to a die roll for each Faith Point spent.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine pp.56-63 True Faith
Realms of Power: The Divine p.12 Empyreal Aura

entries.title: Mystics (female religious)
entries.requires: Visions Flaw, or True Faith with the Understanding power
entries.summary: Explains how to represent a religious mystic in game terms: usually the Visions Flaw, or occasionally True Faith with Understanding and Meditation. Also covers how a bishop's (or pope's) acceptance of a nun's visions earns her a Reputation as a mystic.
quotes: In most case, the experiences of a religious mystic are covered by the Visions Flaw.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine pp.34, 36, 37, 54

entries.title: False Visions
entries.summary: Guidance for storyguides on non-divine sources of apparent visions (Spirits of Deceit, deluded or feigning individuals, Magic auras, faeries) and on the difficulty of proving a vision genuine, including a magus investigating inside a Dominion aura.
quotes: It can be very difficult to prove whether or not a particular mystical experience is genuinely divine.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal p.38

entries.title: Holy Tradition: Franciscans
entries.requires: Tradition: Franciscans (Franciscan friar or Poor Sister)
entries.summary: Treats the Franciscans as a Holy Tradition whose members can develop supernatural Abilities under the guidance of experienced Franciscans. Lists the favored Abilities and restricts membership to friars and Poor Sisters.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Intervention, Meditation, Purity, Understanding.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine p.47

entries.title: Joining the Franciscan Tradition
entries.summary: How a character becomes a member of the Franciscan tradition, either at character creation (supernatural Virtues balanced by Flaws, with Monastic Vows compulsory) or in play through an invitation from a Mystagogue.
quotes: the Supernatural Virtues that bestow the favored Abilities must be balanced by Flaws in the conventional manner, and Monastic Vows is compulsory.

entries.title: Franciscan Initiation Scripts
entries.summary: Introduces the available Franciscan Initiation Scripts, which retrace formative experiences in Francis' life, and notes that two of them need a season at Francis' cave near Assisi. The Mystagogue must know the Virtue being granted.
quotes: All require that the Mystagogue knows the Virtue to be gained.

entries.title: Franciscan Initiation: Meditation
entries.summary: Initiation script for the Meditation Virtue: a season of solitary prayer in Francis' cave, with a Quest and Major Ordeal, granting the Meditation Virtue and the Driven Flaw. Gives the Initiation Total, Script Bonus and Sympathy bonus.
quotes: Initiation Total 21, Script Bonus 15: Major Ordeal (9) + Quest (3) + Sympathy bonus: Path of the Founder (3).

related.text: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults p.59 (Psychodrama)
