entries.title: Franciscan Initiation: Understanding
entries.summary: Initiation script for the Understanding Virtue: a Quest for an old Byzantine crucifix followed by a vigil and vision at the chapel of Saint Damien, granting the Understanding Virtue and the Visions Flaw. An unworthy Initiate gains Plagued by Supernatural Entity instead.
quotes: Initiation Total 12 (21 - 9 for previous Major Ordeal), Script Bonus 7: Minor Ordeal (3) + Quest (3) + Sympathy bonus: Path of the Founder (1).

entries.title: Franciscan Initiation: Intervention
entries.summary: Initiation script for the Intervention Virtue: a winter season of study with the Mystagogue, a barefoot journey in rags to work as a scullion, and a trip to Rome to obtain a papal blessing without asking for it. Gives the Initiation Total and Script Bonus breakdown.
quotes: Initiation Total 15 (21 - 6 for previous Major Ordeal; Script Bonus 9: Time and place (1) + Initiate's time (1) + Mystagogue's time (3) + Quest (3) + Sympathy bonus: Path of the Founder (1).

entries.title: Franciscan Initiation: Purity
entries.summary: Initiation script for the Purity Virtue: a season of fasting in rags in Francis' cave, counted as an Ordeal that permanently harms the Initiate's constitution, with troupe-played temptations forming a Quest. Grants the Purity Virtue and the Fragile Constitution Flaw.
quotes: Initiation Total 18 (21 - 3 for previous Major Ordeal), Script Bonus 9: Quest (3) + Minor Ordeal (3) + Sympathy bonus: Path of the Founder (3).

entries.title: Franciscan Script Variations
entries.summary: Explains that Francis, guided by angelic advice, tailors the Initiation Scripts to each candidate, and that other Mystagogues may unknowingly use unsuitable Scripts. This deliberately bends the standard Mystery rules to vary Initiates' Flaws.
quotes: This bends the rules set out in The Mysteries: Revised Edition

entries.title: Holy Magic (overview)
entries.summary: Introduces holy magic, a form of Hermetic-derived magic aligned wholly with God, which requires a magus to relearn much of their craft.

entries.title: Holy Magic Summary
entries.summary: Quick summary list of the restrictions and benefits of practicing holy magic.

entries.title: Holy Magic: Restrictions
entries.summary: Holy magi must relearn spells via the Holy Magic Ability, halve lab totals from Hermetic sources, forgo Hermetic words and gestures (offset by prayer), cannot use magic to sin, and draw Infernal and Faerie attention.
quotes: This is usually a –15 penalty
This requires that they roll a simple die + Presence + Theology of 15+
their lab totals must always be halved when learning magic from a Hermetic source

entries.title: Holy Magic: Benefits
entries.summary: Holy magi are attuned to Divine and Magic auras, may cast spells using miracle guidelines, substitute long-term fatigue for vis in rituals, do lab work in the Dominion, and use new Ranges, Durations and Targets.
quotes: Each Fatigue level spent during a ritual is equivalent to as many as three pawns of vis of an appropriate Art

entries.title: Holy Ranges, Durations, and Targets
entries.summary: New spell Range, Duration and Target categories for holy magic (such as Presence, Communion, Recitation, Office, Sabbath, Grace, Sin, Faith, Dominion), each equated to an existing Hermetic parameter for spell level.
quotes: For the purposes of calculating spell levels, this range is the same as Voice.
Dominion (Target): This is the same level as Boundary

entries.title: Holy Societates
entries.summary: Holy Societates are traditions that teach Holy Magic as a favored Ability and can train both Gifted and unGifted characters.

entries.title: Holy Societas: Sol Invictus
entries.summary: Sample holy societas listing favored Abilities, history and beliefs of the Invicti, a Hermetic society practicing holy magic.

entries.title: Ars Notoria (overview)
entries.summary: Introduces the Notory Art of King Solomon, a Christian system of orations and figures (notae) combined into rings that grant divinely given knowledge and abilities; only Gifted Christians can use it.

entries.title: Finding a Text of the Ars Notoria
entries.summary: A character can seek a copy of the Ars Notoria through a story or, less entertainingly, spend a season rolling Intelligence + Divine Lore against a high Ease Factor; a botch turns up some other book.
quotes: FINDING A COPY OF ARS NOTORIA: Intelligence + Divine Lore + stress die vs. an Ease Factor of 21

entries.title: Studying the Ars Notoria
entries.summary: Learning the Ability from the text requires reading four languages and Artes Liberales, a Gifted reader and the normal rules for learning a Supernatural Ability; starting characters must take it as a Major Supernatural Virtue.
quotes: The reader needs a 4 in each Language to accurately read the book.
The Ars Notoria text is treated as a tractatus with a Quality of 20.

entries.title: Ars Notoria: Future Study
entries.summary: Ars Notoria is increased by study like other Abilities; glosses help with understanding but cannot teach the Ability initially.

entries.title: The Rings of Solomon (recitation rules)
entries.summary: Explains how rings are recited: a recitation score plus a stress die against an Ease Factor depending on ring level and duration, season-long first recitations, learning rings in order, no stacking of benefits, and tracking temporary experience.
quotes: RECITATION SCORE: Intelligence + Ars Notoria + Modifier
FIRST RECITATION OF AN ARS NOTORIA RING: Ease Factor = 6 + 3 times level of ring + 1 per season of desired duration
SUBSEQUENT RECITATIONS OF A KNOWN ARS NOTORIA RING: Ease Factor = 3 + 3 times level of ring + 1 per season of desired duration

entries.title: Ars Notoria Modifiers
entries.summary: Table of modifiers to the recitation score for behavior such as fasting, chastity, personality Flaws, sins and conflicting Supernatural Abilities, with explanations including the fasting roll.
quotes: Characters wishing to fast for a season must make a Stamina + stress die roll against an Ease Factor of 6 to succeed.
| Performing a Mortal Sin| –9 |

entries.title: First Ring of Solomon
entries.summary: First ring, recited in spring or autumn, grants temporary experience in Philosophiae and raises Communication.
quotes: Successfully reciting this oration gives you 100 experience points in the Academic Ability: Philosophiae.

entries.title: Second Ring of Solomon
entries.summary: Second ring, recited in winter, grants temporary experience in Theology and raises Intelligence.
quotes: With a successful recitation of the second ring, you gain 100 experience points in the Academic Ability: Theology.

entries.title: Third Ring of Solomon
entries.summary: Third ring, recitable in any season, grants temporary experience in Medicine and the Greater Purifying Touch Virtue for a chosen disease.
quotes: A person gains 100 experience points in the Academic Ability: Medicine, and also receives for free the Supernatural Major Virtue: Greater Purifying Touch.

entries.title: Fourth Ring of Solomon
entries.summary: Fourth ring summons a personal patron angel who acts as a guardian and teacher of academic Abilities, and may end the ring or cancel other rings if the character acts impiously.
quotes: Successfully reciting the fourth ring grants you the Major General Virtue: Patron Angel.

entries.title: Fifth Ring of Solomon
entries.summary: Fifth ring, recited in summer, lets the character determine which realm a being is affiliated with and possibly learn its powers, with no need to Penetrate.
quotes: SENSE REALM AFFILIATION: Perception + Ars Notoria vs. 6 + Target's Magic Resistance/5

entries.title: Sixth Ring of Solomon
entries.summary: Sixth ring, recited in spring, provides holy divination about the results of actions via a Perception + Ars Notoria roll against difficulties listed in a table.
quotes: DIVINATION: Perception + Ars Notoria vs. variable Ease Factor

entries.title: Seventh Ring of Solomon
entries.summary: Seventh ring gives perfect understanding of known skills: simple die rolls become stress dice and stress dice cannot botch, though the patron angel may end it for Pride.
quotes: In game terms, you replace all your simple die rolls with stress die rolls.

entries.title: Ars Notoria: Beneficial Side-Effects
entries.summary: Ars Notoria score reduces the Divine-aura penalty to other magic and an active ring prevents Warping Points from Divine auras.
quotes: For each point of Ars Notoria you have, you may reduce the Divine penalty received from the Realm Interaction Chart by 3.

entries.title: Ars Notoria: Writing Books
entries.summary: Rules caveats for writing books while a ring's benefits are active: the effect must cover the writing period, authors cannot stop to extend it, and cannot learn from their own texts.
quotes: Remember too that no author may learn from his own texts.

entries.title: Craft Amulets: Shape and Material Bonuses
entries.summary: Lists materials, shapes and colors that give bonuses to enchanting amulets, plus extra bonuses for particular combinations; the total is capped by the crafter's Craft Amulets score.
quotes: The total bonus provided by shapes or materials is limited to the character's Craft Amulets Score.
Forming the amulet from a coin provides an additional +1 bonus.

entries.title: Craft Amulets (Ability and Amulet Creation)
entries.summary: Explains how Minor and Major amulets are made with Touch range and Worn duration, how long they take, the totals used to craft them, and how penetration is handled.
quotes: CRAFT MINOR AMULET TOTAL: Dexterity + Craft Amulets + Shape and Material Bonus + Dominion Aura Bonus
CRAFT MAJOR AMULET TOTAL: Dexterity + Craft Amulets + Holy Method + Holy Power + Shape and Material Bonus + Dominion Aura Bonus
The crafter's Craft Amulets Total must be at least double the target level of effect.

entries.title: Gematria: Divination from Texts
entries.summary: Explains how Gematria derives hidden meaning from the Torah by numeric values of Hebrew letters, and the limits when applying it to other books.
quotes: Using other books requires a stress die. Books on Arts or Accelerated Abilities cannot be used.

entries.title: Shinnui Shem (Changing a True Name to Delay Aging)
entries.summary: A kabbalist spends a season changing a True Name, severing arcane connections and gaining a bonus to future Aging Rolls that ends at the next Aging Point and does not stack with other supernatural bonuses.
quotes: BONUS TO AGING ROLL: (Simple Die + Intelligence + Gematria + Understanding + Book Quality + Dominion Aura) / 5
A character may only be renamed once by Shinnui Shem

entries.title: Kabbalah and the Sefirot
entries.summary: Describes practical kabbalah and ties a kabbalist's Kabbalah score to the Sefirah of the Tree of Life he has come to understand.
quotes: so a kabbalist with a score of 5 in Kabbalah has achieved the understanding of tiferet and those with a score of 10 or more achieve understanding of Keter.

related.text: Tree of Life table under Mythic Companion: Kabbalist

entries.title: Learning the True Names of Angels (Merkavah Total)
entries.summary: A kabbalist fasts and prays over seasons, spending long-term fatigue and accumulating points against the target's Might until its True Name is revealed, giving a Holy Connection and a Penetration bonus.
quotes: MERKAVAH TOTAL: Stamina + Merkavah + Adjuration + Ceremony Bonus + Dominion Aura
EASE FACTOR: Target's Might Score
provides a +5 bonus to his Penetration modifier when affecting the being

entries.title: Dangers of Studying Merkavah Alone
entries.summary: A student studying or using Merkavah alone must pass a Personality Stress Roll each season or become obsessed; a botch attracts Infernal attention.
quotes: the character must make a Disciplined Personality Stress Roll against Ease Factor 9.

gated.title: Infernal traditions
gated.intro: The maleficia, Goetia and infernal magic.

entries.title: Consumption Guidelines
entries.summary: General notes on victims and targets for Consumption effects, including extra magnitudes for animals and plants and the need to penetrate Magic Resistance.
quotes: the effect must penetrate it to have any effect on the target

entries.title: Debauchery/Consumption guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines by level for Debauchery/Consumption: bonuses and penalties transferred between target and victim, Characteristic shifts, Recovery changes, body exchange and aging.
quotes: Add the magnitude of the effect to the target's Damage and Soak, and also add it to his Load.

entries.title: Incantation/Consumption guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines by level for Incantation/Consumption: transferring wounds, illnesses, aging crises and Decrepitude from target to victim and placing the caster's soul in an object.
quotes: Permanently heal all of a target's wounds, killing a victim.

entries.title: Diablerie Guidelines
entries.summary: Defines what a supernatural creature is for Diablerie guidelines and states that Diablerie cannot affect the Divine.
quotes: Diablerie cannot affect the Divine.

entries.title: Debauchery/Diablerie guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines by level for Debauchery/Diablerie: dispelling, wards against creatures, perceiving Might, Arcane Connections, freeing bound demons, and creating Infernal auras and regiones.
quotes: Create an Infernal aura at level 1. Each additional magnitude increases it by one, to a maximum of 5.

entries.title: Incantation/Diablerie guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines by level for Incantation/Diablerie: Magic Resistance, restoring a demon's Might, compelling and dominating creatures, False Powers and tainting vis.
quotes: Give a person, object, or area Magic Resistance equal to the level of the effect + 5, which does not add to other forms of resistance.
Permanently taint vis with the power of the Infernal, producing vis infesta.

entries.title: Effusion Guidelines
entries.summary: Notes that unnatural Effusion effects usually add two magnitudes to the level.
quotes: usually add two additional magnitudes to the level

entries.title: Debauchery/Effusion guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines by level for Debauchery/Effusion: softening objects, hotter flames, igniting materials of differing flammability, controlling natural phenomena of increasing severity and warding against them.
quotes: Soften an object, giving it a penalty to Damage or Protection equal to the effect's magnitude.

entries.title: Incantation/Effusion guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines by level for Incantation/Effusion: hardening objects, chilling, controlling substances, moving and teleporting objects over increasing distances and storing a maleficium in an object.
quotes: Harden an object, giving it a bonus to Damage or Protection equal to the effect's magnitude.
Instantly transport an object to anywhere the caster has been before, or to which he has an Arcane Connection.

entries.title: Debauchery/Malediction guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines by level for Debauchery/Malediction: hampering, fatigue loss, wounds of increasing severity, destroying targets, disease and striking dead.
quotes: Strike a person or animal dead.

entries.title: Incantation/Malediction guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines by level for Incantation/Malediction: roll penalties with extra botch dice, Characteristic reduction, and suppressing Virtues or granting Flaws.
quotes: Give a target a penalty on all die rolls equal to the magnitude of the effect, as well as that many additional botch dice any time the target rolls a 0.

entries.title: Phantasm Guidelines
entries.summary: General modifiers for phantasms: extra magnitudes for intricate or mobile phantasms and for turning animate things into inanimate ones, plus size modifiers when changing shape.
quotes: adds two magnitudes

entries.title: Debauchery/Phantasm guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines by level for Debauchery/Phantasm: dangerous phantasms, granting abilities to a target, invisibility, creating phantasms with Infernal Might and separating a spirit from its body.
quotes: Create a dangerous phantasm, like fire or poison, that does +(base level of the spell) Damage upon contact.

entries.title: Incantation/Phantasm guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines by level for Incantation/Phantasm: remote senses, perceiving spirits, seeing through Infernal illusions and ominous visions of the past or future of increasing range.
quotes: Gain an ominous vision of an event that happened within a day in the past, or that is likely to happen within a day in the future.

entries.title: Debauchery/Psychomachia guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines by level for Debauchery/Psychomachia: tarnishing auras, changing emotions, shifting Personality Traits, granting temporary Traits, Warping Points and Confidence.
quotes: Increase or decrease a character's Personality Trait by one step, to a maximum of +3 or –3.

entries.title: Incantation/Psychomachia guidelines
entries.summary: Spell guidelines by level for Incantation/Psychomachia: sensing Divine or Infernal effects and emotions, implanting thoughts and desires, compelling behaviour and controlling a mind completely.
quotes: Compel a target to act on his immediate desires.

entries.title: Maleficia (Infernal casting)
entries.requires: Infernalist with a Method and a Power
entries.summary: Core rules for casting Infernal effects: combine a Method and a Power in a stress-die total against a target level, with failures costing botches and Warping, Hierarchy softening the consequences, a season to secure a soul after a botch, and the Vengeful Powers penalty for selfless use.
quotes: Maleficium: stress die + Characteristic + Method + Power + aura bonus
Treat a failed roll as one botch for each ten levels or fraction thereof that the infernalist is lacking.
The infernalist may substitute his (Hierarchy Score x 10) for his Maleficium Total

entries.title: Infernal Ranges, Durations, and Targets
entries.summary: New spell parameters for maleficia: Range Crossroads, Duration Cursed (condition), Duration Forsaken and Target Passion, each with its equivalent magnitude.
quotes: Range Crossroads is considered the same level as Range Voice.
Duration Forsaken is the same level as Duration Year
Target Passion is the same level as Target Group

related.text: ArM5 p.92 Faerie Magic Range: Road

entries.title: Debauchery (Unholy Method)
entries.summary: The Method of casting a maleficium through a corrupting ritual that costs a long-term Fatigue level or a Light Wound, using Stamina, and that can be extended over hours or a whole season to build up Confidence spending or add Infernal Lore.
quotes: This uses the character's Stamina with the maleficium roll.

entries.title: Example: Richard of Glastonbury (maleficium)
entries.summary: A worked example of building and casting a maleficium, computing a casting total, rolling a possible botch and spending Confidence to limit the damage.
quotes: This is a base 15 Incantation/Diablerie effect

entries.title: Powerful Maleficia
entries.summary: Lists the ways an infernalist can boost a maleficium total: Ceremony, Confidence, Hierarchy, Sacrifice and vis, and that they can be combined.

entries.title: Incantation (Unholy Method)
entries.summary: The Method of casting through chanted words, using Communication, costing a Confidence Point or a Warping Point, and allowing infernal vis to boost the casting total.
quotes: Each pawn of vis he expends while casting the maleficium gives him a +2 bonus to his casting total
The number of pawns he can use in a single maleficium is limited to his (Incantation + Power).

entries.title: New Methods and Powers
entries.summary: Guidance for storyguides on designing additional Methods and Powers for maleficia, including the minimum pairings and how to adapt an existing Method.
quotes: each new Method must be associated with at least two Powers, and each new Power must use at least one Method

entries.title: Unholy Powers (overview)
entries.summary: Introduces the six unholy Powers, each combined with an unholy Method to form an effect, with guidelines per combination.
quotes: There are six unholy Powers

entries.title: Consumption (Unholy Power)
entries.summary: Describes the Power of drawing on the life and health of living beings: Debauchery reshapes the body, Incantation steals life from others, and failure deforms the caster.

entries.title: Diablerie (Unholy Power)
entries.summary: Describes the Power of influencing demons and other supernatural beings within range, and how Forsaken Duration effects become Infernal blessings treated as Vengeful Powers.
quotes: Diablerie maleficia that grant Powers to the target are usually Forsaken Duration

entries.title: Effusion (Unholy Power)
entries.summary: Describes the Power over base materials and insubstantial forces: Debauchery governs fire, air and unseen forces, Incantation governs water, earth and cold matter. It cannot create anything living or make something from nothing.
quotes: Effusion cannot produce anything living

entries.title: Malediction (Unholy Power)
entries.summary: Describes the Power of cursing: Incantation lays general curses, Debauchery lays destructive ones, with Infernal curses usually Forsaken in Duration, bad-luck side effects for roll penalties, and backfire on failure.
quotes: usually have a Forsaken Duration, so that they remain active until the victim can somehow dispel them

entries.title: Phantasm (Unholy Power)
entries.summary: Describes the Power of Infernal illusions that seem real: Debauchery conjures or transforms into phantasms, Incantation perceives and predicts. Phantasms are dispelled by the Divine, cannot survive in the Dominion, and are vulnerable to a chosen material.
quotes: Phantasms cannot survive in the Dominion.
If a phantasm is somehow affected by the Divine, it is immediately dispelled

entries.title: Psychomachia (Unholy Power)
entries.summary: Describes the Power over mind and emotion: Incantation reads and controls minds, Debauchery changes personality so the target wants to sin, and failure muddles the caster.
quotes: with Debauchery the caster can change the target's personality

entries.title: Mythic Companion: The Diabolist
entries.summary: How a character becomes a diabolist through a ceremony with a demon, and character creation for a Diabolist Mythic Companion with required Virtues and a split of Infernal Virtues.
quotes: To become a diabolist, a character must only participate in a short ceremony with a demon
This leaves him with ten points of Flaws to spend, which balance out as many as 20 more points of Virtues.

entries.title: The Goetic Arts
entries.summary: Overview of the four Goetic Arts (Summoning, Ablating, Binding, Commanding), which are learned like Supernatural Abilities but start at 0 and advance as Arts, with Penetration and optional sacrifice.
quotes: they are opened at 0 instead of 1

entries.title: Goetic Summoning
entries.summary: How a sorcerer draws a spirit into a circle: Summoning Total against double the spirit's Might, Hierarchy adjustments for demons, scouring for a non-specific spirit, time and Fatigue costs, concentration if the margin is thin, and botches.
quotes: Summoning Total: stress die + Presence + Summoning + (Realm) Lore + aura + (Penetration x Penetration Modifier)
Scouring Total: stress die + Presence + Summoning + (Area) Lore + aura + Penetration
Summoning or Scouring Target Level: spirit's Might x 2

entries.title: Summoning and Other Realms
entries.summary: Explains that Summoning may belong to the Magic or Faerie realm for aura interaction yet always reads as unholy to Divine investigation.
quotes: Summoning is always tainted

entries.title: Goetic Ablating
entries.summary: Rules for stripping Might from a summoned spirit: an Ablation Total against the spirit's Might, permanent loss of Might for the spirit, and Ablation Points spent on Confidence, Characteristics, health, longevity, Might, Powers, vis and more.
quotes: Ablation Total: stress die + Stamina + Ablating + (Realm) Lore + aura + (Penetration x Penetration Multiplier)
Ablation Points: (Ablation Total – Ablation Target Level) / 5, or spirit's Might / 5

entries.title: Goetic Binding
entries.summary: Rules for forcing a spirit into a person or object: a Binding Total against the spirit's Might, Magic Resistance from the bound spirit, anchoring maleficia in objects, learning the spirit's Abilities and Powers, and Warping and aging effects.
quotes: Binding Total: stress die + Intelligence + Binding + (Realm) Lore + aura + (Penetration x Penetration Multiplier)
The binding can hold a number of spell levels equal to the spirit's (Might x 5)

entries.title: Goetic Commanding
entries.summary: Rules for ordering a summoned spirit: a Commanding Total against its Might, commands lasting until midday or midnight, and a list of common commands such as Follow me, Aid me, Protect me and Teach me.
quotes: Commanding Total: stress die + Communication + Commanding + (Realm) Lore + aura + (Penetration x Penetration Modifier)
A command has force for only a short while, however, only until midday or midnight

entries.title: Mythic Companion: The Summoner
entries.summary: Character creation for a Summoner Mythic Companion: required Summoner and Summoning Virtues plus one free Minor Virtue, with the background of sorcerers and their ghostly mentors.
quotes: Summoning (Major, Goetic Art)

entries.title: Apotropaic Guidelines
entries.summary: Sidebar of new Vim spell guidelines for dealing with demons: restoring Might, creating Arcane Connections, speaking with, binding, weakening, commanding and summoning them.
quotes: Restore a demon's Might Pool by (the level of the spell + 10), as long as the spell penetrates its Magic Resistance.
Reduce the Casting Total for a specific type of magic (such as Infernal Powers) cast by the target by the (level + 2 magnitudes) of the spell.

entries.title: Shape and Material Bonuses (demon-related)
entries.summary: Table of Shape and Material bonuses for enchanting items and casting effects that summon, ward against, bind or banish demons and spirits, with the roll needed to make an angelic-sigil amulet.
quotes: An Intelligence + Infernal or Divine Lore roll against an Ease Factor of 12 is required to make such an amulet

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine p.137

entries.title: Venatores (demon-hunters)
entries.summary: Describes the Venatores, magi who hunt demons and pass on their lore as an advanced apprenticeship, and how demon-slaying earns them a Venator Reputation and a high Hierarchy Score.
quotes: Each demon they defeat increases their poor Reputation among demons, so that Venatores usually have a powerful Hierarchy Score.

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages, House Quaesitor, Deals with Devils

entries.title: Apotropaic Mastery
entries.requires: Spell with Infernal Might as its direct target; Hierarchy Score
entries.summary: A spell mastery ability that boosts the effect level of spells aimed directly at Infernal Might, using the caster's Hierarchy Score.
quotes: It allows the caster to add his (Mastery Score x Hierarchy Score) to the level of effect produced by the mastered spell.

entries.title: Chthonic Magic
entries.requires: Supernatural Ability: Chthonic Magic (lineage, tradition, societas, Hermetic Virtue or Mystery Cult)
entries.summary: Low magic associated with underworld gods and night spirits that is ambiguously Infernal: the magus is attuned to Magic and Infernal auras, can use Infernal vis safely and maleficia Ranges/Durations/Targets, and gains a doubled lowest Art after a sinful act.
quotes: Finally, a chthonic magus may always add his lowest Art score to his Lab Total or Casting Total twice
The chthonic magus becomes attuned to both Magical and Infernal auras, and so gains Warping Points from neither, and the benefits of both.

entries.title: Goetic Magic
entries.requires: Possession of the Goetic Arts in question
entries.summary: Lets a magus who has studied the Ars Goetia substitute Rego and Vim scores in Goetic formulae, and bond a spirit as familiar using the Summoning Art.
quotes: a magus may substitute his score in Rego for his score in Summoning, Ablating, Binding, or Commanding

entries.title: Goetic Mastery
entries.requires: Goetic Arts; Rego Vim spell targeting spirits
entries.summary: A spell mastery ability for spells that target spirits, adding a Goetic Art to the Casting Total and Hierarchy Score to Penetration, and tainting the spell as Unholy.
quotes: He also adds his (Hierarchy Score x 5) to his Penetration Total when he casts this spell on a demon.

entries.title: False Gift (False Magic)
entries.requires: Virtue: False Gift; Flaw: False Power
entries.summary: Explains the Infernally corrupted Gift: it carries the usual social penalties, its Supernatural Abilities are False Powers, Warping causes Vituperation instead of Twilight, and confessing and being absolved removes the Gift.
quotes: When exposed to Warping, instead of experiencing Twilight, a character with the False Gift must undergo Vituperation.
The False Gift has no cost, like its magical counterpart, though it requires the False Power Flaw

entries.title: Designing New Traditions
entries.summary: Guidance for building your own Infernal traditions out of Methods, Powers and other Favored Abilities, including how new Powers and Methods must be linked.
quotes: New Powers must be associated with at least one Method, and a new Method must be associated with at least two Powers.

entries.title: Infernal Traditions: learning Infernal Abilities and Favored Abilities
entries.requires: Touched by evil (Warping Point from an Infernal source, a deal with a demon, or any Infernal Virtue or Flaw)
entries.summary: Defines Infernal traditions for game purposes, who can learn Infernal Supernatural Abilities and how the study activity works, and the four Favored Abilities each tradition specializes in (one tradition per lifetime).
quotes: you must subtract the character's scores in other Supernatural Abilities from the total experience gained in a season of study, and you must reach a score of 1 in that season to learn the Ability.
Infernal traditions usually have four Supernatural Abilities in which they specialize

entries.title: Luciferans (Infernal tradition)
entries.summary: Infernalists deceived into following a seemingly holy Lucifer; lists their Favored Abilities and notes that a character can play one who thinks he is pious, with Powers relabeled as Divine counterparts.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Debauchery, Diablerie, Malediction, Sense Passions

entries.title: Unknowing Evil (playing an unwitting Luciferan)
entries.summary: Optional rule letting the storyguide disguise a Luciferan character's Powers under Divine-sounding names so the player can portray an infernalist who believes he is holy.
quotes: labeling Debauchery, Diablerie, and Malediction as Purity, Adjuration, and Cursing

entries.title: Strigae (Infernal tradition)
entries.summary: Night-witch covens led by a senior infernalist with a demonic patron; lists the Favored Abilities and describes how covens operate, including the Benandanti nightwalkers who fight the stregoni.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Debauchery, Effusion, Phantasm, Ceremony

entries.title: Witch-Hammers (Infernal tradition)
entries.summary: Infernalists who hunt witches and heretics, taught by the malleus epistula, which acts as a summa on the tradition's four Favored Abilities.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Ablating, Incantation, Psychomachia, Summoning
is essentially a summa (Quality 26, Level 1) on all four Favored Abilities of the tradition

entries.title: Dark Gnostics (Infernal tradition)
entries.summary: Infernalist heretics who teach that sinful acts have moral value; the entry lists their Favored Abilities and describes their beliefs and use of maleficia to gain insight.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Diablerie, Entrancement, Incantation, Phantasm

entries.title: The Dread Host (Infernal tradition)
entries.summary: Infernalists who bind demons and spirits into servants, relics and possessed followers, hoping to become Infernal ghosts after death; lists the Favored Abilities and describes the possession-driven danse macabre.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Binding, Effusion, Incantation, Summoning

entries.title: The Mulhidun (Infernal tradition)
entries.summary: Eastern demonologists who summon and enslave demons to labor for them; lists the Favored Abilities and describes how binding demons to charms lets outsiders think all of them can command demons.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Ablating, Binding, Commanding, Summoning

entries.title: The Damhadh-Duidsan (Infernal societas)
entries.requires: Infernal Societas: The Damhadh-Duidsan (House Ex Miscellanea lineage)
entries.summary: Hermetic lineage descended from a Gaelic hedge wizard that uses rune-based curses; gives the Favored Abilities and a template for designing a member, with Giant Blood common.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Consumption, Incantation, Malediction, Shapechanging
use the Ex Miscellanea character template, taking Puissant Corpus, Necessary Condition (runes), and either Shapechanging, Giant Blood, or Incantation for your free Virtues and Flaws

entries.title: Ogam Writing
entries.summary: Explains the Gaelic runic writing used by the Damhadh-Duidsan to inscribe incantations and the modest Language requirement it carries.
quotes: a Language score of at least 2 that may be used to sound out the letters

entries.title: The Ordo Vagorum (Infernal societas)
entries.requires: Infernal Societas: The Ordo Vagorum (Goliards; Clerk or Educated, sinful Compulsion)
entries.summary: Wandering student-clergy infernalists (Goliards) loosely tied to House Mercere; lists Favored Abilities and the requirements for joining, such as Clerk or Educated plus a sinful Compulsion and an Infernal background Virtue or Flaw.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Consumption, Corruption, Debauchery, Psychomachia
they should take either Clerk or Educated, and have some sort of sinful Compulsion

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages, p.93 Goliards

entries.title: The Witches of Thessaly (Infernal societas)
entries.requires: Infernal Societas: The Witches of Thessaly (Ex Miscellanea or other witches; Chthonic Magic)
entries.summary: Chthonic witches of Thessaly and their Hermetic sisters; lists Favored Abilities, notes that kin in the tradition learn Supernatural Abilities without penalty, and gives free Virtue and Flaw suggestions for Ex Miscellanea Thessalians.
quotes: Favored Abilties: Chthonic Magic, Commanding, Hex, Summoning
for as members of the same Infernal tradition they can learn their Supernatural Abilities without penalty

entries.title: Drawing Down the Moon
entries.requires: Infernal Societas: The Witches of Thessaly
entries.summary: The Thessalian rite of summoning the succubus Selene to seduce a man, which yields virus lunare that serves as an Arcane Connection, and can be made fixed by working it into a kolossos figurine.
quotes: This liquid is treated as an Arcane Connection to the man she seduced, and lasts for one month.

gated.title: Ancient magic
gated.intro: The magics of the ancient world and their integration.

entries.title: The Language of Adam
entries.summary: Fluency in Adamic gives the speaker a lasting Arcane Connection to anything he can name or that is in earshot, and even partial knowledge boosts the Penetration multiplier against targets with Magic Resistance; naming something also shapes its destiny.
quotes: has at least a score of 5 in the Dead Language (Adamic) Ability
receives a +1 bonus to his Penetration multiplier whenever he uses his magic on a target with Magic Resistance

entries.title: Story Hook: The Language of Innocence
entries.summary: Option for a Gifted child raised without language influences to begin with a limited, undevelopable score in Dead Language (Adamic) that can be taught on to others.
quotes: may begin with a score of 2 in Dead Language (Adamic)

entries.title: The Tower of Babel
entries.summary: Describes the research route to Adamic: become fluent in two of the four ancient root languages and reconstruct their common ancestor, which also demands a minimum Area Lore for the region.
quotes: the character must first become fluent in two of these four ancient languages via linguistic research
gain the required Area Lore score of 5

entries.title: Linguistic Research
entries.requires: Fluency in two related languages and Area Lore for their homeland
entries.summary: Seasonal study of two related languages grants Exposure experience in their common ancestor, and the character can alternatively experiment as in Breakthrough research with roll modifiers, a Discovery result giving a big experience jump and a botch costing experience.
quotes: This gives the character two points of Exposure experience in the common language Ability
the player may modify the results of the experimentation roll by +1 or –1, to a maximum of +3 or –3

entries.title: Seeking Lost Babylon
entries.summary: Gaining the Area Lore needed for linguistic research means exploring ancient Babylonia, which takes many seasons of Practice.
quotes: It takes about 15 seasons of exploring Babylonia to gain a score of 5 in Area Lore (Ancient Mesopotamia) through Practice.

entries.title: The Guardians
entries.requires: Access to the Garden of Eden regio
entries.summary: Describes the layered Divine regio of Eden and the angelic guardians who bar humans, reptiles, faeries, demons and ghosts but admit animals, so characters can only pass by fully transforming into an animal shape and keeping it.
quotes: The regio has three levels.
Characters with Divine Might can enter and leave whenever they wish

entries.title: The Animals
entries.requires: Access to the Garden of Eden regio
entries.summary: Rules for life inside Eden: animals speak Adamic, Gifted magi in animal form lose their Gift and cannot cast or experiment, and learning Adamic from the animals is slow by Exposure but faster by Practice.
quotes: Magi who enter in animal form find that they no longer have The Gift while within the garden
they can begin to learn through Practice, which gives eight experience points per season

entries.title: The Fruits
entries.requires: Access to the Garden of Eden regio
entries.summary: Eating the fruit of the Tree of Knowledge or the Tree of Life expels the character permanently and transforms them, granting Intelligence or the Gift with Warping, or Magical Might after an Aging roll, and fixing them in animal form while barring their whole species.
quotes: All characters who partake of it gain an Intelligence score if they have Cunning, or gain The Gift if they are already intelligent.
He must make a successful Aging roll (one which does not cause him to gain an Aging Point) to wake up.
he has a Magical Might score equal to (10 – Size)

entries.title: Talking to the Animals
entries.requires: Access to the Garden of Eden regio
entries.summary: Clarifies that Eden's animals speak Adamic without having Intelligence scores, so language-comprehension magic needs an Animal requisite to make sense of them.
quotes: effects like the spell Thoughts Within Babble (InMe 25) do not make sense of the words the animals speak unless they are designed with an Animal requisite

entries.title: Adamic Writing
entries.summary: A character fluent in Adamic who can also write may name things in writing, creating the same Arcane Connection as speaking the name; inscribing the mark of Cain additionally ties the target to Cain's destiny.
quotes: who have a score of 1 in Artes Liberales

entries.title: Finding Cain
entries.summary: Ways to learn Adamic from Cain: slow Exposure from his muttering, tutoring him by listening to his confessions, or coercing him with holy things, with the warning that slaying Cain passes his curse to the killer.
quotes: through exposure to Cain's bizarre manner of speaking, they can pick up experience points in the language

entries.title: Secrets of the Necromancer
entries.summary: Introduces Canaanite necromancy as a Major Supernatural Virtue and matching Supernatural Ability, noting that learning it from the ghost of Zephaniah is impractical for magi and that integration into Hermetic theory is the realistic route.

entries.title: Major Supernatural Virtue: Canaanite Necromancy
entries.summary: A Canaanite necromancer replicates Hermetic Corpus or Mentem effects dealing with communicating with, commanding or summoning the dead using a stress roll against an Ease Factor scaled to the effect's magnitude, and can use the Veil of Death range.
quotes: A stress roll of Communication + Canaanite Necromancy Ability against an Ease Factor of (3 x the magnitude of the effect)
Communication + Canaanite Necromancy Ability + stress die vs. Ease Factor (3 x magnitude of effect)

entries.title: Hermetic Integration (Canaanite Necromancy)
entries.summary: A magus working with a Canaanite necromancer assistant gains Insight Lab Texts and invents effects dealing with the dead, accumulating breakthrough points until the Minor Hermetic Virtue Canaanite Magic is gained.
quotes: To Integrate Canaanite Necromancy: Accumulate 45 or more breakthrough points

entries.title: Canaanite Laboratory Assistants
entries.summary: A Canaanite necromancer can supply the Insight and assist with experimental effects during integration, adding to the magus's Lab Total, but only for projects integrating Canaanite and Hermetic practice.
quotes: The magus receives a bonus to his Lab Total equal to the necromancer's Intelligence + Canaanite Necromancy Ability score

entries.title: Minor Hermetic Virtue: Canaanite Magic
entries.summary: The integrated Virtue grants the Veil of Death range, a permanent Arcane Connection to all the dead with a Penetration bonus, and in return the dead always sense the magus and hold an Arcane Connection to him.
quotes: exploit this Arcane Connection for a +4 Penetration multiplier bonus
a simple Perception roll against an Ease Factor of 6

entries.title: New Range: Veil of Death
entries.requires: Virtue: Canaanite Magic or Canaanite Necromancy
entries.summary: A new spell Range that reaches any dead mortal human regardless of the distance to their remains, provided the caster is connected to the target; it counts as Sight for magnitude purposes.
quotes: For the purposes of spell magnitudes, this range is equivalent to Sight.

entries.title: Who is Dead?
entries.requires: Virtue: Canaanite Magic or Canaanite Necromancy
entries.summary: Defines which dead can be reached by Canaanite necromancy (mortals not yet in Heaven, ghosts) and which cannot (animals, faeries, Final Twilight), and doubles botch dice when targeting those given a Divine burial rite.
quotes: if the caster botches double the number of botch dice are rolled

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine (extreme unction)

entries.title: Speaking to the Dead
entries.requires: Virtue: Canaanite Magic or Canaanite Necromancy
entries.summary: Advice on the limits of conversing with the long dead: mutual incomprehension, little reason to cooperate, and no information about the afterlife beyond who is in the world of the dead.

entries.title: The Infernal and Necromancy
entries.summary: A botched attempt to summon or speak to the dead usually draws a malevolent spirit that impersonates the target and subtly corrupts what it says; Hermetic magic cannot see through the deception.
quotes: If a character botches when attempting to summon or speak to the dead, a likely result is that a malevolent spirit pretends to be the intended target.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal (Infernal ghosts)

entries.title: Finding En-Dor
entries.summary: Locating the true site of En-Dor takes a season of searching and a roll that is harder if the searcher is not in the field; teams use the leader's scores with a bonus for similarly skilled helpers, and rival groups are resolved by the higher total.
quotes: To Find En-Dor: Int + Area Lore Canaan + stress die vs. Ease Factor 18 (or 21 if not in the field)
To search among the various possible locations to find the true location of En-Dor takes one season.

entries.title: Books on Canaanite necromancy
entries.summary: Gives study sources for improving Area Lore Canaan: the Bible and Mishna count as tractatus, and several classical works are listed as summae or tractatus with their own Source Quality and level; poor translations lower the Source Quality.
quotes: both the Bible and the Mishna (a Jewish work) may be studied as if they were tractatus of Source Quality 5

entries.title: The Clay Tablets
entries.summary: Decoding the Canaanite clay tablets takes a season and a roll, after which each full sequence works as a summa for Area Lore Canaan whose Source Quality drops for every missing tablet; each tablet is an Arcane Connection to the others in its sequence.
quotes: A season's worth of decoding work is represented by a roll of Intelligence + Hebrew against an Ease Factor of 18.
the Source Quality is reduced by 3 for each missing tablet

entries.title: En-Dor Regio Level One
entries.summary: First regio level of En-Dor: a Divine aura swamps a lesser Magic aura, and a magical stream gives a Longevity Ritual effect while in the regio, forces an Aging roll on leaving, and yields tainted Aquam vis.
quotes: acts like a +5 Longevity Ritual (ArM5, page 101)

entries.title: En-Dor Regio Level Two
entries.summary: Second regio level of En-Dor: a strong Magic aura, a valley that cannot be left except through the cave, and a city of the dead that is a suitable covenant site.

entries.title: Defixio Magic
entries.summary: Defixio magic let ancient cultists cast spells on targets they could name without any Arcane Connection, by preparing defixiones; Hermetic integration yields a new Duration and a new Range.

entries.title: Learning Defixio Magic
entries.summary: Sources describing defixiones and a roll that lets a magus realize their effects break the Hermetic limit of needing an Arcane Connection.
quotes: Intelligence + Magic Theory roll against an Ease Factor of 9

entries.title: Investigating Defixio Magic
entries.summary: Insight requires studying both a defixio and a formula from each of five cult specialties, with a bonus when both come from the same cult; an Intellego Vim spell reveals the details of an active defixio.
quotes: the magus adds +3 to his Insight roll
An Intellego Vim spell (base level 4) reveals

entries.title: Integrating Defixio Magic
entries.summary: Spells invented while integrating defixio magic must be Rituals, use the cult's Art combination, and are flawed until the Breakthrough; Event Duration and Unlimited Range need different breakthrough totals, with each cult limited to a fifth of the points.
quotes: The magus must make a Minor Breakthrough (30 breakthrough points) for Event Duration and a Hermetic Breakthrough (60 breakthrough points) for Unlimited Range.

entries.title: New Duration: Event
entries.summary: A Ritual-only Duration that holds the spell in abeyance until a described condition occurs; it requires an Intellego requisite, interacts with Magic Resistance and Aegis, depends on the casting range for detection, and adds to the spell's magnitude.
quotes: This Duration is only available for Ritual spells.
Any spell that uses the Event Duration must have an Intellego requisite.
The Event Duration adds +1 to the magnitude of the spell cast.

entries.title: Defixio Lore
entries.summary: Describes the Major Supernatural Virtue and Ability that let a cultist prepare a defixio, with cult Art limits, a day and vis per magnitude, and a roll against an Ease Factor that depends on how well the target is identified.
quotes: The creator must spend one day and expend one pawn of vis per magnitude of the spell or Ability in preparing the defixio.
After the defixio is created, the preparer must roll Intelligence + Defixio Lore + a stress die.
Defixio Lore's Penetration total is equal to the amount that the stress roll exceeds the target Ease Factor.

entries.title: Event Duration Examples
entries.summary: Worked examples of building Event Duration spells, showing how the trigger and aim determine requisites and Range, and noting that such a spell causes no Warping but cannot move.
quotes: thus does not cause Warping

entries.title: New Range: Unlimited
entries.summary: A Ritual-only Range that reaches any distance if the caster has sympathetic connections to the target totaling a minimum bonus, but needs no Arcane Connection.
quotes: This range is only available for Ritual spells.
This Range adds +6 to the magnitude of the spell or, for spell guidelines that require an Arcane Connection, it adds +2 magnitudes to the base.

entries.title: Unlimited Range Examples
entries.summary: Worked examples of Unlimited Range spells, including how a guideline that needed an Arcane Connection is converted by replacing it with a sympathetic connection and adding magnitudes.
quotes: adds +2 magnitudes to the final level of the spell

entries.title: Naming Conventions
entries.summary: Summarizes how names are given and used among Christians, Muslims and Jews, as background for deciding which names can serve as sympathetic connections in defixio and Unlimited Range magic.

entries.title: Religious Names in Defixio Magic
entries.summary: Birth names, nicknames and bynames work as sympathetic connections, but baptismal, laqab and rabbinical names do not and can cause the spell to fail or to be treated as if only a pseudonym were known.
quotes: the spell always fails

entries.title: Using Duration Event
entries.summary: Advice on Event Duration spells as traps and alarms: require the player to write down the exact trigger and totals, beware accidental Code of Hermes violations, and note the side effects of casting without Penetration.
quotes: The storyguide should always require the player to write out a complete description of the triggering event and record the relevant spell totals.

entries.title: Using Range Unlimited
entries.summary: Advice on Unlimited Range spells: the magus must create the symbolic representation himself, inaccurate maps or pictures fail, locations never visited raise troupe questions, and a storyguide may cap the distance.
quotes: A magus must create any symbolic representation used as a sympathetic connection in an Unlimited Range spell

entries.title: Finding Defixiones
entries.summary: Only defixiones whose magic has not yet been released can be studied, and the storyguide should limit suitable finds per searching season.
quotes: A magus may only study those defixiones whose magic has not yet been released.

entries.title: Ancient Texts
entries.summary: Collections of ancient defixio formulae are not rated like books, cannot teach Defixio Lore, but a formula from the same cult as a defixio gives a bonus to the Insight roll.
quotes: do not have Source or Quality ratings

entries.title: Chthonic Sanctuaries
entries.summary: Magic Lore rolls identify that underground cult temples may hold defixiones and point to a region, while Intellego Vim can detect their auras and vis sources.
quotes: Intelligence + Magic Lore roll against an Ease Factor of 12 reveals
An Intelligence + Magic Lore roll against an Ease Factor of 15 provides the general region of an appropriate sanctuary.

entries.title: Integrating Fertility Magic into Hermetic Theory
entries.requires: Ancient fetish figurine or cave painting
entries.summary: Insight comes from fetish figurines or cave paintings, effects dealing with birth and fertility earn breakthrough points, and there are two separate Breakthroughs, one for the Arcane Ability Fertility Lore and one for the Minor Hermetic Virtue Fertility Ritual Magic.
quotes: The first allows the magus to learn the Arcane Ability Fertility Lore; this is comparatively simple and requires only 15 breakthrough points.
requiring 35 breakthrough points

entries.title: Arcane Ability Fertility Lore
entries.summary: A non-supernatural Arcane Ability checked by visual inspection to detect pregnancy, due date, kinship and fertility, using Perception rolls whose Ease Factors depend on what is being determined.
quotes: A roll of Perception + Fertility Lore against an Ease Factor of 3 indicates whether a character is pregnant
A roll of Perception + Fertility Lore against an Ease Factor of 12 reveals whether a character (male or female) is fertile
increase the Ease Factors listed here by 3

entries.title: New Target: Unborn Child
entries.summary: A Target available to those with Fertility Ritual Magic that counts as Individual for spell level and lets a magus affect an unborn child, provided he can sense the mother, whose Magic Resistance also protects the child.
quotes: This Target is equivalent to Individual for the purposes of calculating a spell level

entries.title: Hermetic Magic and Mother and Child
entries.summary: Explains that ordinary Hermetic magic can only target a later-term unborn child as a Part of the mother and cannot separate mother and child earlier, a flaw which fertility magic circumvents.
quotes: Mainstream Hermetic magic can target a baby in the second trimester, and onwards until birth, as a Part of the mother

related.text: ArM5 p.112 Parts of an Individual

entries.title: The Fertility Ritual
entries.summary: A Lab activity of one season that produces a Lab Text for a conception ritual: the Creo Corpus Lab Total sets the Trait Points available, each chosen trait has a Trait Point cost, and performing it consumes vis equal to the points spent and takes parents who are both fertile.
quotes: Maximum Trait Points: 1 for every 10 points or fraction of Creo Corpus Lab Total
developing the ritual is a Laboratory activity that takes one season
Conducting the Fertility Ritual consumes an amount of vis equal to the total Trait Point cost of the desired traits.

entries.title: The Maga's Own Child
entries.summary: A maga devising a Fertility Ritual for her own child gets more Trait Points per Creo Corpus Lab Total, but the ritual is then tied to her and cannot be used for another mother.
quotes: the maximum number of Trait Points for the ritual is equal to 1 for every 5 points, or fraction thereof, of Creo Corpus Lab Total

entries.title: Balancing Traits
entries.summary: Traits given by a Fertility Ritual need not balance, but a troupe is advised to let a player-character child gain balancing Virtues or Flaws as he ages.

entries.title: Supernatural Traits
entries.summary: Parents' traits are irrelevant to a Fertility Ritual, but the magus can only grant supernatural traits from realms he has a connection to, and the Gift connects him to the Magic realm.
quotes: the magus can only develop a ritual granting powers that derive from realms he has a connection to

entries.title: Fertility Fetishes
entries.summary: A mother-made fetish, built over a season under supervision by someone with Fertility Lore, adds to the Lab Total for a Fertility Ritual limited to her own child, holds a pawn of Creo vis, and is a permanent Arcane Connection to mother and children.
quotes: Fertility Fetish Lab Total Bonus: mother's (Dex + Craft Ability) + supervisor's Fertility Lore Ability
may supervise a number of mothers, per season, equal to up to his Leadership Ability Score

entries.title: Breakthrough Points from Fetish Creation
entries.summary: A fertile maga who knows Fertility Lore can make her own fetish as an effect earning breakthrough points toward the second fertility Breakthrough, without further Insight; fetishes others make give none.
quotes: as an effect worth 5 breakthrough points towards the second Fertility Magic breakthrough

entries.title: Repeating a Fertility Ritual
entries.summary: Repeating a ritual is only safe if the original child died; otherwise the magus gains Warping Points that may cause Twilight and the new child bears the Corrupt Fertility Ritual Flaw.
quotes: the magus immediately gains a number of Warping Points equal to half the Trait Point cost of the ritual (round up)

entries.title: Cave Systems
entries.summary: A Perception plus Area Lore roll finds a cave used by the ancient fertility cult, if the storyguide has placed one in the area, and the section describes typical cave layout and surviving fetish figurines.
quotes: To Find a Suitable Cave System: Per + Area Lore vs. Ease Factor 18

entries.title: Cave Painting Galleries
entries.summary: Cave galleries depicting fertility rituals can be studied for Insight and give Lab Total bonuses to Creo Corpus work, reduced if the paintings are moved; hunting paintings give an Animal bonus, copies are useless, and removing a painting needs a mason's roll.
quotes: provides a +3 bonus to Creo Corpus Lab Totals (including during the development of a Fertility Ritual)
A mundane mason can successfully remove a cave painting on a Dexterity + Craft Masonry stress roll against an Ease Factor of 15

entries.title: Library Consultation
entries.summary: Optional extended fact-finding research rules: a character spends a season consulting books on a single question, gaining temporary experience, then rolls against the question's Ease Factor. Suited to very hard questions.
quotes: a magus can consult a number of books on the relevant ability up to his Intelligence + Artes Liberales per season
At the end of the season, the magus rolls Intelligence plus the temporarily boosted Ability against the Ease Factor of the question.

entries.title: The Secrets of the Grigori
entries.requires: Virtue: a Grigori Secret, or integration of Grigori magic
entries.summary: Grigori Secrets are Supernatural Virtues letting a user treat vis of three linked Arts as interchangeable and ignore matching requisites, at the cost of doubled botch dice in Divine or Infernal auras; integration offers a Major Breakthrough to a Hermetic Legacy and a Hermetic Breakthrough to break the Limit of Vis.
quotes: Anyone who uses vis through any of the Secrets in either a Divine or Infernal aura must roll double the usual number of botch dice for the vis.
This qualifies as a Major Breakthrough, requiring 45 breakthrough points.
If the magus wishes to break the Limit of Vis, it requires a Hermetic Breakthrough with 60 breakthrough points.

entries.title: The Chiefs of Ten and their Secrets
entries.summary: Lists the Technique and pair of Forms covered by the Secret of each known Watcher, which is the template for each Grigori Supernatural and Hermetic Virtue.
quotes: Araquiel: Creo, Terram, Corpus
Shamsiel: Rego, Ignem, Vim

entries.title: Finding the Grigori: search Ease Factors
entries.summary: Suggested Abilities and Ease Factors for quickly resolving the search for the Grigori relics and sites with simple Ability rolls instead of a full adventure.
quotes: Order of Hermes Lore, Ease Factor 12
Dominion Lore, Ease Factor 21

entries.title: Heron's Art: Mechanica
entries.requires: Virtue: Mechanica of Heron, or Hermetic integration of Heron's Mechanica
entries.summary: Introduces the Mechanica of Heron Supernatural Virtue, how a Gifted character learns it from a surviving practitioner, and why a magus would rather integrate it into Hermetic theory.
quotes: A new Major Supernatural Virtue, Mechanica of Heron, represents the magical techniques described in this chapter.

entries.title: Integrating Heron's Mechanica into Hermetic Theory
entries.requires: Hermetic breakthrough research (Mutable Device and Awakened Device)
entries.summary: Describes the two suggested Breakthroughs needed to fold Mechanica into Hermetic theory, and how uncorrupted texts and working mechanica give Insight and a one-time Lab Total bonus when inventing a matching device.
quotes: Integrating Heron's Mechanica requires the following two suggested Breakthroughs: Mutable Device and Awakened Device.
Mechanica provide a bonus equal to the magnitude of the device's effect.

related.text: Ancient Magic Introduction: Insight and breakthroughs

entries.title: Ability: Mechanica of Heron
entries.summary: The Supernatural Ability covering what mechanica are, how to build them and use them, mainly in the laboratory, with its suggested specialties.
quotes: Inventing Mechanica, Constructing Anima, working with a particular material.

entries.title: Understanding Mechanica
entries.requires: Hermetic breakthrough research on Heron's Mechanica
entries.summary: A magus studies a mechanica for a season using the Investigating Enchantments rules to learn to use it as well as possibly gain Insight; also gives the accumulated breakthrough points suggested for Mutable Device.
quotes: Study Mechanica: Intellego Vim Lab Total + stress die vs. device spell or effect level
If the study total generated exceeds the level of the effect in the device, the magus understands the device sufficiently to use the device

entries.title: Mechanica of Heron: constructing mechanica
entries.summary: How a Mechanician builds and alters ordinary mechanica in a laboratory: a creation total against a creation level based on the effect's magnitude, modifiers for size and time to employ, a cost in Mythic Pounds rather than vis, and a week's study to alter a device's effect.
quotes: Construct Mechanica of Heron Total: Intelligence + Mechanica of Heron Ability + (lower of Philosophiae or Artes Liberales) + aura
Mechanica Creation Level: (3 x Magnitude of Imbued Effect) + modifiers
Creating Mechanica Cost: 1 Mythic Pound per 3 points of Mechanica Creation Level

related.text: ArM5 p.187 auras and magical devices

entries.title: Mechanica of Heron: awakened simulacra (anima)
entries.summary: Rules for building a simulacrum of an animal, working out its Magic Might from size and material, awakening its anima with a cumulative-bonus lab project, and playing the resulting sentient mechanica (traits, Abilities, powers of movement and speech).
quotes: Anima's Magic Might: Size + Material Base Points + (lower of Philosophiae or Artes Liberales)
Awaken Anima Total: Intelligence + Mechanica of Heron Ability + (lower of Philosophiae or Artes Liberales) + Aura
Awaken Anima Level: 9 + Magnitude of Anima's Magic Might

related.text: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults p.129 automata powers

entries.title: Major Breakthrough: Mutable Device
entries.summary: Hermetic enchanted devices whose invested effect can be altered later in the laboratory using vis, as long as the new effect shares Form and Technique and does not exceed the original level.
quotes: A mutable item is created like a Lesser Enchanted Device with the new Mutable Device property adding +10 to the device's level of effect.

related.text: ArM5 p.110 shape and material bonuses

entries.title: Integrating Mechanica: the integration process
entries.requires: Hermetic breakthrough research on Heron's Mechanica
entries.summary: After an Insight Lab Text exists, the magus makes Hermetic devices that duplicate a mechanica's effects to earn breakthrough points; building enchanted devices without vis breaks the Lesser Limit of Creation.
quotes: Incorporating the Mechanicians' ability to build enchanted devices without vis breaks the Lesser Limit of Creation (ArM5, page 80), requiring a Hermetic Breakthrough to achieve.

related.text: ArM5 p.80 Lesser Limit of Creation

entries.title: Major Breakthrough: Awakened Device
entries.summary: The breakthrough that allows Hermetic magi to awaken enchanted devices; it is a Major Breakthrough unless Mutable Device has already been discovered, in which case it is Minor.
quotes: If the researcher has already discovered Mutable Device, she builds upon existing work and the discovery becomes a Minor Breakthrough requiring 30 points.

entries.title: Major Hermetic Virtue: Awaken Device
entries.requires: Virtue: Awaken Device (after the Awakened Device breakthrough)
entries.summary: Hermetic procedure for awakening a simulacrum into a sentient Awakened Device: Magic Might from material and Magic Theory, vis cost, a Lab Total accumulated over uninterrupted seasons, and further enchanting for locomotion and communication.
quotes: Awakened Device's Magic Might: Material Base Points + Magic Theory
Awakened Device Lab Total: Creo + Form + Intelligence + Magic Theory + Aura
Awakened Device Level: Awakened Device's Magical Might + (Size x 5)

related.text: ArM5 p.97 Material and Size Table

entries.title: Entering the Temple of Serapis
entries.summary: The lost temple's regio is accessible only when the local Dominion aura drops below a threshold; characters carrying a mechanica enter automatically, and the window closes after a few hours.
quotes: When the Dominion aura dips below 4, the doorway to the Temple of Serapis appears as a ghostly archway of shadows beneath the lintel.

entries.title: Ptolemaic coordinates versus Arcane Connections
entries.requires: Ptolemaic coordinates integrated into Hermetic theory
entries.summary: Explains how coordinates work as Arcane Connections that rely on the Law of Names: they do not fade, can be carried in the mind, written down or built into items, and can be shared without being lost.
quotes: They are information rather than objects, so they can be given away, and yet retained by the giver.
They do not need to be collected from a place, because they rely on the Law of Names, not the Law of Contagion.

entries.title: Using Magical Coordinates
entries.summary: Overview of integrating Ptolemaic coordinates into Hermetic magic: learn to measure the array of fixed stars, then calibrate the system by observing the array at the origin point. No new Virtue or Ability is needed and the technique can be taught.
quotes: As soon as a character has completed the tasks required to reconstruct Ptolemy's work, it can be applied immediately to Hermetic magic, and may be taught to others.

entries.title: Deriving Coordinates
entries.summary: The three ways a character can learn the coordinates of a place (stellar observation, other astronomers' observations, spellcasting), and the note that known coordinates can be used day or night, indoors or underground.
quotes: A character does not require starlight to use coordinates; the character can use known coordinates during the day, from inside buildings, or underground.

entries.title: Observation of the Fixed Stars
entries.summary: How to derive a place's coordinates by astronomical observation: an Intelligence + Artes Liberales roll with a clear sky, simple tools and time for calculation (shortened by supernaturally accurate timepieces or Ptolemy's tables). It cannot work without the array of fixed stars at the origin.
quotes: A character who makes an Intelligence + Artes Liberales roll against an Ease Factor of 15 makes an accurate observation.

entries.title: Learning Coordinates from Other Astronomers
entries.summary: Coordinates can be taken from Ptolemy's published lists, but their accuracy varies by region, being excellent near Alexandria, often good within the old Western Roman Empire and poor beyond it.
quotes: His coordinates for places around Alexandria are perfect, and those within the borders of the fallen Western Roman Empire are often correct to within a few miles.

entries.title: Stellar Measurement by Spellcasting
entries.requires: Ptolemaic coordinates plus the Celestial Magic Mystery
entries.summary: Magi with the Celestial Magic Mystery can measure coordinates by spell instead of by eye; the sample spell shows the effect and notes how precisely a magus can hold a coordinate in mind.
quotes: A magus is unable to hold coordinates in her mind with sufficient precision to represent a circle less than 1000 paces across.

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition Chapter 6: Hermetic Astrology (Celestial Magic)

entries.title: The Problem of the Origin Point
entries.summary: Characters cannot use the system until they know the array of fixed stars at the origin point, which they must infer from stellar readings, including one taken on the Zero Longitude in the Purple Islands.
quotes: The characters require three stellar readings.

entries.title: Research on the Purple Islands
entries.summary: Rolls and Ease Factors for what characters can learn about the Purple Islands from classical geography and Magic Lore before they sail.
quotes: An Intelligence + Artes Liberales roll, against an Ease Factor of 6, gives the following information:
An Intelligence + Magic Lore roll, against an Ease Factor of 9, gives the following information:

entries.title: The Code of Hermes and the Guan
entries.summary: Discusses whether the Code of Hermes protects the Guan from Hermetic interference, since they serve hedge-magician kings whom the Order may demand to submit.
quotes: The servants of magicians are the property of those magicians, and may be legitimately targeted.

entries.title: Guan king magic (meceny)
entries.summary: Community-ceremony magic of the Guan kings: it cannot fail or botch when the traditional formulae are used, and every meceny can perform a fixed set of effects with village help plus two minor effects unique to his tribe.
quotes: The magic of Guan kings is performed with community ceremonies, and cannot fail or botch, provided the ancient and tested formulae are used.
All meceny can perform the following effects, if assisted by their villages:

related.text: ArM5 p.153 Coerce the Spirits of the Night

entries.title: Entering the Garden of the Hesperides
entries.summary: How characters enter the regio hiding the Garden, its Magic aura, the restriction on entering while facing east, and the effects of the golden apples (a pawn of Creo vis and a reduction in Apparent Age).
quotes: The regio has a Magic aura of 9.
Each apple contains a pawn of Creo vis.

entries.title: Serpent-dryad growth
entries.requires: Dragon tree grown from Ladon's blood
entries.summary: Describes how dragon trees grown from Ladon's blood produce serpent-dryads and the progression by which the serpent gains heads and improves its Might, Soak, Size, Strength, Confidence and mental Characteristics as the tree flowers.
quotes: At each flowering, the serpent gains an extra head.
For every five heads, the creature gains a point of Might and Soak.

entries.title: New Shape and Material Bonuses
entries.summary: Four new materials with enchanting bonuses available to all characters: Cappadocian Salt, Doum Palm Leaf, Pure Honey and Sun Scarab.
quotes: Cappadocian Salt: +6 purifying effects
Sun Scarab: +4 detect magic

entries.title: The Hyperborean Hymns of Apollo (overview)
entries.summary: Introduces the hymns, the sacred names taught by Apollo, whose power derives from the Magic realm rather than the Divine.
quotes: although their power derives from the Magic realm, not the Divine.

entries.title: Performing the Hyperborean hymns
entries.requires: Tradition: Hyperborean hymns (The Gift or Virtue: Hyperborean Hymnist)
entries.summary: Each hymn is learned as its own Supernatural Ability, and only Gifted characters or those with the Hyperborean Hymnist Virtue can recite a hymn successfully; Hermetic magi can study discovered hymns only for Insight.
quotes: Only characters with The Gift or with the Virtue Hyperborean Hymnist can ever successfully recite a hymn and gain the supernatural powers it provides.

related.text: ArM5 p.166 learning multiple Supernatural Abilities

entries.title: Hyperborean New Virtues (Hymnist and Descent)
entries.summary: The character-creation Virtues that grant access to the hymns: Hyperborean Hymnist (a starting hymn with its powers already infused), and Minor and Major Hyperborean Descent (longevity, spirit affinity, a Mythic Blood variant with a bird or flight feat).
quotes: Your character starts with one recited hymn, which confers the Supernatural Ability of [Hymn] 1, and 15 levels of Powers (which have already been infused at the start of play).

entries.title: Supernatural Ability: Hyperborean Hymn
entries.summary: Each hymn is a separate Supernatural Ability: every level gives levels of powers, adds to Soak against the hymn's principles, and can be added to a Lab Total when the hymn is involved in the effect or item.
quotes: For each level of a Hymn Ability, your character gains 15 levels of powers (see below for details).
Hymns may be also used in the laboratory, by adding the Ability to your character's Lab Total if the hymn involves either the effect or item being enchanted.

entries.title: Dead Language: Hyperborean
entries.summary: The Hyperborean language, understood by spirits and related to Ancient Greek; it aids hymn recitation but is not required, and its alphabet needs a separate level of Artes Liberales.
quotes: everyday usage, poetry, religious usage, talking to spirits.

entries.title: Illumination: Hyperborean Warping
entries.requires: Tradition: Hyperborean hymns (as first and primary magical tradition)
entries.summary: A Gifted character whose primary tradition is the hymns suffers Illumination in place of ordinary Warping or Hermetic Twilight; Hermetic magi are unaffected and still experience Twilight.
quotes: Illumination does not affect Hermetic magi, who always experience Twilight.

entries.title: Apollo's Light: Illumination Control roll
entries.summary: Warping gives a Hyperborean wizard an Apollonian Personality Trait; gaining several Warping Points at once forces an Illumination Control roll, and failure transforms the character into an animal or separates the spirit from the body.
quotes: Illumination Control Roll: Stamina + Concentration + highest Hymn Ability score + stress die
Illumination Ease Factor: character's updated Warping Score + number of Warping Points gained + aura + modifiers + stress die

entries.title: Illumination transformation and the Bright Lightening
entries.summary: What happens while an Illuminated character is transformed, the second Control roll needed to return to human form, and the voluntary Bright Lightening that trades extra Warping for experience in a hymn.
quotes: This transformation lasts for a number of hours equal to the total number of Warping Points the character has.

entries.title: Illumination Example
entries.summary: A worked example of an Illumination Control roll, including the effect of Descent and infused power levels, and of voluntarily failing the roll.
quotes: Abaris's Warping Score is 8 (223 Warping Points).

entries.title: Reciting the Hymns
entries.summary: How a hymnist infuses a Power: a season of contemplation, then a recitation total against an Ease Factor derived from the Power's level. Once infused the Power is used at will and invoked with a brief prayer, with no gestures; includes a worked example.
quotes: Hymn Recitation Total: Communication + Hymn Ability + modifiers + aura
Hymn Recitation Ease Factor: (total level of Power(s) + Power level modifiers) / 3

entries.title: Puissant hymns and hymn Affinities
entries.summary: Affinity with Ability and Puissant Ability can be taken for a hymn; Puissant raises recitation and Soak totals but does not increase the points for Powers.
quotes: Puissant Hymn effectively increases your hymn recitation totals for that hymn, and other totals that may use your character's Hymn Ability score (such as Soak).

entries.title: Apollonian Personality Traits
entries.summary: Guidance on which Personality Traits Apollo favors and disfavors, used for Dutybound characters and Illumination.
quotes: Apollo symbolized a number of virtuous Personality Traits, the most prominent one being Austerity.

entries.title: Finding hymns, the Easy Way
entries.summary: A season-long stress roll to track down a hymn teacher, fragment or relic as a shortcut to a full adventure, with outcomes for failure and botch.
quotes: Finding a Hyperborean Hymn Source: Intelligence + Magic Lore + stress die vs. Ease Factor 21

entries.title: Recitation Total Modifiers
entries.summary: Table of modifiers to a hymn recitation total: devotional behavior, distraction, Descent, knowing the language, and honorable or dishonorable Personality Flaws.
quotes: Devotional behavior means spending a season prior to reciting the hymn in activity devoted to the veneration of Apollo.

entries.title: Hymn Powers
entries.summary: How hymn Powers are designed: levels are set with the Hermetic guidelines and effect modifiers, the Ease Factor to recite is a fraction of the level, and hymns need no vis or Rituals even for permanent effects.
quotes: The Ease Factor to recite a hymn is determined by dividing the level of the Power by three (round up).

entries.title: New Duration: 19 Years
entries.summary: A new Duration for hymn Powers lasting until the stars complete their nineteen-year revolution, one magnitude above Year Duration.
quotes: The power or spell lasts for 19 years, or until the stars complete their 19-year revolution, whichever is the lesser.

entries.title: Learning to Speak Hyperborean
entries.summary: Ways a character can acquire the Hyperborean language: similarity to Ancient Greek, decoding paired prayers, or instruction from Hyperborean ghosts and spirits.
quotes: knowing Ancient Greek allows limited understanding of Hyperborean.

entries.title: Gaining New Powers and Improving Existing Ones
entries.summary: Raising a Hymn Ability grants more levels of powers that can be spent on new Powers or on improving old ones, each requiring a recitation season; includes a worked example.
quotes: Each time you increase one of your character's Hymn Ability scores, he gains 15 additional levels in powers.

entries.title: Gaining More Levels (hymns and vis)
entries.summary: Hymnists can exceed the practical limit on powers per hymn by spending vis during a recitation, one extra level per pawn, with a suggested adjustment for high-vis sagas.
quotes: For each pawn of vis expended during the recitation of a hymn, the character gains one extra level to spend on Powers.

entries.title: The Seven Beautiful Names of Light: principles and invocation
entries.summary: Introduces the seven surviving hymns, the idea of principles (the hymn equivalent of Forms, relevant to Magic Resistance), the Magic Resistance power common to all hymns, and the longer invocation time at night.
quotes: During the nighttime the hymn takes longer to invoke: 15 minutes per point of the Ease Factor.

entries.title: Hymn: Azai (Beautiful Light)
entries.summary: The hymn of life, authority and vitality, and its list of principles (what its Powers can affect and their related Hermetic Forms for Magic Resistance).
quotes: Corpus: birth, the heart, vitality

entries.title: Hymn: Eloure (Fire Delighter)
entries.summary: The hymn of emotion, water and fertility, and its principles.
quotes: Mentem: emotions, dreams, honesty, maternal urges

entries.title: Hymn: Iaó (Fire Feeler)
entries.summary: The hymn of senses, pleasure and beauty, and its principles.
quotes: Mentem: affection, attraction, creativity, pleasure

entries.title: Hymn: Óai (Light Breather)
entries.summary: The hymn of intellect, animals, secrecy and travel (including the spirit world), and its principles.
quotes: Animal: birds, crows, dolphins, grasshoppers, hawks, mice, snakes, swans, wolves

entries.title: Hymn: Pentiterouni (Firewalker)
entries.summary: The hymn of discipline, the body, earth and stern authority, and its principles.
quotes: Corpus: aging and growth, bones, the organs and flesh, skin, trembling

entries.title: Hymn: Psyrinpheu (Fire Breather)
entries.summary: The hymn of passion, war and victory, and its principles.
quotes: Corpus: fevers, the head, muscles, sexuality, stamina, youth

entries.title: Hymn: Semesilam (Encloser, Lightmaker)
entries.summary: The hymn of the arts, justice, optimism and prosperity, and its principles.
quotes: Mentem: benevolence, justice, morality, optimism

entries.title: Hyperborean Choirs (overview)
